title: Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Consultant IT - Governance, Risk & Compliance Technology
descriptionHtml:
Über DIGITAL IMPACTS:

In einer sich schnell verändernden Technologieumgebung entwickeln sich auch die Erwartungen unserer Kunden stetig weiter. Diese sind ein entscheidender Treiber für nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg. Bei DIGITAL IMPACTS bringen wir Unternehmen mit Branchenexperten und hochqualifizierten Berater:innen zusammen, um sie auf ihrem Weg in eine digitale Zukunft zu begleiten.

Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Business, Daten und Technologie – mit einem klaren Fokus auf Umsetzung. Unsere Projekte enden nicht auf Folien, sondern im Go-Live. Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die funktionieren und messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Digitale Transformation ist für uns kein Buzzword, sondern tägliche Projektrealität: Wir arbeiten in komplexen Umfeldern, strukturieren Anforderungen und treiben Lösungen konsequent voran.

Wir suchen dich:

Als Consultant IT - Governance, Risk & Compliance Technology (w/m/d) unterstützt du Kunden im Finanzsegment bei der Übersetzung von regulatorischen Anforderungen in tragfähige Governance-Strukturen. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themenbereiche und begleitest Projekte von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

Bei DIGITAL IMPACTS erwarten dich spannende Projekte, eine schnelle Übernahme von Verantwortung und ein Umfeld, in dem du sichtbar Einfluss auf Kundenprojekte hast und dich fachlich wie persönlich schnell weiterentwickelst.

Aufgaben

  • Du setzt dich kontinuierlich mit aktuellen nationalen und internationalen regulatorischen Anforderungen der Finanzbranche auseinander, insbesondere mit Vorgaben der BaFin und der Europäischen Union (EZB, ESAs, ...).
  • Du berätst Kunden im Financial-Services-Umfeld zu IT Compliance, Risiko-, Kontroll- und IT-Governance-Themen und unterstützt sie bei der Umsetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen.
  • Du führst Gap-Analysen von regulatorischen Anforderungen gegenüber bestehenden Betriebsprozessen durch, leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab und begleitest die Implementierung regulatorischer Anforderungen – von der fachlichen Einordnung bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt Kunden bei Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung robuster Governance-Strukturen und orientierst dich dabei an relevanten Frameworks wie COBIT, ITIL oder vergleichbaren Frameworks und Marktstandards.
  • Du unterstützt bei Business Development Themen, z. B. bei der Vorbereitung von Angeboten oder der Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Du setzt dich mit dem Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen in Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Themen auseinander und entwickelst Ansätze, wie diese sinnvoll und effizient in Beratungsprojekten genutzt werden können.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast dein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschafts-, oder Rechts-wissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung innerhalb der Prüfung, Beratung oder dem Betrieb von Prozessen im IT/IKT Bereich von Finanzinstituten mit und hast bereits erste Erfahrung in den Themen IT Governance, IT-Risken und Kontrollen, IT Compliance, sowie der Durchführung von regulatorisch-getriebenen Transformationsprojekten.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen in der Finanzbranche und kannst komplexe fachliche Inhalte sicher einordnen sowie klar, professionell und verständlich kommunizieren.
  • Du kennst relevante Standards und Frameworks im Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Umfeld, z. B. COBIT, ITIL oder vergleichbare Ansätze.
  • Souveränes und selbstsicheres Auftreten zeichnen dich ebenso aus wie deine exzellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus!

Benefits

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit fixen und variablen Bestandteilen
  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Flexible und projektabhängige Einteilung von Remote/On-Site
  • Offene Kultur und ein motiviertes, junges Team
  • Moderne technische Ausstattung (Notebook und Smartphone), Software und KI-Tools für den täglichen Einsatz
  • Flexible Entwicklungsperspektiven – ob fachliche Spezialisierung oder Führungsverantwortung, du gestaltest deinen Weg bei uns aktiv mit
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Consultants, die dich in deiner Entwicklung begleiten

title: Content Creator – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Culinary Agency

Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ?

Chez Culinary Agency, nous accompagnons des établissements et des marques d’exception dans leur stratégie de communication et leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique.

Vos missions

En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients.

1. Organisation et préparation des tournages

  • Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients.

  • Préparer les besoins en amont : idées de contenus, séquences, matériel et organisation logistique.

  • Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings.

2. Création de contenus vidéo

  • Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium.

  • Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels).

  • Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné.

  • Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.

  • Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients.

3. Montage et post-production

  • Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats.

  • Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels.

  • Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients.

4. Suivi, coordination et relation client

  • Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients.

  • Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production.

  • Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence.

  • Développer une relation de confiance avec les clients, en étant leur interlocuteur privilégié lors des tournages et en assurant un suivi de qualité.

  • Créer un lien humain fort avec les clients, comprendre leurs attentes et leurs univers, et savoir s'adapter à leurs personnalités.

  • Représenter l'agence auprès de clients et de personnalités de premier plan, parfois connues, et contribuer à construire des relations professionnelles durables.

La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain, capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants :

  • Vous avez une expérience en création de contenu vidéo, tournage et montage.

  • Vous maîtrisez la captation vidéo, notamment avec un iPhone, et connaissez les codes des réseaux sociaux.

  • Vous possédez un véritable œil esthétique et savez identifier les images qui valorisent un lieu, un produit ou une expérience.

  • Vous êtes extrêmement organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs productions en parallèle.

  • Vous savez produire du contenu en volume sans sacrifier la qualité.

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'agence auprès de clients exigeants.

  • Vous aimez créer du lien, instaurer une relation de confiance et entretenir des relations professionnelles de qualité.

  • Vous soignez votre présentation et adoptez une attitude professionnelle en toutes circonstances.

  • Vous êtes polyvalent(e), autonome et capable de vous adapter à des environnements et des interlocuteurs variés.

Une expérience à l'international est un vrai plus, tout comme une sensibilité particulière aux univers de la gastronomie, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, du luxe et de l'art de vivre.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Localisation : Paris, secteur Saint-Lazare et Paris-centre

  • Présence terrain : environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine chez nos clients pour les tournages.

  • Déplacements professionnels : environ 3 jours par mois, avec des nuitées à prévoir selon les tournages.

Vous rejoindrez une agence en plein développement, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez participer à des projets variés, rencontrer de belles maisons et contribuer directement à la qualité des productions.

Notre processus de recrutement

Nous souhaitons prendre le temps de découvrir votre parcours, votre personnalité et votre potentiel créatif.

  1. Premier échange en visioconférence : un entretien de préqualification pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos expériences et vos motivations.

  2. Mise en situation : si ce premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposerons un exercice pratique afin d'évaluer votre créativité, votre sens de l'image, votre maîtrise de la vidéo et votre capacité à produire du contenu.

  3. Vérification des références : nous pourrons échanger avec certaines de vos précédentes expériences professionnelles.

  4. Entretien final avec le CEO : une dernière rencontre pour échanger sur votre vision du poste et votre envie de rejoindre Culinary Agency.

Vous avez envie de mettre votre créativité au service de la gastronomie et de belles maisons ?

Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer et de vous accueillir dans notre brigade !

title: Customer Operations Director
descriptionHtml:
Customer Operations Director

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence?

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery.

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations.

What will you do?

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance.

You will:

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels.

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries.

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets.

  • Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation.

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up.

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs.

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals.

  • Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product.

  • Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high.

In addition:

  • You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment.

  • You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance.

  • You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries.

  • You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline.

  • You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements.

  • Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus.

  • You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus.

  • You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets.

What you get  
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Ready to make an impact?

Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners?

Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

You'll also help customers get the most from our technology, so they spend less time on repeat questions and more time looking after their investors.

What makes this role interesting is the mix: part customer support, part operations, part analysis. You'll spot recurring issues and feature requests in the data, suggest process improvements that make life easier for the whole team, and find new ways to delight the firms that rely on us. Your ideas can change how we work.

Ein Betrieb läuft mit SO'USE, das Terminal funktioniert, die Gäste bestellen selbst. Und dann? Genau da setzt du an - schlägst noch die Anbindung der Lieferdienste und den eigenen Webshop vor. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskunden das volle Potenzial unserer Plattform nutzen, und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden Betriebe, die mit uns wachsen.

SO'USE ist eine Plattform für digitales Bestellen und Bezahlen in der Gastronomie. Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats. Über 1.500 Betriebe arbeiten damit täglich: vom Foodtruck über Bäckereiketten bis zu HANS IM GLÜCK.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden aktiv, vor allem am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls, und suchst den Kontakt, bevor Probleme entstehen.

  • Dein Ziel: Kunden nutzen das volle Produktportfolio von SO'USE, vom Self-Order-Terminal über Webshop und Tablet-Bestellung bis zur Lieferdienst-Anbindung.

  • Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale im Bestand und bringst sie im Gespräch auf den Tisch, passend zum Betrieb.

  • Starke Kommunikation, besonders am Telefon und in MS-Teams-Calls. Du telefonierst gern und viel, auch mit Menschen, die gerade keine Zeit haben.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for the business objectives your customers set to achieve through their AI transformation journey.

This is not the SAAS CSM role we know. Rather than driving adoption and holding the relationship, you reverse-engineer the use cases a customer already runs on the platform and agentify them: you take an existing business process and drive it into the AI era, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and applied AI work together. You build beside the customer’s own team until the workflow runs. It requires a can-do mindset, strong business acumen backed by technical fluency.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Munich office.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate use cases: Inventory the use cases an account already runs and agentify them, placing the right AI capabilities in the right places so humans and agents work together.

  • Diagnose workflows: Map where decisions get made and work moves forward, and turn it into a sequenced transformation plan with the customer’s executives and process owners.

  • Build beside the customer: Run working sessions where the customer’s own team builds the workflow, and stay in the room until it runs.

  • Route by account maturity: Use the account maturity audit and Path A readiness to decide what gets built beside the customer and what becomes a scoped engagement.

  • Partner on services: Source engagements for Deployment Strategy with the business context established, and stay connected through delivery so every build lands back into the account plan.

  • Forecast outcomes: Forecast credit burn against entitlement at business-unit level, and diagnose any shortfall: an unbuilt workflow, an unadopted one, or a process that never changed.

  • Advise on governance: Own the permissioning, data boundaries, agent oversight, and approvals that move agents from pilot to production.

  • Lead change with sponsors: Hold the relationships with the sponsors who drive change, tie every workflow to the outcome they need to show, and lead the operating-model shift that makes it stick.

  • Prepare renewals: Evidence delivered outcomes on the T-120/90/60/30 cadence, and surface risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner early enough to act.

How Success Is Measured

The core success component is our ability to drive business outcomes for our customers through the different monday.com layers of operations.

But when breaking it down to the actual day2day we can find :

* Retention of all paid components: seats, AI credits, and services.
* AI consumption growth: adoption of AI capabilities into new and existing use cases, measured as credit burn against entitlement across the account.
*Growth in new AI capabilities usage that drives commercial growth.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience

  • Experience in customer success, consulting, solutions, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS, ideally with enterprise accounts.

  • Ability to diagnose how a business process really runs and redesign it with AI and humans working together.

  • Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, or AI agents, and comfort building alongside customers rather than only advising.

  • Credibility with multiple business owners and executives, not only IT or platform owners.

  • Strong commercial and analytical skills: tying usage to business outcomes, forecasting consumption against entitlement, and making a renewal case with evidence.

  • Working knowledge of applied AI governance topics such as permissioning, data boundaries, platform automation, LLMs and agent oversight.

  • Clear communication and the ability to lead change with sponsors across a customer organisation.

  • Experience with high-paced operations and large enterprise customers is an advantage.

title: Customer Support Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Le poste

En tant que Support Operations Specialist, tu rejoindras la Team Customer Success & Delivery. Véritable point de contact de nos clients, tu les accompagneras dans l'utilisation de notre solution en assurant le traitement, le suivi et la résolution de leurs demandes. Tu auras aussi un rôle clé dans le pilotage de l'activité support, en interne comme auprès des clients.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Qualifier et traiter les demandes entrantes (outil de ticketing, e-mail) dans le respect des SLA (anomalies, demandes de support utilisateur, demandes d'évolution, demandes de travaux).

  • Vérifier la complétude des tickets (informations nécessaires, pièces jointes, contexte).

  • Réaliser le diagnostic des incidents (N1/N2) afin de déterminer la nature du besoin.

  • Prendre en charge et résoudre les demandes ne nécessitant ni paramétrage technique ni développement informatique.

  • Assurer la résolution des incidents ou leur escalade vers les équipes Produit ou Tech si nécessaire, en garantissant un transfert clair et documenté.

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes de bout en bout, informer régulièrement les clients et documenter chaque étape.

  • Veiller au respect des niveaux de service (SLA) et relancer les équipes de niveau 2 et 3 si nécessaire.

  • Formaliser la base de connaissances (FAQ, guides, tutoriels) et structurer les macros de réponse.

  • Participer aux tests et aux recettes des nouvelles versions et remonter les retours clients pertinents à l'équipe Produit.

  • Piloter l'activité support : prioriser et suivre les tickets de l'équipe, assurer le reporting et proposer des plans d'amélioration.

  • Animer les points réguliers avec certains clients (mensuels, trimestriels ou annuels) pour présenter le bilan du support sur la période.

Les outils et environnements de travail :

  • Utilisation basique de Base de données (via phpMyAdmin).

  • Maîtrise de Mantis (gestion des tickets).

  • Utilisation de base documentaire et procédures internes.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu es diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 (informatique de gestion, gestion de projet, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en support logiciel B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS, avec une vraie dimension pilotage : priorisation et suivi des tickets, reporting, actions d'amélioration.

  • Tu as déjà animé des points réguliers avec des clients.

  • Tu comprends les environnements SaaS (web et mobile), tu possèdes des notions d'API et de SSO, et tu sais réaliser des requêtes SQL simples.

  • Tu fais preuve d'un bon esprit d'analyse, de rigueur et de méthode pour diagnostiquer, qualifier et suivre les demandes.

  • Tu sais prioriser tes activités et gérer plusieurs sollicitations en parallèle.

  • Tu as un excellent sens du service client et tu apprécies d'accompagner les utilisateurs dans la recherche de solutions.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu es organisé(e), réactif(ve) et animé(e) par une démarche d'amélioration continue.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu parles anglais.

  • Tu as déjà participé à la création ou à la mise en place d'une FAQ.

  • Tu connais les écosystèmes ERP ou SIRH.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Une équipe expérimentée, bienveillante et toujours prête à partager ses connaissances.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  • Seconde mise en situation : l’objectif est d’évaluer les capacités rédactionnelles.

  • Échange avec le Team Lead – Projet, la Head of Delivery et le Project Manager.

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour de télétravail par semaine. Les 3 premiers mois, une présence quotidienne sur site est demandée pour faciliter ton intégration.

Rémunération : 34k à 36k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

title: Customer Value Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Value Partner at Hawk, you own the customer relationship from first scoping through implementation and into ongoing growth: one name, one accountable owner, no handoffs between a CSM, an Engagement Manager, and a PM along the way. You run delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology, and you're judged on whether the customer hits the outcomes we promised. At the core of the role is understanding what value actually means for each customer, in their own numbers, against their own objectives, and then building it, not reporting on it after the fact. You're not a project manager who bends to every customer's internal governance model. You're the person who proves the value Hawk delivers, then converts that proof into retained and expanded revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle for your portfolio, from initial scoping and implementation through to ongoing value realization, adoption, and new use cases. There's no relay handoff here; you carry the account start to finish.

  • Manage delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology: build the plan, track progress against it, and report clearly. Lightweight project management, owned by us.

  • Understand what value truly means for each customer, in their own numbers, and then build it. Design and drive joint success plans that align Hawk's delivery to each client's real business objectives and regulatory context, not a generic template.

  • Own commercial outcomes: drive GRR and NRR for your accounts, and where contract terms carry revenue contingency, own that recognition outcome too.

  • You're not negotiating deal terms, but you're building and proving the confidence that gets deals signed and renewed.

  • Monitor usage and performance relentlessly, and turn what you find into optimization work: false positives down, analyst hours back, faster investigations. These are numbers customers see in their own systems, not numbers we tell them about.

  • Bring AI and agentic AI tools and techniques into how you manage your customers: faster QBR prep, sharper account insight, more consistent reporting, so your time goes to judgement and relationships, not manual admin.

  • Work the sales cycle as a credibility engine, not a seller. You get pulled into pre-sale conversations to build confidence that Hawk can actually deliver what's being promised, backed by your own track record of having done it, and you're the SME customers turn to for end-to-end value creation and enablement with Hawk's technology.

  • Build and defend executive relationships across the account, from governance calls to QBRs, so that Hawk's value is something the customer's leadership sees and states in their own words, not something we have to convince them of every quarter.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years in customer-facing roles spanning some combination of customer success, engagement management, or delivery/project management within B2B enterprise software. This role consolidates all three, so breadth across them matters more than a title match.

  • A real track record managing accounts at €500K+ ARR, including cross-sell or expansion work you can point to and explain, not just accounts you kept alive.

  • Comfortable owning a delivery plan end to end, scoping, tracking, and reporting, using Hawk's best practices and methodology, without needing a separate PM in the room to keep things on track.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS and enterprise software delivery models; experience in AML, fraud prevention, or another regulated financial services domain is a real advantage, not a nice-to-have footnote.

  • Hands-on comfort with AI and agentic AI tools and techniques, and you actually use them, to work faster, sharpen your analysis, and raise the quality of what you deliver to customers, not just aware that they exist.

  • Genuine comfort operating at C-suite level. You can run a governance call with a customer's leadership team and hold your own, translating delivery status into a conversation executives actually want to have.

  • A bias toward ownership over process. You understand what value actually means for a customer, not just what the contract says, and you close the gap yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Experience in, or real appetite for, a start-up or scale-up environment where the account model is still being built as you go, not a fully mature playbook you're just executing.

Bonus

  • Another language relevant to Hawk's EMEA customer base, in addition to fluent English.

  • Prior experience where you personally carried both the commercial number (GRR/NRR) and the delivery outcome for the same account, rather than one or the other

title: Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
Opportunity

Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.

This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.

Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.

About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.
  • Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.
  • Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.
  • Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.
  • Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.
  • Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.
  • Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.

What We’re Looking For

You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.
  • Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.
  • Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.
  • Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.
  • Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.
  • Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.
  • A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.
  • An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.
  • A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.
  • Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.
  • Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.

Desirable experience

  • Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.
  • Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.
  • Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.
  • Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.
  • Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. title: Design Engineer

  • Make experimental things: demos, prototypes, side projects and ideas that help us discover what tldraw should build next

You should have

  • Experience working on sophisticated interactive software, not only marketing websites or static interfaces

  • Excellent visual, interaction and product design judgement

What you’ll get

  • Equipment allowance + great tech stack

About tldraw

tldraw is a London-based Series A startup building tools for infinite canvas and creative collaboration.

Our open-source canvas SDK powers products built by developers around the world, while tldraw.com gives us a place to explore what the medium itself can become.

We’re now experimenting with a broader product suite: evolving our existing products, exploring new applications built on top of tldraw, and making bets on new ways for people to create, think and work with computers.

We like building things, putting them in front of people and seeing what happens. We care deeply about craft, creative tooling and making software that feels genuinely new.

Wir suchen einen Digital Designer für E-Mail & E-Commerce (m/w/d) in Vollzeit.

Du entwickelst zeitgemäße E-Mails, die Typografie, Bildsprache und Inhalte zu einem hochwertigen visuellen Erlebnis verbinden. Produkte setzt du mit Gespür für Details in Szene. Freisteller, Überlappungen und fließende Übergänge sorgen dabei für einen stimmigen Verlauf.

Wir möchten unsere Designs weiterentwickeln: hochwertiger, mutiger und eigenständiger. Dafür suchen wir jemanden mit einem hohen ästhetischen Anspruch, der Briefings gestalterisch weiterdenkt, eigene Ideen entwickelt und bis zur fertigen E-Mail umsetzt. Erfahrung mit Fashion- oder Premiummarken passt besonders gut zu uns. Ebenso Offenheit für die Arbeit mit KI-gestützten Workflows.

100 % remote bei Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Hamburg oder Umgebung ist für gelegentliche Office-Tage und Teamevents ein Plus.

Aufgaben

  • Gestaltung von Newslettern und automatisierten E-Mails mit hochwertiger Produktinszenierung

  • Entwicklung editorialer Layouts mit klaren visuellen Hierarchien und durchdachter Dramaturgie

  • Gestaltung fließender Übergänge mit Freistellern, Überlappungen und zusammenhängenden Bildwelten

  • Eigenständige Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Entwürfen innerhalb der jeweiligen Brand Guidelines

  • Entwicklung passender Headlines, kurzer Texte und CTAs

  • Aufbau der fertigen E-Mails in Klaviyo und Optimierung für Desktop und Mobile

  • Eigenständige Qualitätskontrolle und zuverlässige Zusammenarbeit mit Asana & Slack

  • Einsatz von KI im kreativen Alltag und Ausprobieren neuer Tools und Arbeitsweisen

Qualifikation

  • Ein starkes Portfolio mit zeitgemäßen, hochwertigen digitalen Designs und editorialem Gespür

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail- oder E-Commerce-Design oder aussagekräftige Arbeiten aus Fashion, Beauty, Lifestyle oder dem Premiumsegment

  • Ein hoher eigener Qualitätsanspruch und ein sicheres Urteil für Typografie, Bildsprache, Komposition und Details

  • Die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in Markenästhetiken einzuarbeiten und sie eigenständig in Newsletter-Designs zu übersetzen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma und Photoshop oder vergleichbaren Design-Tools sowie Erfahrung mit responsiver Gestaltung

  • Gespür für aktuelle Designtrends und dafür, was zur jeweiligen Marke passt

  • Gutes Sprachgefühl für markengerechte Headlines und kurze Texte

  • Bereitschaft, KI aktiv zu nutzen, neue Möglichkeiten zu testen und Ergebnisse kritisch zu beurteilen

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, auch bei regelmäßigen Kampagnen

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Klaviyo-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Deine gestalterische Qualität und dein Gespür für gutes Design stehen für uns im Vordergrund.

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Langfristige Vollzeit-Festanstellung

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, unsere Designqualität mitzugestalten

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und wenig Micromanagement

  • Klare Prozesse und umfangreiches Onboarding

  • Weiterentwicklung in Klaviyo, E-Mail-Marketing und E-Commerce

  • Gelegentliche Office-Tage & Teamevents in Hamburg

  • 38.000 bis 48.000 € brutto/Jahr, je nach Erfahrung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen CV, einen Link zu deinem Portfolio und ein kurzes Anschreiben.

Erzähl uns außerdem kurz, warum du zu Heimer Marketing passt und wie du KI bisher bei deiner Arbeit einsetzt. Schau gerne auf unserer Webseite und bei Insta vorbei.

Wenn du überzeugende Erfahrung aus dem Fashion- oder Premiumsegment mitbringst, kannst du Klaviyo bei uns lernen.

Mit ausgewählten Kandidaten führen wir ein Gespräch und möchten im weiteren Prozess anhand einer typischen Designaufgabe sehen, wie du an unsere E-Mails herangehst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Digital Measurement and Analytics Director
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to our Analytics Director, you will create impact by leading and scaling our Analytics Team in Northern Europe. We take pride in our rapidly expanding partnership with Google and our success in capitalising on the significant growth opportunities across Germany and the wider Northern European market.

You'll contribute to shaping our clients' digital measurement strategies whilst directly line-managing, mentoring, and developing a team of two Analysts. Acting as both a technical authority and a strategic client partner, you will oversee the delivery of robust measurement frameworks, champion data quality, and serve as the senior escalation point for complex projects.

Responsibilities

  • Be the senior measurement advisor for key clients in the DACH region and Northern Europe, translating complex business objectives into scalable measurement frameworks, executive dashboards, and strategic narratives that drive action.

  • Help with new pitches to prospective clients alongside the Analytics Director and commercial teams, scoping measurement solutions and showcasing our analytics capabilities.

  • Oversee the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of GA4 setups across client accounts.

  • Lead the design and troubleshooting of complex tracking solutions using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and structured data layers to ensure accurate measurement.

  • Own the configuration and optimisation of Consent Mode across client portfolios to safeguard privacy compliance whilst maximising measurement accuracy.

  • Go beyond basic reporting to build a compelling narrative from data to drive strategic client action.

  • Mentor a small team of two Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, conducting technical peer reviews, and supporting their ongoing professional development.

Qualifications

  • C2-level or native-level German.

  • Over 5 years of experience in digital analytics, with expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), advertising platform conversion tracking, custom reporting, and strategic analysis.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), data layer implementation, and tracking and debugging methodologies.

  • You understand methods that safeguard user privacy while still enabling the collection of essential and privacy-compliant data.

  • Experience leading and mentoring a small team of analysts, including managing day-to-day workloads, reviewing technical implementations, and supporting career growth.

  • Track record of helping with new pitches to prospective clients, including scoping analytics requirements, shaping proposals, and presenting technical solutions to win new business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options and find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your CV in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

📈 Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn.

title: Digital Product Manager SAP HR (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe Corporates Operations recherche un·e Product Manager SAP HR (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille.

Au sein de la direction Corporate Operations (200 personnes), qui pilote l'ensemble du SI RH & Finance, notre équipe SI RH est au cœur d'une transformation d'envergure internationale : l'implémentation globale de Workday dans tous les pays Decathlon. Nous gérons un écosystème de produits critiques (Core RH, Talent, Recrutement, Paie) avec pour ambition de concilier excellence opérationnelle locale et rationalisation globale. Un défi technologique et humain passionnant où chaque membre de l'équipe a un impact direct sur le quotidien de nos collaborateurs.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Product Manager SAP HR, ta mission sera de garantir la stabilité et la performance du RUN de tes produits, tout en les faisant évoluer pour accompagner les projets stratégiques et la transformation internationale de l'entreprise. Tu seras responsable des produits SAP HR (calcul de la paie France et Espagne pour 40 000 utilisateurs) et SAP BW (reporting de paie).

Tes responsabilités principales s'articuleront autour de 4 grands piliers :

  • Pilotage du RUN & Excellence Opérationnelle : Garantir la qualité et la conformité légale de la paie France & Espagne (et des futurs pays où sera déployé la solution SAP HR). Tu seras l'interlocuteur·trice privilégié·e des équipes payroll locales pour écouter, challenger et traduire leurs besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles.
  • Animation de l'écosystème & Agilité : Animer au quotidien une équipe d'experts (3 développeurs ABAP, TMA HR Path et TMA Winch Consulting). Tu piloteras les rituels agiles, la priorisation du backlog sur JIRA et le suivi des livrables.
  • Flux de données & Écosystème digital : Être le·la garant·e des échanges de données fluides et sécurisés entre l'outil de paie et les outils digitaux de Core RH, de planification des collaborateurs, de rémunérations diverses, ainsi que les outils financiers.
  • Modernisation, Sécurisation & Projets Majeurs :
  • Mener le projet stratégique de migration de SAP HR & SAP BW vers la version RISE S4, en étroite collaboration avec l'éditeur SAP et les équipes techniques SAP internes de Decathlon.
  • Gérer l'application des Support Packages (patchs) de sécurité et coordonner les impacts avec le métier.
  • Piloter l'intégration technique avec Workday (stabilisation pour la France, construction du flux pour l'Espagne avec l'intégrateur Shapein).
  • Gouvernance, Économie & Stratégie : Assurer le pilotage budgétaire de ton produit (licences, TMA, projets). Tu participeras également aux réflexions stratégiques autour de l'initiative "SAP United" pour conseiller et étudier le déploiement de SAP HR dans d’autres pays, notamment avec le Royaume-Uni et la Malaisie en remplacement de leurs solutions locales.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d'expérience sur un scope et des responsabilités similaires.
  • Expertise Métier : Une expérience significative sur un outil de paie et une forte appétence pour les enjeux techniques et légaux liés aux RH. Une connaissance de SAP HR est un sérieux atout.
  • Product Management & Agilité : Maîtrise de la méthodologie Agile (JIRA), vision orientée valeur produit, et capacité éprouvée à gérer des dépendances complexes et des roadmaps techniques.
  • Soft Skills : Excellente communication, leadership d'influence pour animer des tiers (éditeurs, intégrateurs) et collaborer avec des opérationnels experts. Esprit critique, orientation décisionnelle et forte capacité à prendre du recul.
  • Langues : Français & Anglais courant indispensable pour évoluer dans notre contexte international.

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • SAP HR & SAP BW HR
  • Environnement RISE S4
  • Écosystème SIRH (Workday, Etemptation) 
  • JIRA

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Directeur de Site Datacenter H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vos missions

Rattaché à la Direction des Opérations, vous intervenez sur :

  • Pilotage global du site : vous assurez la conduite du datacenter et de ses infrastructures critiques, et vous garantissez la disponibilité, la fiabilité, la performance et la sécurité des installations.

  • Respect des procédures d'exploitation : vous veillez à l'application des procédures et des règles de sécurité sur l'ensemble des interventions réalisées sur le site.

  • Management : vous encadrez les équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance, et vous pilotez les prestataires intervenant sur le site.

  • Maintenance et contrats : vous planifiez et pilotez les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective, et vous suivez l'exécution des contrats associés.

  • Relation clients hébergés : vous assurez le suivi de la relation avec les clients du site et contribuez à leur satisfaction.

  • Audits et certifications : vous préparez les audits et vous assurez le maintien des certifications du site.

  • Projets d'évolution : vous accompagnez les projets d'extension, de modernisation et d'amélioration continue des infrastructures.

  • Indicateurs de performance : vous suivez et analysez les indicateurs de disponibilité, de performance et de qualité, et vous en assurez le reporting.


Le profil recherché

Prérequis :

  • 3 ans d'expérience minimum impératifs en environnement datacenter.

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent exigé dans les domaines de l'énergie, de l'électricité ou du génie climatique (CVC).

  • Anglais professionnel (niveau B2 minimum), à l'écrit comme à l'oral, indispensable.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise de l'exploitation d'infrastructures critiques et complexes, en environnement à forte disponibilité.

  • Maîtrise des installations électriques (haute et basse tension, groupes électrogènes, onduleurs) et des systèmes de refroidissement et de climatisation.

  • Maîtrise du management d'équipes techniques et du pilotage de prestataires multi techniques.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive et corrective et du suivi des contrats de prestation.

  • Maîtrise des indicateurs d'exploitation (disponibilité, performance, qualité) et de leur reporting.

Atouts appréciés :

  • Idéalement, une expérience en site d'hébergement multi clients (colocation).

  • Une certification de type Uptime Institute (ATD, ATS) ou une pratique des référentiels ISO 27001 et ISO 50001 est un plus.

  • Une expérience de projets d'extension ou de mise en service de salles informatiques est appréciée.

  • La pratique des démarches d'efficacité énergétique appliquées au datacenter (PUE, free cooling) est souhaitée.

Autres éléments

  • CDI, statut cadre

  • 35 heures par semaine, en format hybride

  • Rémunération : 80 000 à 100 000 euros brut annuels selon profil et expérience

  • Poste basé dans les Yvelines (78)

  • Astreintes ponctuelles selon l'organisation du site

  • Perspectives d'évolution dans un groupe en fort développement

title: Director, Business Transformation and Value Consulting (DACH) - CPG/Retail
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

About Celonis

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.

About the Role

Based at our global headquarters in Munich, as a Business Transformation and Value Consulting Manager / Director (internal title: Value Engineering Manager / Director) for CPG & Retail, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.

In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is based in Munich.

What Sets Our Patch Apart

The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators. 

As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth: Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
  • People Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
  • Executive Advisory & Player-Coach: Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
  • Enterprise AI Champion: Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
  • Ecosystem & Partner Strategy: Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
  • Thought Leadership: Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

Leadership Behaviors We Value

  • Deliver Business Outcomes: Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
  • Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent: Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
  • Lead by Example: Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
  • Think BIG, Be BOLD: Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

Qualifications & Scope

  • Language Skills: Native or business-fluent German (spoken and written) and fluent English are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.
  • Location Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
  • Proven Leadership Experience: Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.
  • People Management: Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
  • Executive Presence: Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
  • Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
  • Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
  • Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
  • Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs. 
  • Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
  • Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
  • Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

About Us:
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Aufgaben

title: Director of Laser Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Director of Laser Engineering (m/f/d)

Location: Darmstadt, Germany
Travel: Approximately 20%

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the engineering organization and laser systems needed for laser-driven fusion energy. We bring together specialists across laser engineering and adjacent teams to tackle a complex, long-term technology challenge.

The opportunity

As Director of Laser Engineering, you will own the delivery of our laser functions at fusion machine and system level. You will lead a team of managers and technical leaders, , establish a single technology and functional roadmap, ensuring coherence of the sub-functions, , and build the operating practices that help the organization scale from individual expertise to coordinated industrial engineering.

You will connect immediate technical priorities to long-term FPP goals, make sure technology risks have clear owners and retirement plans, and represent Laser Engineering in technical reviews and executive-level forums. The role has a global scope, with most of the team and work based in the Darmstadt area.

What you will do

  • Own and maintain the technology and functional roadmap of the laser function, linking critical work to long-term system goals.

  • Lead and develop a team of five direct reports and a broader organization of 15+ indirect FTEs and students; delegate outcomes, coach managers, and build leadership capacity; scale the team by a factor 2-3x in the next 12 months. .

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, technical review processes and practical operating rhythms as the organization scales.

  • Steer partnerships and outsourcing strategies for laser technology development. Act as an escalation step in those relationships.

  • Build a current picture of technology maturity, dependencies, gate reviews, and technical risks; maintain a risk register and drive actions that retire risks systematically.

  • Strengthen technical documentation and working practices so that important context is visible, maintained, and usable across teams.

  • Lead system-level architecture discussions by testing assumptions, weighing evidence and trade-offs, and surfacing gaps or decision points.

  • Work closely with Laser Systems Engineering, Program, Lab Infrastructure, Digital Twin, Supply Chain, and the Reactor team to maintain alignment and resolve cross-functional issues; work closely with Legal and business development on IP strategy. .

  • Represent the function at fusion-machine-wide technical review meetings and executive forums, communicating outcomes, risks, and decisions clearly.

What you bring

  • A technical background in engineering, physics, photonics, or a related discipline, gained through a relevant degree or equivalent experience.

  • Proven experience leading managers or senior technical leaders. You have developed leaders, not only managed projects or individual contributors.

  • A record of building and delivering technology or engineering roadmaps in a complex environment.

  • Strong first-principles reasoning: you can challenge expert views constructively, separate data-backed conclusions from assumptions, and make sound decisions when information is incomplete.

  • Experience managing technical risks, dependencies, and cross-functional delivery.

  • Clear, concise, outcome-focused communication with senior and technical audiences.

  • High EQ, adaptability, and comfort working in an organization where priorities and structures may evolve.

  • Willingness to maintain a consistent presence in the Darmstadt area and travel approximately 20%. Full relocation is welcome but not required; the on-site cadence can be agreed with the team.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Experience in laser engineering, photonics, or complex hardware—or building structure in a scaling organization—is a plus, but not required. A PhD is not required.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
