title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key results
  • Own the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadership
  • Partner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in place
  • Manage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation 
  • Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right time
  • Own build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutions
  • Get ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to it
  • Build, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product Managers
  • Implement best in class product development and managerial practices

About you 

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, with a substantial part of it in AML, financial crime, compliance, risk or fraud, ideally at a regulated financial institution, e-money institution, PSP, bank or fintech
  • 4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product Managers
  • Deep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)
  • Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positives
  • A proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)
  • Comfortable operating in a regulated environment: you have worked alongside compliance officers, internal and external auditors and supervisors, and you know how to move quickly without creating regulatory exposure
  • Able to deliver from 0 to 1, and not afraid to build your own tools to achieve your goals
  • Exceptional leadership skills and substantial experience building high-performing teams of 10+, ideally not only in product (and we’d expect your former teams to still be singing your praises!)
  • Strong business judgement, analytical skills and long-term planning skill
  • Both quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisation
  • Well organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownership
  • An excellent communicator, including in written and spoken English

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit.

Working at Vinted 

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work 

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

descriptionHtml:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

 

Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future.

 

Job Title: Director of Silicon Characterization

Location: Saint-Sulpice, Switzerland

Responsibility

  • Own the silicon characterization strategy and execution for multiple product programs, from first silicon through validation closure and release readiness.

  • Lead development of comprehensive validation plans, schedules, resource allocation, and execution tracking across projects and locations.

  • Oversee development of scripts, automation frameworks, and program infrastructure for IC validation, characterization, and ATE interfacing.

  • Ensure rigorous and timely execution of silicon bring-up, debug, validation, and characterization for SerDes-based and other high-speed products central to Kandou AI’s portfolio.

  • Drive the definition, specification, and review of evaluation boards and reference hardware required for lab validation and customer enablement.

  • Support customer demos, technical evaluations, and issue resolution involving silicon, EVMs, and validation data.

  • Co-own silicon validation, characterization, and test reporting, ensuring clear communication of status, risks, correlation, and readiness.

  • Partner closely with design, product engineering, quality, applications, and operations teams to accelerate debug cycles and improve silicon learning.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of validation and characterization requirements for high volume semiconductor products and IP.

  • Ability to define validation coverage from product specifications and translate it into structured test plans, milestones, and resource plans.

  • Effective collaboration with analog, digital, DfT, product, and applications teams to review and finalize validation strategy.

  • Ability to lead teams and coordinate execution across multiple sites and external partners.

  • Sound judgment in selecting methods, tools, and trade-offs for technical problem solving.

  • Experience evaluating lab and test equipment, managing vendors, and supporting procurement decisions.

  • Good understanding of budgeting, lab investment planning, productivity, and cost management.

  • Flexible, pragmatic, and execution-oriented when addressing unexpected silicon or lab issues.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with deep expertise in IC bring-up, validation, characterization, and ATE interface development.

  • Strong hands-on experience in high-speed or high-frequency signal measurement, lab automation, and validation environments.

  • Proven expertise with instruments and methods used for electrical and compliance testing, including BERTs, oscilloscopes, and signal analyzers.

  • Experience with SerDes-based products is strongly preferred and especially relevant for Kandou AI’s technology roadmap.

title: Electrical Engineer (Launcher)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
descriptionHtml:
About Genesis

Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models.

The Role

Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it.

This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs.

What You'll Do

  • Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers.

  • Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot.

  • Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve.

  • Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly.

  • Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot.

  • Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies.

  • Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands.

Your First Three Months

  • Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards.

  • Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site.

  • Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work

What You'll Bring

  • Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering.

  • 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype.

  • Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates.

  • Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation.

  • Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain.

  • Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Jetson family (JetPack / L4T, meta-tegra) or comparable embedded GPU platforms.

  • Knowledge C++ and Python packaging systems and how to deal with cross-compilation.

  • The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system.

  • Exceptional ownership and initiative, with the judgment to choose workable solutions for our current stage over the theoretically ideal one.

Bonus

  • Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets.

  • Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware.

  • Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs.

  • Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate.

  • French and English. Mandarin is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy being the go-to person for a critical system and making it easier for others to use.

  • Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer.

  • Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware.

  • Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

title: Enterprise Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

about the role

As Enterprise Deployment Strategist you own deployment and commercial success for a portfolio of telli's largest (tier 1) customers. You lead complex, high-stakes deployments with many stakeholders on both sides, from signature to first production call and from pilot to long-term contract.

what you'll do

Enterprise Pilot Ownership & Commercial Success

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts and turn ambiguous customer problems into a deployment roadmap: identify the highest-value use cases and decide what to build first (business impact, technical feasibility, time-to-value)

  • Build business-case-driven use cases and quantify their impact on the customer

  • Make the case for conversion and expansion: surface the value delivered, close the loop with decision makers and identify upsell opportunities

AI Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Navigate the enterprise: understand and navigate complex organizations and stakeholder relationships

  • Shape the customer's AI roadmap beyond the current use case and become their advisor for AI transformation in customer operations

  • Communicate across all levels, from call center agents and team leads to C-level and procurement

Complex Deployment Leadership

  • Scope, structure and execute high-stakes deployments end-to-end for tier 1 customers with multiple workstreams and stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering and customers to build, tune and improve AI agents that handle thousands of conversations daily, tracking performance against success criteria

Technical Implementation

  • Understand the customer's tech stack and workflows (CRMs, dialers, telephony, ticketing, calendars) and shape the integration architecture together with FDEs

  • Partner with customer IT on scoping data flows, outcomes and actions

Product Insights

  • Be the best read on how enterprises use telli and where the product falls short, and proactively feed learnings to PM and engineering

  • Build playbooks and workflows that make enterprise deployments faster and more repeatable

what makes you a great fit

  • You have >2 years ofexperience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes with large customers (e.g. in consulting, GTM, AI deployment/customer success, or IT implementation)

  • You have executive presence & can navigate enterprises: you build credibility with leadership and move decisions forward in complex organizations

  • You can lead complex projects: you scope, structure and execute deployments end-to-end

  • You have strong business sense: you understand customer problems and priorities and can quantify the impact of telli

  • You bring structure to ambiguous problems: you challenge assumptions, identify the most valuable problem to solve, and turn incomplete requirements into a practical solution and clear priorities

  • You have technical fluency: you're comfortable with APIs, integrations, and you've built workflows or AI agents yourself

  • You operate with high autonomy, agency and urgency: you run your accounts independently and unblock yourself and your customers

  • You're an excellent communicator in both English and German (additional languages are a big plus) - especially writing

title: Enterprise Platform Engineer, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As an Engineer, Enterprise Platforms, you will be a hands-on owner of the collaboration tools our employees use all day. You will administer, automate, and improve them, working alongside identity, endpoints, and the wider SaaS stack.

This is a role for someone who sees a problem, figures out the fix, and ships it. Our team is small and the scope is broad. You will have real ownership early, a lot of autonomy, and few layers between you and the people you support. You will turn policies, runbooks, and employee needs into reliable configurations, scripts, and self-service experiences. We use AI tools where they make us faster or more accurate, and we expect good judgment about when to trust them.

This role reflects Abnormal VOICE values. You move with velocity, design for long-term ownership and governance, use data with intellectual honesty, stay close to customer needs, and aim for excellence in reliability and simplicity.

What You Will Do

  • Administer Google Workspace: users, groups, org units, shared drives, Drive sharing and DLP, Gmail routing and policies, Calendar and room resources, Meet, and audit and security investigation tooling.
  • Administer Slack (Enterprise Grid): workspaces, channels, user groups, permissions, app approvals, Slack Connect, retention, export and eDiscovery, workflows, and audit logs.
  • Build and maintain automation for joiner, mover, and leaver flows, access requests, deprovisioning, and common employee needs, using SCIM, APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, and scripting.
  • Work with identity (Okta SSO, MFA, group-based access) so Google and Slack access follows least privilege and birthright rules.
  • Support endpoints and other SaaS platforms as needed, including macOS device management and long-tail SaaS administration.
  • Create self-service experiences, runbooks, and enablement content so employees can resolve common needs without escalation.
  • Participate in Tier 2/3 incidents, perform root cause analysis, and feed what you learn back into automation, runbooks, and standards.
  • Add logging, dashboards, and reporting so changes are monitored and audit questions can be answered quickly.
  • Use AI tools where they help (documentation, troubleshooting, request triage, analysis), with human review and appropriate access controls.
  • Partner with Security, GRC, Legal, People, Finance, and IT Service Delivery to deliver changes safely.
  • Triage incoming requests and incidents by impact and urgency, route them to the right owner or queue, and resolve or escalate within agreed response targets.
  • Turn vague or incomplete requests into clear requirements: ask clarifying questions, identify stakeholders and constraints, and confirm the desired outcome before building.
  • Set clear expectations with employees and stakeholders about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs. Give status updates proactively, and flag risks or delays early.

Governance and Compliance

  • Define and enforce standards for external sharing, Slack Connect, guest access, and third-party and OAuth app approval in Google Workspace and Slack.
  • Run regular access and license reviews, using systems and audit logs to find unused, orphaned, or over-privileged access.
  • Keep configuration baselines documented, changes tracked in ServiceNow, and evidence ready for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP audits.
  • Review audit logs and investigate suspicious activity with Security.
  • Document requirements, risks, and approvals for changes so they pass change review and can be audited later.

Scripting and Automation

  • Automate first. If a task happens more than a couple of times, you script it, build a workflow, or turn it into self-service.
  • Write scripts and tools (Python, Apps Script, and shell) against the Google Workspace, Slack, and Okta APIs.
  • Build and maintain integrations and workflows in Workato, connecting identity, HR, collaboration, ticketing, and SaaS systems.
  • Use Torii workflows to automate app discovery, onboarding and offboarding, and license reclamation.
  • Build ServiceNow catalog items and flows so requests are routed, approved, and fulfilled with minimal manual touch.
  • Keep scripts and configuration in version control, with logging, error handling, and clear documentation so others can run and maintain them.

Our Tooling

  • Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack (Enterprise Grid)
  • Identity: Okta
  • Automation and integration: Workato, Torii, Python, Apps Script
  • Service management: ServiceNow
  • Endpoints and other: Jamf, Zoom, and a long tail of SaaS applications

You don't need experience with every tool. Strong experience with comparable platforms, and a record of learning new ones quickly, is what matters.

How We Work

  • Automation-first: We remove repetitive work rather than absorbing it, and we measure success by manual touches eliminated.
  • Customer-first: Employees are our customers. We respond with urgency, communicate clearly, and fix root causes so the same problem doesn't come back. We do what we say we'll do, or we tell people early when that changes.
  • Fast-paced: Priorities shift quickly and requests arrive from every direction. We move fast, ship in small steps, and iterate.
  • Time management and triage: You juggle incidents, requests, and project work. You sort what comes in by impact and urgency, handle what's urgent first, and protect focused time for project work and for the root-cause fixes that prevent tomorrow's tickets.

What We're Looking For

  • You find the problem before someone assigns it, and you follow through to a documented, working fix.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: unclear requirements, incomplete documentation, and shifting priorities don't stop you.
  • You prioritize well when everything feels urgent. You set expectations early and honestly: you say no or "not yet" clearly and kindly, and you explain the reason.
  • You learn new platforms quickly and teach what you learn.
  • You ask the right questions up front: who needs this, what problem it solves, what 'done' looks like, and what could go wrong. You propose a recommended approach rather than waiting to be told.
  • You communicate proactively: status updates, change notices, and honest post-incident write-ups.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or a similar role supporting business-critical technology.
  • Hands-on administration of Google Workspace (Admin console, groups, Drive and sharing controls, Gmail, Calendar).
  • Hands-on administration of Slack (workspace and channel management, user groups, app management, permissions). Enterprise Grid experience is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access concepts: SSO, MFA, least privilege, directory and group management, and SCIM or standards-based provisioning.
  • Ability to script and integrate systems using APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, Python, or similar tooling.
  • Experience with incident and change management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and documented follow-through.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting technical processes and explaining complex systems to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of working independently and taking ownership without close direction.
  • Experience writing scripts or building workflows that automate repetitive IT work, and a habit of automating before doing something manually a third time.
  • A customer-first approach to supporting employees: responsive, clear, and focused on fixing root causes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage your time across incidents, requests, and project work, prioritizing by impact.
  • Ability to set and manage expectations with stakeholders, including saying no or negotiating scope and timelines while keeping trust.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company, where you wore multiple hats, built processes from scratch, or scaled IT through rapid headcount growth. 
  • Experience with acquisitions, tenant or domain migrations, or workspace consolidation. 
  • Experience with data governance in collaboration tools: retention, legal hold, eDiscovery, DLP, and audit log analysis. 
  • Google Workspace or Slack administration certifications, or involvement in their admin communities. 
  • Experience with Okta, Jamf, Zoom, or other enterprise SaaS administration.
  • Experience in remote-first, SaaS-first, or zero-trust environments.
  • Familiarity with version control, configuration-as-code, or CI/CD for platform automation.
  • Experience building self-service workflows, or using AI tools to improve support, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Awareness of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) as applied to collaboration and end-user platforms.
  • Experience with Workato or a similar integration platform (Zapier, Tray.io, Boomi, or Okta Workflows).
  • Experience with Torii or another SaaS management platform, such as Zluri or BetterCloud.
  • Experience with ServiceNow (catalog items, flows, incident, request, and change) or a similar ITSM platform.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, or the M365 admin center), especially in a mixed Google and Microsoft environment.

title: Events Lead
descriptionHtml:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With Partnerships, design, plan and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable model for international expansion.

  • Run a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between in-person moments.

Partner, Customer & Conference Presence

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, design high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, virtual showcases, roundtables) aligned to commercial and ecosystem goals.

  • Own CuspAI’s presence at major conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, materials science summits): evaluate sponsorships, oversee booth and recruitment stand design, manage on-site logistics, and report on ROI.

  • Partner with Operations to deliver internal moments such as CuspCon, offsites and all-hands.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing and Creative to bring CuspAI’s brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Work with Partnerships, Comms/Marketing and Operations to align every event with commercial, ecosystem and company goals.

  • Source and direct external agencies, AV suppliers and local vendors, and own budgets, timelines and post-event reporting to leadership.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

title: Filialleiter / Stellvertretender Filialleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mitfahren kann jeder. Du willst vorne fahren?
Dann übernimm bei uns eine Filiale. Du führst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Leuten und kümmerst dich um über 3.000 Artikel. Dazu kommen jede Menge Kunden, die mit dem richtigen Rad nach Hause rollen wollen. Ob du leitest oder erstmal stellvertrittst, finden wir zusammen raus.

Über uns

Wir sind Little John Bikes. Bei uns dreht sich alles ums Rad, vom Stadtflitzer bis zum E-Bike. Wir sind bodenständig, reden Klartext und lachen gern. Und unsere Branche nimmt gerade richtig Fahrt auf.

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Geld, das sich lohnt: hohes Grundgehalt plus Ertragsprovision für deine Leistung und die deiner Crew.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag. Punkt.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, ab 55 sogar 32.
  • Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Jedes Jahr.
  • Arbeitszeitkonto: Im Sommer gibst du Gas, im Winter nimmst du dir die Zeit zurück. Über das Jahr passt's.
  • Einarbeitung in einer Patenfiliale. Keiner schmeißt dich ins kalte Wasser.
  • Dein Weg zum Meister: Du bist Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle? Wir fördern dich bis zum Zweiradmechanikermeister.
  • Weiterbildung und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, damit du als Führungskraft wächst.
  • Echte Perspektive: von der Stellvertretung zur Filialleitung. Und darüber hinaus.
  • 30 % Rabatt für dich, das ganze Jahr.
  • Dienstrad-Leasing. Wär ja auch komisch, wenn nicht.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Empfehlungsprämie: Du holst gute Leute in die Crew, wir sagen Danke.
  • Produkte, die Spaß machen: E-Bikes und hochwertige Räder in einer Branche mit Zukunft.


Was du bei uns bewegst

Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein.

  • Du führst und motivierst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Mitarbeitern. Als Filialleitung trägst du die Verantwortung. Als Stellvertretung unterstützt du und springst ein.
  • Du planst die Abläufe, von der Sortimentspflege bis zum Einsatzplan.
  • Du hältst über 3.000 Artikel in Schuss.
  • Du stehst selbst auf der Fläche, berätst Kunden und machst den Deal klar.
  • Du hast die Zahlen im Blick und bringst deine Filiale nach vorn.
  • Du bist da, wenn's mal hakt. Für deine Crew und für die Kunden.


Was du mitbringst

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung im Einzelhandel.
  • Führungserfahrung als Filialleitung oder Stellvertretung. Oder richtig Lust auf deinen ersten Schritt in die Führung.
  • Du behältst den Überblick. Auch im Juli, wenn der Laden brummt.
  • Du redest gern mit Menschen und bringst den Abschluss sicher nach Hause.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und steckst andere mit deiner Energie an.
  • Empathie und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Muss ja.
  • Flexibilität in der Saison.


Nice-to-haves

  • Handelserfahrung aus Fahrrad, Auto, Möbel, Mode oder Schuhe.
  • Fahrradwissen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss.
  • Werkstatt-Background als Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle. Einige unserer Filialleiter haben genau so angefangen und machen bei uns ihren Meister.


Klingt nach deinem Ding?

Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht.

Diese Stelle passt auch, wenn du dich als Filialleiter, stellvertretender Filialleiter, Storemanager, stellvertretender Storemanager, Leiter einer Fahrrad- oder Autofiliale, Verkaufsleiter im Fahrradbereich oder als Zweiradmechatroniker mit Führungsambitionen (m/w/d) siehst.

title: Finance & Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
Job description

Today, the Finance & Operations team at Maki is two people. Together we cover finance and operations, including HR and part of legal, across three entities: France, the UK and the US.

That means this internship isn't a back-office job: it's a front-row seat. You will be our first Finance & Operations intern, working hand in hand with our Founding FP&A, who you report to directly, on the processes and numbers that keep the company running across three jurisdictions.

You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, get into the detail, and own real work from week one. Nothing here is theoretical.

If you want breadth rather than a narrow slice, and you'd rather build processes than inherit them, this is your opportunity.

💪 About your mission

  • Finance operations: Support day-to-day finance: client billing, supplier payments, cash management and financial documents.

  • Reporting & analysis: Contribute to monthly reporting (P&L and cash), to management reports commenting on business performance, and to KPI tracking for board and investor reporting.

  • Planning: Support budgeting and forecasting.

  • People operations: Contribute to the employee lifecycle: onboarding, offboarding, HR documents and employee records.

  • Legal and contracts: Help prepare and track contracts and corporate documents.

  • Be the first answer: Act as the first line of response for the team's day-to-day administrative questions.

  • Build, don't just maintain: Formalise and improve our processes and tools so they scale with the company.

  • Ad hoc projects: Support the team on both one-off and strategic topics.

We're looking for someone who wants to understand how a company actually works, not just one function of it. If you're excited to learn fast, take ownership early, and build something that outlasts your internship, we'd love to hear from you.

🔭 Our vision

Give human resources more-than-human powers.

🎯 Our mission

Build the conversational AI agent that liberates HR teams, advances organizations, and expands human potential.

🎨 Our values

We are still very young and our culture is evolving as we grow together. Nonetheless, below are values we identify ourselves with:

  • Play to Win - Our ambition is limitless. We relentlessly aim for the top, pushing forward to be number one.

  • Push the Boundaries - Innovation drives us. We adapt, evolve, and set new standards to redefine what's possible.

  • Trust is Earned - Trust is our foundation. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of transparency, security, and responsibility.

  • Embrace Intensity - Speed and precision define our approach. We execute with urgency, focus, and purpose to create immediate, tangible impact.

  • Stronger Together - We succeed as one. Collaboration, shared purpose, and collective ownership are at the heart of our progress.

Preferred experience

🧑‍🔧 What we are looking for

  • A Master's student (M1 or M2) looking for a 6-month internship from January 2027, as a gap year or end-of-studies internship.

  • Bilingual in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Rigorous by instinct: you notice when a number doesn't tie, and you care enough to find out why.

  • Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets: formulas, pivot tables, handling messy data without panicking.

  • Discreet: you will handle confidential data every day.

  • Autonomous: the team is small, so you'll be trusted early and asked to figure things out.

  • Curious about how companies are built, not just how spreadsheets work.

  • Prior exposure to finance, audit or accounting is a plus, not a requirement.

A note on diversity @MakiPeople

"Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles."

🌱 Your progression with us

  • Learn from someone who built it: You'll be mentored one-to-one by the person who set up our finance and operations function, not rotated through a large team.

  • Make a real impact: In a team of two, there is no busywork. What you produce is what the company runs on.

  • Build a rare skill set: Few interns get exposure to finance and operations across three jurisdictions at once.

💝 What we offer

  • A 6-month internship starting January 2027, based in Paris

  • Flexible working arrangements, 1 to 2 days of remote work per week

  • Meal vouchers

  • Supportive, ambitious, and fast-paced culture

  • Team socials (weekly lunch, quarterly seminars)

Recruitment process

  • Step 1: A short screening call on Maki 📞

  • Step 2: Online assessments 📝

  • Step 3: An interview and case study with your future manager 💻

  • Step 4: A final interview with one of our co-founders ☕

  • Step 5: Your offer 💌

  • Step 6: Your onboarding 🧑‍🎓

title: Financial Analyst
descriptionHtml:
🏷️ Title: Financial Analyst

👫 Department: Analytics. Reporting to the Head of Analytics, working closely with our Co-Founder & CEO

💰 Salary: £60,000 - £80,000 + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here.

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering.

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays.

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future.

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week.

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK.

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Care providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

Lottie is growing fast. Care providers want what we're building, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. We need someone to get under the skin of the numbers, understand what's driving our success, and turn that into the plans, budgets and decisions that shape where we go next.

That's where you come in. You'll be the technical, commercially minded person at our CEO's side - writing the SQL, building the models and bringing the numbers that shape our biggest decisions. No middle man between the founder and the data: you go to the source yourself, work it out from first principles, turn it into a clear recommendation and then help make it happen.

With 2027 set to be Lottie’s most ambitious year yet, you'll own business planning and budgets, support investor relations and future M&A, and partner with teams across Lottie, including our commercial and marketing teams, to help them hit their goals. No FP&A title or accountancy qualification needed - a strong data or commercial background with real modelling depth is enough.

  • You are genuinely technical - you write your own SQL, work in git, are comfortable in Python and build financial models from scratch.

About the Team

The Flight Test organization is a mission-focused, flat, and highly collaborative multinational team that serves as the critical bridge between engineering labs and real-world deployment. Working directly alongside software and hardware engineering, the team runs high-tempo flight campaigns globally to rapidly iterate, validate, and field STARK’s advanced autonomous platforms.

Your Mission

As a Flight Test Engineer, depending on your experience, you will be responsible for the planning, execution, and analysis of flight tests for experimental fixed-wing UAV platforms. You will work closely with the experimental R&D team to conduct flight research or validate system performance and contribute to the next generation of our autonomous flight technologies.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on building the next generation of autonomous capabilities by leveraging existing Anduril platforms like Ghost or Altius, bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril's Lattice ecosystem, and developing breakthrough systems that will shape the future of the battlefield. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

Omen is Anduril's hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

This role is part of the new Omen flight test team in the UAE. The team runs Omen ground and flight testing in the UAE alongside our U.S. flight test team, using the same aircraft configuration, procedures and test plans, and works closely with our UAE partners.

About The Job

As a UAS Flight Test Engineer you will plan, execute and report on developmental and operational flight Test & Evaluation (T&E) activities. You will work alongside a team of engineers and test specialists assisting in the wider management and coordination of test and evaluation within the US, UK and Europein the UAE and the US under both civil and military approval schemes.

You will report to the Omen Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (SEIT) Lead in the UAE, work closely with the Omen SEIT Lead in the U.S., and support the Test Director during test activities.

You will be based in Abu Dhabi and travel regularly within the UAE, mainly to our remote test range (long days and early starts, with overnight stays when needed). Before flight testing starts in the UAE, you will spend an extended period in the United States (expected to be several months) training with the Omen flight test team at our Costa Mesa headquarters and U.S. test sites during the first prototype flight campaign. Expect further U.S. trips after that.

UAE nationals are encouraged to apply.

title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Tangible Markets builds secondary-transaction infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are banks, fund administrators, and secondaries teams whose workflows are technical, regulated, and specific. You sit between them and our product engineering.

The role blends solutions engineering with customer success, plus real engineering work. You lead technical discussions with clients, shape how the platform fits their workflow, own their success after go-live, and help build configurations and integrations that close the gap. You are not embedded on client sites full-time, and this is not a pure relationship role either. Most weeks split between client-facing work and hands-on technical work.

Full-time · Remote (European time zones preferred)

Tasks

Client-facing (roughly half the role)

  • Run technical discussions during onboarding: architecture reviews, security questionnaires, SSO and data-flow conversations with client IT teams
  • Translate client workflow requirements into product terms, and product capabilities into client terms
  • Own accounts after go-live: adoption, expansion, the quarterly “how is this actually going” conversation
  • Be the trusted technical contact when something breaks or a new requirement lands

Product and engineering (the other half)

  • Help build client-specific configuration, integrations, and glue code (SSO, data mappings, API integrations, etc.)
  • Turn recurring client asks into structured product requirements and argue for them with the product team
  • Prototype solutions fast, validate them with the client, then hand the generalizable parts to the engineering team
  • Write the runbooks and docs that make each client’s setup maintainable by someone other than you

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a technical role with client exposure: solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, or product engineering with heavy customer contact.
  • You can read and write production code: You don’t need to be the strongest or only engineer on the team, but “I’ll build it” has to be a real option, not a handoff.
  • You can hold a room: an SSO deep-dive with a bank’s IT security team in the morning, a product feedback session in the afternoon.
  • Financial services background, or evidence you absorb regulated domains fast.
  • You write clearly: Requirement docs, runbooks, and follow-up emails carry most of this job’s leverage.
  • Judgment about what to build, what to configure, and what to push back on.

Nice to have:

  • Anything fintech, especially on the vendor for banks (or other fintechs) side.
  • Prior work at an early-stage B2B company where you wore several hats.
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance processes (vendor due diligence, DORA, GDPR).

What this role is not:

  • Not pre-sales quota-carrying. You join conversations for technical depth, not to close.
  • Not full-time on-site embedding. Client contact is regular but structured: calls, workshops.
  • Not a support queue. You own outcomes for accounts, not tickets.

Why this role matters:

Enterprise clients in private markets churn because nobody on the vendor side understood their workflow well enough to make the platform fit. This role exists so that someone does, and so that what they learn changes the product.

Process:

  1. 30-minute intro call
  2. Technical conversation around a real (anonymized) client scenario
  3. Working session: scope a solution and present it back
  4. Conversation with the founders

title: Founding Account Executive – Poland
descriptionHtml:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Poland for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Poland is one of our expansion markets. It has become one of Europe’s major manufacturing hubs, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Poland from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Poland.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Poland from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Poland end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Polish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English. Polish is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. title: Founding Optimization Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founding Optimization Engineer

Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape the optimization architecture on a greenfield: custom algorithms, heuristics, OR and simulation, fast C++ with Python on top. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The algorithmic core: Design how planqor.ai represents, propagates and optimizes schedules, resources and constraints, and how it repairs them when disruptions hit.

  • Performance: Make it fast. Profile and optimize the C++ core and expose it cleanly.

  • Evidence: Build the benchmarks, instances and experiments that show what actually works and where it fails.

  • The path to production: Work with our systems engineer to turn algorithms into decisions planners trust.

  • The team: Grow into leading optimization at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our goal is not to build the most impressive optimization algorithm on paper. It is to build decision systems that remain useful when the real world changes. A strong solution that can be updated, repaired and explained quickly beats closing the last optimality gap on a static model.

So we are neither a solver wrapper nor a research lab. We use whatever works (MIP, CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, learning or something purpose-built) and let the evidence decide.

Generative AI makes this loop dramatically faster. We use it to implement ideas, explore alternatives and evolve algorithms against our benchmarks. But speed only counts if the methodology holds: representative data, adversarial tests, meaningful metrics, rigorous validation.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong modern C++ and performance engineering. You are comfortable building performance-critical algorithms, profiling them, choosing appropriate data structures, and reasoning about runtime, memory, and scalability.

  • Real experience solving optimization problems. This may come from Operations Research, combinatorial optimization, scheduling, MIP/CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, optimization under uncertainty, or related fields. You do not need to be an expert in all of them. Big plus for Sequential Decision Analytics.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual models and algorithms: how state is represented, how changes propagate, how components interact, and how the complete decision system behaves under real-world disruptions.

  • Python for experimentation and data analysis. You can build benchmark pipelines, analyze data, visualize results, and quickly investigate why an approach succeeds or fails.

  • Empirical engineering judgment. You design experiments, challenge assumptions, measure performance, and abandon approaches when the evidence says they are wrong.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

What you'll get

  • Ownership: shape the optimization architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the optimization team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in backend and product? Check out our Founding Full-Stack Engineer role.

title: Front End Developer
descriptionHtml:
Remote Front End Developer

About SchemeServe

For 26 years, SchemeServe has helped transform insurance products into successful, profitable solutions.

We’re always looking for new ways to innovate and improve. We strive to challenge industry norms and bring a unique personality to our work.

In a nutshell, SchemeServe is a UK-based Insurance SaaS solution specialising in services for starting, managing, and growing traditional (and specialist) insurance products. It was started in 2000 by our CEO and Founder, Adam, and the software now represents the leading edge in super-fast scheme deployment and truly Obsessive Support ™.

We’re fully remote, but we get together twice a year for some not-so-serious, and teeny tiny bit of serious, time together. We value self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and take on new challenges. To help with this, we offer learning budgets for courses, books, and workshops.

Since we’re remote, we don’t offer free snacks or bean bags, but we do provide flexible work arrangements, a healthy work-life balance, and a friendly company culture. Every Thursday, we have 'Elevenses,' where anyone can join a video call to catch up, share stories, or play games. It helps us stay connected.

About the role

Enjoy the freedom of remote work while playing a key role in shaping the tools that thousands of brokers and insurers rely on. By enhancing our front-end, you'll improve user interfaces that empower professionals to manage schemes more efficiently and provide excellent service to their clients, all from the comfort of your home.

If you're a passionate Front-end Developer in the UK who knows React.js and modern front-end tools, this opportunity could be an excellent fit for you.

We’re looking for someone ready to jump in and focus on building user interfaces as part of one of our product teams. Within 6 to 12 months, you’ll help build and modernise core parts of SchemeServe, significantly enhancing our clients' workflow and efficiency. You’ll use React.js, TypeScript, and CSS (including Tailwind CSS) to create reliable, maintainable products. If you’ve done this before and enjoy it, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll primarily work with a product team in an agile manner, which includes back-end and QA engineers, as well as UX designers, a product manager, and an engineering manager. Sometimes, you may also join other front-end projects, so strong communication and people skills are essential.

Front-End Developer Responsibilities:

  • Developing new and existing features/ interfaces to enhance the user experience.
  • Building reusable components and front-end libraries for future use.
  • Translating designs and wireframes into high-quality code.
  • Optimising components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers.
  • Maximise pages for speed and scalability.
  • Accurately translate user and business needs into functional frontend code.
  • Liaising with internal & external stakeholders through the life cycle of each project.
  • Maintaining brand consistency throughout the implementation of designs.


Front-End Developer Requirements:

  • UK-based: Your presence in the UK helps with tax and data rules, ensuring smooth operations and compliance.
  • 6+ years of experience in front-end development.
  • 3+ years of experience using React.
  • Understanding of key design principles.
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
  • Good problem-solving skills demonstrated by delivering solutions to complex challenges.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills to collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Good interpersonal skills to foster a positive team environment.
  • Experience working in an agile development process.
  • Be open to feedback and constructive criticism, and be happy to work collaboratively to improve.


Interview Process

Experience an interview process designed with collaboration and appreciation at its core. This is your opportunity to showcase how your skills align with what we need, in an environment of mutual respect and partnership.

You’ll initially meet your potential future manager along with the Principal of Frontend in a 30-60 minute cultural interview, where both parties can discuss values and work styles openly.

We offer a short take-home tech test that allows you to demonstrate your coding skills. This is your chance to present your thought process, leading into a tech interview where we explore your solutions collaboratively.

Finally, during an hour-long tech interview, we take a deeper dive into your technical expertise. This session is an exploration of your approach and how it fits with our technological challenge.

Note for recruiters

We are not currently accepting any candidates from recruiters with whom we do not already have a working agreement.

You are welcome to send an email if you really want, but it will be ignored :-)
