title: Functioneel Applicatie Beheerder Backend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder

32–38 uur | Assen | Hybride werken

Als ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat bedrijfskritische applicaties betrouwbaar functioneren én help je ons om het beheer verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de ruimte om verbeteringen te signaleren, initiatief te nemen en samen met collega's daadwerkelijk veranderingen door te voeren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en externe leveranciers.

Je werkt met verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties, zoals AFAS, AXON en CODA, en zorgt ervoor dat deze goed aansluiten op de processen en behoeften van onze organisatie.

Je houdt je bezig met het dagelijkse beheer, maar kijkt ook continu naar mogelijkheden om onze applicaties, dienstverlening en beheerprocessen te verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Applicaties betrouwbaar laat functioneren. Je beheert verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties, ondersteunt gebruikers en zorgt ervoor dat incidenten en verstoringen effectief worden opgelost.

  • Complexe vraagstukken analyseert. Je onderzoekt waar problemen ontstaan, bijvoorbeeld in een applicatie, koppeling of bedrijfsproces, en schakelt met de juiste specialisten of leveranciers.

  • Verbeteringen initieert en realiseert. Je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over structurele oplossingen en helpt om applicaties en processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten.

  • Het beheer verder professionaliseert. Je draagt bij aan duidelijke beheerafspraken, goed ingerichte processen, heldere verantwoordelijkheden en goede documentatie.

  • Meewerkt aan veranderingen. Je bent betrokken bij wijzigingen, testen, releases, migraties en de ingebruikname van nieuwe of aangepaste functionaliteiten.

  • De verbinding legt tussen business en IT. Je begrijpt wat gebruikers nodig hebben en vertaalt hun vragen naar passende oplossingen, in samenwerking met collega's en leveranciers.

Daarbij heb je oog voor onderwerpen als informatiebeveiliging, autorisaties, continuïteit en compliance.

Meer dan dagelijks beheer

Wat deze functie interessant maakt, is dat je niet alleen verantwoordelijk bent voor het goed functioneren van applicaties, maar ook bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze beheerorganisatie.

We willen ons functioneel beheer steeds slimmer, duidelijker en professioneler organiseren. Denk aan het verbeteren van werkprocessen, het versterken van samenwerking en het creëren van meer overzicht en eigenaarschap.

Jouw ervaring, ideeën en initiatief zijn daarbij van waarde.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een ervaren Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder die graag begrijpt hoe systemen, processen en mensen met elkaar samenhangen.

Je houdt van structuur, maar weet ook flexibel om te gaan met veranderingen. Wanneer een gebruiker aangeeft dat iets niet werkt, neem jij geen genoegen met een snelle oplossing. Je wilt begrijpen wat er aan de hand is en hoe je kunt voorkomen dat hetzelfde probleem opnieuw ontstaat.

Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende mensen, van eindgebruikers tot technische specialisten en leveranciers.

Verder herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO-werk- en -denkniveau hebt richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of informatiemanagement;

  • Je begrijpt bedrijfsprocessen en kunt goed analyseren hoe applicaties deze processen ondersteunen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het afhandelen van incidenten, wijzigingen en gebruikersvragen en weet hierin overzicht en structuur aan te brengen.

  • Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met verschillende stakeholders en leveranciers en weet mensen met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Zorgvuldig omgaat met onderwerpen als autorisaties, documentatie, compliance, continuïteit en beheerafspraken;

  • Communicatief sterk bent en complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk kunt maken voor gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Proactief verbeteringen signaleert en eigenaarschap toont.E

Ervaring met ITIL, Agile werken, SLA, P1 processen of onderwerpen zoals autorisatiebeheer en compliance. Hetzelfde geldt voor ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, platformdiensten of identity- en accessmanagement.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je gaat aan de slag binnen Univé IT Kern, waar verschillende teams samenwerken aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van ons IT-landschap. Binnen IT Kern werken we aan applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen die essentieel zijn voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een omgeving waarin techniek, processen en mensen samenkomen. Je werkt met collega's die graag kennis delen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze IT-dienstverlening betrouwbaar blijft en tegelijkertijd klaar is voor de toekomst.

Binnen het Backend Platform ligt de nadruk op het beheren en verbeteren van bedrijfsapplicaties en ondersteunende IT-diensten.

Je krijgt te maken met verschillende gebruikers, IT-teams en leveranciers. Dat maakt je werk veelzijdig en vraagt om zowel technische affiniteit als gevoel voor de organisatie.

title: GenAI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Iedereen kan een prompt schrijven. Een AI-oplossing bouwen waar een organisatie echt op durft te vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) maak jij het verschil tussen een interessante demo en een oplossing die elke dag werkt in een echt proces. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker.

De uitdaging

Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM.

Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt.

Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken.

Je plek

Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op.

Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken.

Lees hier meer over de AI squad.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen.

  • Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering.

  • Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy.

  • Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework.

  • Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen.

  • Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen.

  • Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering.

  • Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar ben je wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  1. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben.

  1. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  1. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen over deze rol? Neem contact op met Raoel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT

title: General Counsel at amo
descriptionHtml:
amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump and Sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

The role:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

How we think about legal:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write.

  • Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe.

  • Pragmatic on risk: you know which rules are non-negotiable, where there is room for judgement, and how much risk is worth taking for the business. You give a recommendation, not a list of risks.

  • Built for scale: you set up the contracts, policies and processes that enable our growth.

What you'll own:

You'll cover every legal question that comes with scaling a consumer app across markets, working with the right local counsel on each topic:

  • Corporate: general corporate, group structure as we expand internationally, BSPCE plans and employee liquidity operations.

  • Employment: French labour law across the employee lifecycle, from contracts, immigration and internal rules to terminations.

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

title: Growth Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs - vom Suchen über das Kaufen bis zum Finanzieren. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und verwandeln sie in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen hands-on, datengetriebenen Growth Engineer, der als erste Person die technische Basis für unser Brokerage-Geschäft baut. Du verbindest unsere Verwaltungsdaten aus über 70.000 Einheiten mit CRM, Outreach-Tools und KI und baust daraus ein System, das automatisch erkennt, welche Eigentümer verkaufen wollen. Dadurch kommen wir gezielt mit verkaufswilligen Eigentümern ins Gespräch und können qualifizierte Leads an unsere Makler übermitteln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Inside-Sales-Team sowie dem Leadership-Team zusammen und baust Brokerage zu einem eigenen, profitablen Geschäftsfeld aus. Brokerage ist bei Buena noch ein kleines Geschäftsfeld, mit dir soll daraus ein Multi-Millionen-Geschäft werden.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Signal-Engine bauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

  • Outreach automatisieren: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

  • Funnel messbar machen: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat und trackst Kosten pro Lead sowie Conversion.

  • Experimente fahren: Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst und misst es sauber.

Du passt, wenn du

  • Hands-on Erfahrung als GTM Engineer, in Growth oder RevOps mitbringst und Systeme selbst gebaut hast.

  • Schon einmal etwas von null aufgebaut hast, etwa als Gründer, Geschäftsführer oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase.

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise hast, also Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

  • Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) beherrschst. Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Deine Benefits

  • Top-Vergütung inklusive VSOPs.

  • Bis zu 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros im Prenzlauer Berg.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat.

  • 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du baust unsere Akquise-Engine von null auf. Was du in den ersten Monaten aufsetzt, wird zur Grundlage des ganzen Geschäftsfelds. Wenn es funktioniert, skalierst du es selbst weiter und deine Rolle wächst mit.

  • Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt aufs Geschäft. Du hast Zugriff auf Daten aus unserem Verwaltungsbestand, die sonst niemand hat und arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen: Jedes Signal, das funktioniert, wird zu messbarem Umsatz im Brokerage.

  • Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitenden im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

title: GTM Experience Manager (Field & Event Marketing)
descriptionHtml:
lemlist is the outbound platform for sales teams: find leads, run multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls), personalize with AI and book meetings.

We're at +$60M ARR, growing ~50% year over year, profitable and 100% bootstrapped, with 180 people.

lemlist is moving upmarket. We’re hiring a GTM Experience Manager to build our field marketing channel from scratch: bring in bigger deals and help our strategic customers stay and grow with us.

You’ll get the right people in the room and make it worth their time, with speakers they want to hear from, topics they care about and experiences they’ll tell others about. We want people talking about lemlist, and Sales walking away with real opportunities.

You’ll decide which conferences are worth investing in, what to build with partners and which events we should run ourselves. You’ll own the budget and make it happen, working closely with Marketing, Partnerships and Sales.

The scope is worldwide, with a focus on Europe and our Paris HQ as the home base for our own events.
It includes events for lemlist but also for claap, the sales intelligence platform we bought one year ago (same target audience).

What your impact will look like

Within 3 months, you’ll have:

  • Drafted our field strategy for lemlist: audience, objectives & how to reach them through events & strong sales/partners collaboration

  • Identify, negotiate & start action plan for 2 must-attend paid Events for lemlist

  • Design & organise 2 events with our most strategic partners and generate good pipeline out of it (that would make us breakeven if we have the usual ASP & CVR)

  • Built a clear operating model with Sales for pre-event outreach, rep selection, on-site activation and follow-up

  • Started creating one owned event format that can become recognizable lemlist franchise (eg. GTM monthly breakfasts…)

  • Organise at least one workshop for one of our strategic account/customer (at our or their HQ)

Within 12 months, you’ll have:

  • Generated 2M$ pipeline out of events, paid or owned - and are breakeven overall (total events OPEX spending < ARR signed and influenced)

  • Made lemlist events a must-be place for our ecosystem and audience

  • Run regular workshops for our top customers with CSMs, our Product leaders and/or our CEO, driving measurable adoption and upsell, and producing a steady flow of customer storiesz

  • Become the internal expert on the GTM event ecosystem (paid & partners): you know all the relevant events globally, who attends them, which ones are emerging and which ones are declining

  • Built a clear investment strategy across sponsored events & owned events with a strong point of view on where we spend and why

  • Build strong relationships with our key partners & some GTM communities, thanks to successful events

  • Built a measurement framework that lets us understand ROI: meetings, pipeline, revenue, brand impact, etc.

  • Built a repeatable playbook for selecting and activating the right Sales reps at each event so we maximise impact before, during and after

  • Bonus project: launch the lemlist swag store and build a rewards program to engage prospects, celebrate users and strengthen partner relationships.

What you’ll do concretely

You’ll manage two main types of events:

  • Sponsored events:

    • third-party conferences and trade shows.

    • You’ll build lemlist’s presence through booths, speaking opportunities and creative activations (eg. lemlist @ VivaTech)

    • …sometimes by creating our own event around a major industry moment.

  • lemlist events:

    • experiences organised by lemlist for prospects, customers or both.

    • Meetups at our HQ, the lemhouse in Avignon, executive dinners, IRL workshops in coffees or any venue of your choice.

    • Webinars with our team, partners a/o users, for our prospects & clients

    • You may run them independently or with some of our partners.
      → Recent examples: Event for a client at our HQ ; Hackathon with Clay and HubSpot.

Curate the right events and partners

  • Spot the difference between an outdated tradeshow that won’t attract our buyers anymore and the next place our audience will actually want to be (eg. recent AI / GTM trendy events)

  • For sponsored events, evaluate sponsorship opportunities based on audience quality, pipeline potential and brand impact. Assess audience & sponsor list (competition can be a good sign), ask feedback to operators that have been there.

  • Negotiate sponsorship packages to secure the best value, visibility and booth location. There is ALWAYS room to negotiate.

  • Proactively identify the right partners to build events with, and know when to push back on opportunities that are not worth our time.

Create content people want to show up for

  • Find and convince great speakers to join us for our events. Including customers, sales leaders, operators and partners.

  • Define sharp themes and angles that reflect what our audience genuinely cares about.

  • Oversee the creation of agendas, talks, workshop programs and speaker materials, with support from the wider Marketing team.

Deliver memorable experiences

  • Own every event from idea to execution, ensuring a smooth experience for attendees, speakers, partners and the lemlist team.

  • Manage vendors and logistics, including venues, catering, booth production, room setup, equipment and travel, with support from our Office Manager for in-house events.

  • Design experiences people remember, whether through a creative booth activation, an unexpected format or standout branding.

  • Stay calm when plans change at the last minute. Because they will.

Turn events & content into pipeline

  • Work closely with our French and EMEA Sales teams to define the audience, targets and pipeline objectives for our events.

  • With our sales leads, select and organise (in advance!) the right lemlist reps for each event.

  • Get Sales moving before the event: activating their networks, booking meetings and running targeted outreach.

  • Own the follow-up plan after the event so conversations turn into real opportunities

Own the budget and performance

  • Own a €300K annual budget covering field marketing activities.

  • Track sourced and influenced pipeline, meetings, opportunities and conversion rates, then share clear post-event learnings.

About you

  • B2B SaaS native: you know the European Sales and GTM ecosystem, its key players, communities and events.

  • Passionate about Sales: ideally, you’ve worked in Sales yourself and instinctively know which topics, angles and formats will resonate with our audience.

  • Performance-driven: you can own a budget and prove its impact. You think in meetings, opportunities, pipeline and revenue.

  • Hands-on: you can build a European strategy one day and fix a missing microphone the next. Neither is beneath you.

  • Strong editorial instinct: you understand Sales and know why people show up, what they’ll remember and what they’ll tell others about.

  • Great with people: you know how to get Sales reps, speakers, partners and vendors moving in the same direction.

  • Highly organised: you can run several events at once and stay calm when something inevitably goes wrong.

  • A fierce negotiator: you negotiate hard, spend carefully and never accept the first sponsorship package.

  • Fluent in English (French is a plus)

Bonus points

  • You’ve created an event or activation people were still talking about months later.

How to apply & recruitment process

How to apply: send us your LinkedIn and one event or activation you've built that you're proud of (links, photos, results: attendance, meetings, pipeline).
No concrete example, no review.

  1. Screening call (30 min)

  2. Business case (async) + live debrief (45 min)

  3. Culture fit with the team

  4. CEO interview

  5. Reference check

  6. Offer

title: Head of AI (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM 
Stark's engineering team is a rapidly growing, agile group dedicated to developing high-performance, software-defined, and mass-scalable autonomous systems across air, sea, and command software domains. Operating in a fast-paced environment, the team combines elite engineering talent with an AI-native operational culture to solve complex design challenges, push hardware boundaries, and deliver field-tested defense capabilities

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will define and own STARK's AI strategy, across the product, across internal tooling, and across the entire technical organisation. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Chief Engineers and Engineering Leads, setting a direction they can execute against.

On the product side, you'll push the boundaries of what's possible in sensing, autonomy, and robotics for defence. On the internal side, you'll systematically drive AI-powered productivity across every function at STARK. And beyond the company, you'll be our most visible and credible AI voice; the signal that serious AI talent picks up when deciding where to build next.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Define and own STARK's AI strategy across product and internal domains, setting a direction that Technical Leads can execute against
  • Lead AI stack decisions, model selection, frameworks, MLOps infrastructure, evaluation, and tooling, in partnership with the CTO and Technical Leads, with final technical accountability sitting with you
  • Act as connective tissue across teams: identify and resolve cross-team AI dependencies, shared infrastructure gaps, and redundant workstreams that individual leads cannot see from inside their own domain
  • Drive internal AI adoption across STARK, developer productivity tooling, agent and automation infrastructure, and responsible-use frameworks across engineering and operations
  • Provide technical oversight and challenge across all AI workstreams, asking hard questions on methodology, adversarial robustness, distribution shift, and performance under real operational conditions, without taking over delivery
  • Monitor the academic and commercial AI landscape and translate relevant advances into concrete strategic inputs for the CTO and programme leadership
  • Keep AI strategy grounded in operational reality by partnering with programme and product leadership so that what we build maps to real mission requirements, not research for its own sake
  • Raise the AI bar at STARK: contribute to senior technical hiring, define the AI engineering standard, and build STARK's standing in the European defence-AI community
  • Represent STARK externally, speak at defence, robotics, and AI venues, publish or present where it serves the mission, and act as a credible signal of the company's technical ambition

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or a closely related field, or demonstrably equivalent depth through industry research and an open publication or open-source record
  • Proven experience setting AI technical strategy at a senior level, across multiple domains simultaneously, not within a single team or project
  • Deep technical fluency in at least one of: perception and sensor fusion, autonomy and motion planning, SLAM/localisation, or multi-agent coordination (C2), with enough breadth to engage credibly across all of them
  • Strong track record of influencing technical decisions without direct line authority, working through and alongside Technical Leads, not over them
  • Experience in defence, aerospace, or another safety-critical domain where AI system failure carries real-world consequence; direct UAS or ground-robotics experience strongly preferred
  • Fluent English; working German is a practical advantage in Berlin or Munich
  • Eligibility for the required security clearance

NICE TO HAVE

  • An existing network within the European defence AI community
  • Prior experience in a staff- or principal-level AI role inside a scaling deep-tech or defence company
  • A public profile, talks, papers, or open-source work, that already signals technical credibility
  • Comfort operating in a high-autonomy, low-overhead role: setting direction and shaping outcomes without a large dedicated team

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

  • Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

  • Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

  • Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

  • Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

  • Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

  • Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

  • Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

How We Work in Solutions

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them
  • Lead the AI-driven transformation of the entire finance function, from planning and controlling to accounting and reporting, with clear governance and review steps.

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Proven experience in designing and running AI-supported finance processes across a full finance function, including integration with ERP and finance systems, controls and data protection (GDPR), and measurable impact.
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English is required (C1 or above), as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.
Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Team mission

The Internal Controls team acts as a strategic partner to the business, designing effective, automated controls and streamlined operations rather than policies that ask someone to remember a step. The Internal Controls sits within Finance and acts as the second line of defense in GetYourGuide's Three Lines Model, and collaborates with stakeholders across the organization.  You will build and run GetYourGuide's internal control over financial reporting (ICOFR) program from the ground up to reach a steady evidenced operating cadence.

title: Head of Partnerships (AI & Biotech)
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Adaptyv is the company best positioned to become the verification layer for biology, and long-term partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs are how we get there.

You find the partners where Adaptyv can become core infrastructure. You shape the terms, and you run the deal: scientific scope, pricing, legal, and the internal plan to deliver it. You also design new partnership models and the deals that do not fit a standard quote.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the largest deals. Source, structure and close strategic partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs.

  • Set the terms. Pricing, data rights, exclusivity, milestones. You find structures where both sides win.

  • Align the company behind each deal. The lab, the scientists and engineering deliver what you sign, so you bring them in early.

What We're Looking For

  • Deal-maker with a track record. You have closed complex, high-value deals in life sciences, AI or deep tech. Biopharma BD, corporate development or partnerships experience is ideal. We will also bet on rising talent.

  • Credible with scientists. You can follow a discussion about binding data and assay design, and you know when to bring in the expert.

  • High agency. Nobody hands you a pipeline. You build it, and you own the outcome.

  • AI-native. It's 2026: you use Claude and similar tools every day for research, modeling and drafting, and you check what they produce.

  • Low ego, high EQ. Partners trust you, and so does the team.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Implementation lead
descriptionHtml:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We’re looking for a customer-focused problem solver to join our Implementation team. You’ll lead end-to-end deployments of Watershed for our largest and most complex strategic accounts - translating goals into clear plans, finding solutions to customer needs, orchestrating cross-functional work, and building customer confidence.

You’ll design scalable systems and processes for repeatability while also solving complex, bespoke needs for our largest customers. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, advisory, customer success, and external partners to keep momentum high and outcomes measurable. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role driving the success of Watershed’s customer base.

 

You will:

  • Own and deliver implementations from kickoff to wrap-up: run discovery, map milestones, manage risks, and drive crisp execution

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact during implementations, building high‑trust relationships across technical and non‑technical stakeholders

  • Design out-of-the-box, creative solutions that meet customer needs, leveraging existing product and services and generating insight into potential future needs

  • Develop a deep understanding of Watershed’s product and services to guide customers on what’s possible and make smart trade‑offs

  • Conduct enablements for customers on using complex Watershed features

  • Coordinate internal and customer teams, sequence dependencies, and renegotiate timelines when inputs change

  • Act as the voice of the customer to product and engineering, surfacing patterns, blockers, and feature requests that inform the roadmap

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and processes that make implementations faster, more consistent, and measurable over time

 

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 3-6+ years in management consulting, solutions, or software implementation, preferably at a B2B SaaS company. You have experience leading customers through complex programs or projects

  • Take pride in your ability to learn new concepts quickly and thrive operating in a high-volume environment

  • Love to sweat the details, but are also able to zoom-out and see the big picture

  • Are a systems thinker who brings structure, clarity, and momentum to ambiguous problems

  • Are excellent at communicating clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences to introduce new concepts and drive alignment

  • Love working on multiple workstreams simultaneously, juggling multiple balls and keeping stakeholders accountable

  • Have a keen eye for identifying risks and drive mitigation plans to keep projects on track

  • Are an early adopter of AI solutions and excited to use them to drive impact

 

This position is required to be in person in our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

Ihre Fachkenntnisse und Ihr technisches Know-how sind entscheidend, um innovative Lösungen im Prüfprozess voranzutreiben.

Aufgaben

Benefits

title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
descriptionHtml:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié.
  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

      • Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min)
      • Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min)
      • Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter
      • Rencontre avec les équipes
      • 2 prises de références
      • Offre

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues.

title: Integration Engineer, ERP
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, documentation and driving improvements to ensure market fit, reliability and efficient installation.

  • Enable technical project managers and integration specialists to consult on, install and configure existing integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go fast, that works for us.

  • Hands-on integration experience with at least one ERP system (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS, ABAS or similar), ideally more than one. You have built or maintained native interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience writing production code in Go.

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in ERP systems: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Experience with both cloud and on-premise ERP environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access or API rate limits in cloud ERPs).

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: We have an office in Zurich, London, Munich and Cologne, hybrid with 3+ office days per week in those locations or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

title: [Interim] Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office)
descriptionHtml:
(Interim) Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office)

Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start

Riverflex is supporting technology leaders at major retailers through a number of strategic engagements, and we are looking for experienced strategy consultants to join our team on an interim basis. You work as part of a Riverflex team alongside our in-house consultants, reporting to a member of our leadership team. You help CTOs shape how their technology organisations run, decide and deliver.

Current and upcoming opportunities include:

  • Supporting a CTO following the merger of regional technology departments into one. The work covers how the leadership team should operate and how to set up a CTO office that delivers on their ambitions.

  • Partner with CTO-1 leadership to shape, document and drive the convergence plan following the merger of regional technology departments.

  • Establishing an AI-enabled CTO office. This means rethinking processes and ways of working, and using AI solutions to make the office more effective.

  • Acting as strategic thinking partner to a CTO. This means answering key technology questions and preparing updates for the C-suite.

  • Supporting CTO to drive improvements and modernization of security and disaster recovery strategy.

  • Support a large-scale, multi-country data transformation by setting up an EU-level DMO and governance model that aligns priorities, decision-making and delivery across regions.

You bring top-tier consulting training and sharp problem-solving skills. You structure ambiguous questions, build the analysis and craft the storyline. You do this as part of a tight team, not as a solo act.

About Riverflex

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018, eventually growing into a global team of consultants united by a mission to help courageous leaders drive transformative change. Today, we offer an integrated service through three service pillars: strategy and transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating products that Augment Intelligence. For more information, visit www.riverflex.com.

Responsibilities

  • You break down strategic technology questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses and workplans

  • You help design technology operating models, including leadership team set-up, governance, CTO office structure, processes and ways of working

  • You run the analysis: fact-finding, stakeholder interviews, data gathering and synthesis into clear recommendations

  • You build executive-ready storylines and materials for CTO and C-suite audiences

  • You work within a Riverflex team, contributing ideas, structure and challenge, and taking direction from the engagement lead

  • You build trusted working relationships with senior client stakeholders across technology and the business

  • You get up to speed quickly and add value from week one

Job requirements

  • 8 - 10 years’ experience, including a strong grounding in strategy or technology consulting at an MBB or Big 4 firm

  • Proven experience on technology strategy, operating model or transformation work at senior level

  • Excellent structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking

  • Strong executive communication, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear C-suite narrative

  • A collaborative, low-ego working style and comfort working within a team led by Riverflex leadership

  • Availability to start immediately

  • Based in the Netherlands, or able to be on site regularly

  • Fluent English and EU work authorisation

The following are a plus for our different open opportunities:

  • Experience designing or setting up a CTO office, or integrating technology functions after a merger

  • Exposure to AI-enabled ways of working or process redesign

  • Expertise in Cyber Security and Disaster Recovery

Why this role

You work at CTO and C-suite level on questions that shape how major retailers run technology. You join an experienced Riverflex team from day one, with real input into the thinking and the outputs. With several engagements in flight, strong delivery opens the door to further work across our growing pipeline.

Apply now

Interested in this role? Submit your CV and a brief note on your relevant experience through the Riverflex website or reach out to our talent team directly.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, or disability.
