title: Onboard Software Engineer - Hyperdrive
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:

  • Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);

  • Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and

  • Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

Hyperdrive is the common platform powering every onboard service across our spacecraft.
The team builds the core capabilities other onboard services need to run mission logic—from interactions and housekeeping to events, automated fault detection and recovery, and lifecycle management.
By making complex spacecraft software consistent, observable, and resilient, Hyperdrive helps teams move faster while keeping missions safe in orbit.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.
About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 5+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., GitLab-CI, Jenkins).
  • Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Experience with library management and ABI/API version control.
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Online & Offline Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mit zahlreichen Studios deutschlandweit zählt FitnessKing zu den starken Marken im Fitnessbereich.
Seit vielen Jahren bewegt sich das Unternehmen mit mehreren Konzepten souverän unter den nationalen Marktführern.
Derzeit expandieren wir weiter und beschleunigen unser Wachstum, ohne dabei auf Kundenservice
und Qualität zu verzichten.

Für unsere Zentral-Verwaltung in Koblenz suchen wir zur Verstärkung unserer Marketingabteilung
ein kreativen Marketing Manager*in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit.

DEINE AUFGABEN

• Verantwortung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketing-Konzeptes
• Steuerung der Social-Media-Kanäle
• redaktionelle Konzeption, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung aller Online-Aktivitäten (Homepage, Newsletter, Blog, etc.)
• eigenverantwortliche Projektarbeit
• abteilungsübergreifende Öffentlichkeitsarbeit

DEINE QUALIFIKATION

• abgeschlossenes Studium / Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing/PR
• umfangreiches Marketing Know-how sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Kommunikation und PR
• mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
• sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Sozialen Medien
• hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit gepaart mit eigenverantwortlichem und ergebnisorientiertem Arbeiten
• sehr gute Fähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift, kreatives Schreiben erwünscht

UNSER ANGEBOT

Werde Teil eines werteorientierten, inhabergeführten Unternehmens!
Wir bieten dir einen krisen- und zukunftssicheren Arbeitsplatz sowie Gestaltungsspielraum für
eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, diese umzusetzen. Du erhältst die echte Chance Verantwortung zu übernehmen!
Wir bieten abwechslungsreiche, aber auch anspruchsvolle Aufgaben mit zahlreichen Herausforderungen.
Werde Teil unseres Erfolgs und nutze die Chance aktiv, an der Gestaltung teilzuhaben. Wir suchen Mitarbeiter/-innen,
die hoch motiviert sind, sich selbst und das Unternehmen FitnessKing weiterzuentwickeln.

KONTAKT
Wir freuen uns auf deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. deiner Motivation, warum gerade du genau die richtige Person für unser Team
und FitnessKing bist, Gehaltsvorstellung und Kontaktdaten) über den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite.

We’re committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and supportive environment where talented finance professionals can thrive, contribute their expertise and make a genuine impact.

Interested?

title: Partner Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re looking for a Partner Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team.

This is a brand new role and our first dedicated Partner Marketing hire, so we're looking for someone who has already planned and delivered successful B2B co-marketing campaigns with external partners and is excited by the opportunity to build a partner marketing programme from the ground up!

Partnerships are already an important part of how we reach and win enterprise customers. Now we want to build a proper marketing engine around them – identifying where the biggest opportunities are, creating brilliant joint propositions and campaigns, and turning our partner network into a measurable source of pipeline and growth.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Marketing Manager, you’ll work closely with Partnerships and Sales to decide where we invest, build compelling co-marketing plans and then get stuck into delivering them.

What you'll be busy doing:

  • Building and owning our partner marketing strategy, including how we tier and prioritise partners

  • Developing joint value propositions and co-marketing plans that resonate with our shared customers

  • Planning and delivering campaigns across content, email, social, events and webinars

  • Supporting partnership and integration launches with the plans, campaigns and assets needed to make them successful

  • Owning partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, tracking performance and using the results to decide where we invest

  • Creating co-branded content and partner enablement materials, including launch packs and customer case studies

  • Building strong relationships with our partners’ marketing teams and becoming their go-to marketing contact at Goodlord

  • Working closely with Sales, Partnerships and the wider Marketing team to turn great partner activity into commercial results

The role combines strategy with hands-on delivery, so you'll need to be just as happy working out what we should do and why as you are getting on and doing it!

ABOUT YOU

We're looking for someone with hands-on B2B partner, channel or alliance marketing experience, ideally in SaaS or tech, who has owned joint campaigns that generate leads and pipeline.

You’ll be commercially minded and comfortable talking about pipeline and revenue, not just campaigns and engagement.
You’ll understand that great partner marketing isn't about doing the same thing with every partner – it's about identifying where the opportunity is, creating something valuable for both sides and measuring whether it's working.

This role is likely for you if:

  • You’ve owned B2B partner or channel marketing campaigns end-to-end

  • You’re comfortable connecting marketing activity to pipeline and commercial outcomes

  • You understand how to assess and prioritise different partners and where to focus time and budget

  • You’ve worked closely with Sales and Partnerships teams

  • You’re comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on delivery

  • You’re confident building relationships with external partners and internal stakeholders

  • You’re proactive, curious and comfortable creating structure where there isn't already a playbook

Experience in proptech would be a bonus, as would experience building or scaling a partner marketing programme from the ground up.

This role is likely not for you if your experience is primarily generalist marketing, or if you've supported partner campaigns but haven't yet owned partner or channel marketing activity yourself. We need someone who brings genuine partner marketing experience and can connect that activity to commercial outcomes.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Partnerships Lead (UK&I)
descriptionHtml:
Who is Heidi?

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The Role

EHR and PMS integrations are a core strategic lever for Heidi, driving global revenue, expanding distribution, and improving clinician efficiency. As the UK&I Partnerships Lead, you’ll lead Heidi’s work with integration and ecosystem partners, helping us scale adoption through strong commercial and technical alignment.

You’ll be commercially sharp and technically curious - someone who can speak both business and product fluently. You know how to turn partnerships into pipelines, and integrations into impact.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead Heidi’s integration strategy and future strategic bets across UK&I.

  • Build and manage strategic partnerships with leading EMR, EHR, and PMS providers to extend Heidi’s reach and impact.

  • Prioritise integrations based on market reach, readiness, and customer impact, ensuring effort aligns with commercial value.

  • Oversee integration partnerships end-to-end - from technical scoping and onboarding to launch and enablement.

  • Activate integrations through co-GTM, referral, and reseller motions that translate into pipeline and adoption.

  • Negotiate partnership agreements that balance strategic alignment with clear commercial outcomes.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Growth to design integrations that are both technically robust and commercially scalable.

  • Build feedback loops and performance dashboards to track partner success, revenue contribution, and customer value.

What we will look for:

  • 4+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, or commercial roles - ideally in SaaS, healthtech, or platform ecosystems.

  • Proven success delivering growth through integration or ecosystem partnerships.

  • A strong grasp of B2B integration models, co-selling, or platform GTM strategies.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • A structured, strategic approach to prioritisation and execution.

  • A collaborative mindset - you thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy, product development, and customer success.

What do we believe in?

Heidi builds for the future of healthcare, not just the next quarter, and our goals are ambitious because the world’s health demands it. We believe in progress built through precision, pace, and ownership.

  • Live Forever - Every release moves care forward: measured, safe, and built to last. Data guides us, but patients define the truth that matters.

  • Practice Ownership - Decisions follow logic and proof, not hierarchy. Exceptional care demands exceptional standards in our work, our thinking, and our character.

  • Small Cuts Heal Faster - Stability earns trust, speed delivers impact. Progress is about learning fast without breaking what people depend on.

  • Make others better - Feedback is direct, kindness is constant, and excellence lifts everyone. Our success is measured by collective growth, not individual output.

Our mission is clear: expand the world’s capacity to care, and do it without losing the humanity that makes care worth delivering.

Why you should Join Heidi 🚀

  • Real product momentum. We’re not trying to generate interest, we’re channeling it.

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You’ll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Unmatched impact. Play a pivotal role in shaping our GTM efforts at a critical growth moment - all while working on a product that delivers tangible value to clinicians and patients every day.

  • Work alongside world-class talent. Join a team of operators and builders who’ve scaled unicorns.

  • Global reach. Help shape our international expansion as we bring Heidi to key international markets.

  • Growth and balance. Enjoy a £500 personal development budget, dedicated wellness days, and your birthday off to recharge.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: People Partner (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

People Partner (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

At tonies, storytelling is at the heart of everything we do. Our success isn't just about innovative technology and creative ideas - it's about the passionate, talented people who bring those stories to life. As we scale, we are looking for a People Partner to join our journey and shape our next chapter. In this role, you’ll be part of our People Partnering team, with the ambition to build high-impact teams through collaborative partnerships and a high-performance culture as an engine for long-term business success.

What you'll do

Driving Organizational Effectiveness through Strategic People Partnering

  • Partner closely with leadership in your designated area across various levels, acting as a trusted strategic advisor on a broad range of people and organizational matters.

  • Support the evolution of your area by contributing to organizational design matters and the implementation of structural changes.

Coaching Leaders to Lead with Impact

  • Act as a coach and sparring partner to leaders, supporting their leadership effectiveness.

  • Help leaders navigate organizational and cultural change, make thoughtful leadership decisions, and drive high-performance within their teams.

Driving the Implementation of People Programs

  • Partner with the people development function to drive the implementation and adoption of people programs within your designated area.

  • Support leaders and teams through change and take ownership of core programs, e.g performance feedback, ensuring effective delivery and desired outcomes.

Navigating Employee Relations with Empathy and Expertise

  • Support the resolution of employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and sensitive workplace dynamics (either directly or in close collaboration with our Employee Relations Specialist).

  • Ensure situations are handled thoughtfully, consistently, and in line with our values and legal requirements.

Creating a Seamless Employee Experience through Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with cross-functional People & Culture teams to ensure a seamless employee experience and embed cohesive ways of working between the business and our department.

What You Bring

  • Multiple years of experience as a People Partner in a complex global company, ideally in a fast-paced, scaling context, with deep experience in partnering with leaders across different countries, including the US.

  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking to understand how different business areas operate, connect people priorities with business needs, and confidently act as a trusted advisor to leaders.

  • Strong collaboration and cross-functional partnership skills, working effectively as a team player with stakeholders at multiple levels across the organization.

  • Clear, confident, and empathetic communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences, build trusted relationships, and create alignment on complex or sensitive topics.

  • Action-oriented ownership to proactively drive topics forward, navigate obstacles, and ensure initiatives are successfully implemented to achieve desired outcomes.

  • Skilled at systemic thinking and problem-solving, understanding how people, processes, and structures interconnect to identify underlying patterns and develop thoughtful, sustainable solutions.

  • Global mindset and flexibility to thrive in an international setup, including early-evening meetings when needed to collaborate with US-based colleagues as well as occasional business trips to Düsseldorf

  • Full professional fluency in English and German

  • Ideally, experience working with works councils and navigating the associated processes and requirements.

Why Join Us?

  • Global teamwork: We work together across departmental and national borders on our vision of bringing the Toniebox to every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code, but to everything else as well. Because you can only give your best when you feel truly comfortable.

  • Mobility: Choose the offer that best suits you – a Germany ticket for unlimited mobility, a monthly payment of fifty euros for an office parking space, a leased bicycle or a remote work allowance.

  • Protection: Benefit from subsidies for employee savings plans, company pension schemes and disability insurance.

  • Relaxation & Time Out: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off, such as Carnival Monday, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also take up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave).

  • Continuous professional development: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language learning and relaxation made easy: Improve your communication skills with the Babbel language learning app and find relaxation through our access to the Calm meditation app.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire tonies range.

 

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Mitwirkung an der Modernisierung und Digitalisierung der Abläufe in der Personalabteilung.

Ihr Profil

Gesucht wird eine Person mit Erfahrung in der Personalsachbearbeitung, einer selbstständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise sowie einem freundlichen und verbindlichen Umgang mit den Beschäftigten. Diskretion, Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen und Interesse an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Verwaltungsabläufe sind uns wichtig.

title: PMO Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You’re the reason the PMO’s reporting rhythm runs on time, every time, so no function lead is left scrambling for a last-minute slide the night before a gate review. You bring cost, schedule and risk inputs together into one clear, decision-ready picture for leadership, and you chase the gaps early, before they turn into someone else’s problem in the room.

You’re also the fabric of the PMO. This goes well beyond reporting: you’ll help us make sense of the data we collect, creating unexpected insights, pointing out unseen opportunities and uncovering hidden dependencies. You’ll bring fresh ideas on how we work and challenge how things have always been done, and your insights will shape the decisions that move Alpha forward.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the PMO's reporting cadence, pulling together inputs from the Cost Controller, Programme Schedule Manager and Risk & Change Manager into steering committee packs and gate-readiness reports

  • Chase status updates ahead of gate reviews and leadership meetings, flagging anything missing, out of date or inconsistent before it reaches a decision forum

  • Maintain the reporting templates and dashboards (in Wrike or similar) that give leadership a clear view of milestones and status

  • Keep the master calendar of programme deliverables, gates and milestones across Alpha and Stellaris up to date

  • Support the logistics for PMO governance forums, including the Release Gates Authority and steering committees, from scheduling to papers

  • Help with ad hoc analysis of cost, schedule and risk data to support PMO decisions

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've supported a PMO or project controls function on a complex, multi-discipline programme, and you know what it takes to keep many moving parts in view

  • You're highly organised and good at turning input from engineers, suppliers and commercial teams into reporting that's clear, concise and actually gets read

  • You're confident with project management and reporting tools, and you pick up new ones quickly

  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus

  • You enjoy building things that don't exist yet and are comfortable with the pace and ambiguity that comes with it

  • You get real satisfaction from being the connective tissue of a programme: making progress, risks and dependencies visible so the people making decisions can make good ones

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (60 min)

  • Technical Panel (2x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Principal AI & Algorithms Engineer (Defence & Security)
descriptionHtml:
Overview 

We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer in our AI & Algorithms department, working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building and testing intelligent systems that require cutting edge algorithms.

As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the algorithmic approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams that use our labs and computing resources to enable us to deliver ambitious projects.

Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us. 

We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office.

What you’ll be doing: 

  • Applying data-driven software development in machine learning/AI, applied statistics, and sensor processing, alongside mathematical computing techniques such as digital signal processing, simulation, and numerical optimisation. 
  • Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client. 
  • Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your opinion sought by colleagues. 
  • Leading the development of proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver. 
  • Driving internal capability and demonstrators that keep us at the leading edge and open up new conversations with clients. 
  • Mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people. 
  • Contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards. 

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years’ experience designing and delivering cutting edge algorithms for intelligent systems, including working on defence or security projects. 
  • Technical skills in one or more of: transformer models, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, machine vision and perception. 
  • A strong undergraduate degree in a relevant technical subject, such as AI/machine learning, computer science, mathematics or, physics. A PhD in a relevant subject is welcome but not required; deep, demonstrable industrial expertise is what matters. 
  • Strong Python and software engineering judgement.
  • The ability to architect the technical approach on complex projects and to review the work of others, including working autonomously as the technical authority. 
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers. 
  • Experience working with non-technical stakeholders for your work. 
  • Interest in working directly with clients and contributing to proposals and sales conversations. 
  • A genuine affinity for working in the defence and security sector.  

While not essential requirements, we would also be very interested if you have experience with any of the following: 

  • Technical experience with any of: signal processing, edge computing, statistical modelling, numerical optimisation, or simulation. 
  • A track record of building client relationships and leading the technical side of sales campaigns and proposals. 

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been a continuous resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.

What we offer:

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
  • Company bonus (profit share)
  • Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
  • Medical insurance and group income protection
  • Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Travel insurance (business and leisure)
  • Generous company pension plan
  • Personalised career development and training plans
  • Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day
  • Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links
  • A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

Why Cambridge Consultants? 

Cambridge Consultants creates exciting and novel breakthroughs in technology and products. Our work on intelligent systems area has helped create world-first and market-changing technologies including real-time AI-enhanced medical imaging, autonomous defence systems against cyberattacks, and edge algorithms to help visually impaired people navigate indoor spaces. We combine our research output with engineering rigour to create innovative and robust solutions to solve complex problems presented to us by our clients. We help clients across a diverse range of markets, including defence/security, healthcare, biotech, industrial and energy, so there is no shortage of variety. 

At the heart of what we do are talented and motivated multi-disciplinary teams empowered to create cutting edge technologies and systems to solve difficult problems for our clients. We offer a diverse, fun, and challenging work environment where you'll have the chance to work on a wide variety of projects that deliver real value using technology.  

We recognise and celebrate individual talent and we understand the importance of letting individuals be just that. Our people are here to do the best work of their lives and our job is to provide the platform for them to do it.

You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. 

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity. 

This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth. 

Key Responsibilities

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure. 

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity. 

What you’ll bring 

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them. 

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance. 

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field. 

Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives. 

This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems — including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling — alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent optics, 100G/400G/800G) and IP backbone design (IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams. 

Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority

Location & Reporting

  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

Employment Basis

Full-time

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

We're looking for an Product Engineer // AI to build the automations that turn claims handling into something the industry has never had: fast, reliable, and actually built for the volume insurance runs at.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Who You Are

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resume. You might come from a product engineering background, an AI/ML team shipping real features, or a startup where you've had to own things end-to-end.

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT.

IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. Thousands of applications to govern. Major transformations to manage. Growing regulatory complexity on one side, business units shipping AI prototypes in days on the other. And in the middle: enterprise IT teams still managing and collecting tech demands manually, managing the complexity of highly integrated processes and systems.

Stackgini changes this fundamentally. Stackgini's system understands its customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up, from technical configuration to application documentation, from individual IT demands to dependencies across the entire tech portfolio, with the depth of knowledge of a senior IT expert and the speed of a machine. If you had unlimited budget, you would hire a dedicated IT expert for every IT demand. With Stackgini, this is now possible.

Some of the largest organizations in this world trust Stackgini including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers or REWE.
We're a small, talent-dense team of >10, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

Tasks

The role

A Product Engineer at Stackgini owns features end to end. You take a customer problem, scope it with Product & CSM, design the solution, build it across the stack, ship it, and stay close to it after release. Recent examples: Product Engineers shipped Decisions and Approvals (a feature for routing IT requests through multi-step approval workflows), built evaluation infrastructure to benchmark agent recommendations against expert baselines, and agentic IT solutions research with our inhouse developed agent tool-use.

You are close to users. You join customer calls, run user tests, read support context, and you use that input to decide what should exist and how it should behave. The person building the feature is expected to shape the feature.

We have more good ideas than hands. For most reasonable feature ideas the question is not whether we build them, but when. Product Engineers are the people who turn that prioritization into shipped product quickly, without lowering the bar.

The AI work

AI is core to our product, but we don't run agents for everything. We use them where they create real value. For that we built our own LLM harness from hard-earned production experience: maximum freedom for the model, without compromising on enterprise control, governance or EU data residency.

What this means for you: you work hands-on with these new technologies, you run evals instead of trusting demos, and you know how to put this stuff into production reliably. Agent output gets benchmarked against expert-curated baselines, and failure modes get named, measured and fixed. If you are obsessed with how AI systems behave, fail and improve, this is the place for you.

How we ship

  • Small teams of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. We deploy continuously to production.
  • We use AI tools heavily, and you have freedom in which ones (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex). Around that we run a strong operating system: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, screenshots or videos for product changes, manual product testing before release, production verification after.
  • The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

Requirements

What we need from you

Nobody at 11 people knows everything. We hire people who dive in and own outcomes.

  • 3 to 6 years of full-stack experience shipping production software people actually use.
  • You can get productive in our stack fast: Kotlin/Spring Boot and Python on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend. You don't need to know all of it on day one, but you should get into it quickly.
  • You have shipped agentic systems, side projects absolutely count. You think in tools, context and evals, not just prompts.
  • Fluent English. German is a real plus because many customer calls run in German. We pair you with a German-speaking teammate when needed, but German gets you closer to users faster.

You'll stand out if

  • You build with AI natively, not as an afterthought.
  • You can take a vague problem to a shipped feature. You scope, decide, implement, test and iterate.
  • You want to understand why people behave the way they do, and you use that understanding to make product decisions.
  • You have high standards for yourself and move fast without needing to be pushed. B2B SaaS or startup experience is a plus.

Our stack

Kotlin (Spring Boot) & Python · TypeScript (React/Next.js) · PostgreSQL · AWS (Fargate, ECS) & Terraform · GitHub Actions · Azure (OpenAI) · AWS (Bedrock)

Benefits

Working here

We work from our office in Berlin (hybrid, but most engineering happens in-person). The team spends free-time together several times a month, shares lunch, and works closely on hard problems. No politics, no long meetings - we move fast and make decisions at the whiteboard. You'll be one of 11 people, which means your work ships to customers within days, not quarters.

Benefits

  • Attractive compensation package including employee stock options
  • Hybrid work with a modern office in Berlin
  • 30 days of vacation and day off on your birthday
  • Budget for self-improvement and dedicated time for learning & innovation
  • Home-office allowance, Deutschlandticket, gym pass
  • The best popcorn in town

Ready to make an impact? Join us at Stackgini and be part of something extraordinary!

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. title: Product Manager, Finance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us to redefine the future of on-demand delivery. To do this, we're building a world-class Finance Engineering (FinEng) organization across all global markets we support at DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. in which each of our product managers plays a critical role in helping to define and execute our vision to move money accurately and at scale across every market we operate in and ensure finance and accounting compliance. As we grow, billions of dollars in money movements flow through our platform every year and our team makes sure every one of them is understood, trusted, and correctly reflected in the financial books.

About the Role

Product Managers on the Finance Engineering team need a systems-oriented mindset, platform thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. In this role, you will define the strategy and vision for systems that track billions of dollars in company-wide money movement, translate transactions into accounting entries, and accelerate the financial close. You will build scalable, audit-ready automation for complex, high-volume financial activity.

This is an opportunity to reshape modern accounting by applying AI to reconciliation, investigations, and incident detection and mitigation. Your products will form a critical part of the company’s financial infrastructure and help earn the confidence of leadership, auditors, and regulators.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive the product definition, strategy, and long-term vision for accounting automation. You own the roadmap
  • Build systems that track billion-dollar-level money movements across the entire company and automatically convert them into accurate accounting entries
  • Reinvent and accelerate the accounting close process, reducing manual effort and shortening close timelines
  • Champion AI-driven approaches to transform close reconciliation, financial investigations, and incident detection and mitigation
  • Partner with FinEng, Accounting, and Finance leaders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into scalable, automated products
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, accountants, and operators
  • Communicate product plans, benefits, and results to key stakeholders including the leadership team

We're excited about you because…

  • You have a track record in product management, including driving product strategy, vision, and roadmap alignment
  • You have built complex, back-end, data-intensive, or platform products. Ideally in fintech, payments, accounting, or financial systems
  • You have a strong grasp of accounting concepts (e.g. double-entry, ledgers, reconciliations, the close process) and how financial data flows through complex system
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking alongside the accounting reality of a specific brand or market
  • You're an execution power-house who thrives in ambiguity and operates at the lowest level of detai
  • You are excited about applying AI/ML to real-world financial problems such as reconciliation, investigation, and incident mitigation
  • You have experience presenting business reviews to senior executives
  • You have empathy for the users you build for, including accountants, controllers, and finance operators
  • You are motivated by building financial infrastructure that works across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As a AI Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.

You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.

You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible?

You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

  • Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

  • Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

  • Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

  • Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

  • Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

  • Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

  • Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

  • Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

  • Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

  • Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

  • Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output.

  • UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use.

  • Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself.

  • Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront.

  • Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact.

  • Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build.

  • AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

  • High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

  • Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

  • Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

title: Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

What is the role about

As a fast paced, highly targeted and highly regulated company, security is more important here than most other companies. That means your impact can be much more material, this role is about working with our brothers and sisters in product and engineering and building security through collaboration. It’s about being an engineer who knows how to use automation and tooling to get more done at pace and to scale security’s impact.

The role includes ‘whole of product’ security - Application, architecture and infrastructure. You’ll understand deeply the threats posed to us by threat actors and where to focus our attention, you’ll be the kind of person who enjoys building long lasting relationships, making impact by really moving the needle and scaling through automation so you are always focussed on the highest value work.

How will you make an impact

  • Threat modelling: Taking an attackers lens on what’s being built and understanding how it could be abused/targeted and being able to bring others on the journey through clear communication.

  • Pen testing/Red teaming/Vuln discovery: Being the threat actor but with a whitebox approach, thinking about what tools can you build to help scale these processes. Thinking about how we bring in more data to find the right issues and surface them with appropriate prioritisation.

  • Communication and relationships: Bringing teams on side by working together with the attackers lens, collaboratively designing best of breed security controls that mitigate threads and support the business and our customers by making them as slick as possible.

  • Going deep on existing MO’s and industry attack knowledge: Understanding deeply the attackers, their motivations and evolving techniques, performing evaluations of our controls to ensure they hold up, continuously iterating and educating.

How will you be successful?

  • Backend/frontend development background with a transition into security engineering

  • 5+ years of experience in secure software development and AppSec

  • Demonstrable record of delivering real world security improvements

  • Deep experience of scaling security through automation including AI and slick processes

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers and CI/CD

  • Strong AWS and/or GCP experience

  • Strong understanding of AuthN/AuthZ, API security, AI Security and OWASP Top 10

  • Experience with tools such as Burp, Wiz, Snyk, Semgrep, Bug bounty and SAST platforms

  • Experience in fintech, payments, crypto or other regulated industries is a big plus

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think like an attacker to anticipate and prevent security issues

  • Strong Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Bug Bounty participation/Hall of fame/CVE IDs are a big plus

  • Any security certifications are a plus (CISSP, CPTS, OSCP, AWS Security+)

Unsere Software läuft dort, wo Ausfälle keine Option sind: in Behörden, bei kritischen Infrastrukturen und im Mittelstand. Wir suchen dich für die Unterstützung unserer Projekte, von der Ausschreibung über das Angebot bis zur Abnahme.

Zwischen Kunden, Entwicklungsteam und Geschäftsführung sorgst du dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt und jedes Projekt von Anfang bis Ende rundläuft. Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Projekte und begleitest sie über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus.

Wichtiger als eine bestimmte Zahl an Berufsjahren ist uns, dass du strukturiert arbeitest, dich in technische Themen hineindenkst und Freude am Kundenkontakt hast. Auch wenn du aus einem angrenzenden Bereich kommst, zum Beispiel Fachinformatik, als IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, aus dem Büro- oder Projektmanagement oder aus Medien- und Kommunikationsberufen, und Organisationstalent plus Technikaffinität mitbringst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich über deine Bewerbung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du pflegst Scrum-Boards, hältst Tickets und Status nach, klärst offene Punkte mit der Projektleitung und den Entwicklern und bereitest die Sprints mit vor
  • Du organisierst Kundenmeetings und begleitest sie, meist gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und Projektleitung, inklusive Vorbereitung, Protokoll und Nachverfolgung
  • Du wirkst bei Softwaretests und Abnahmen mit
  • Du erstellst ausgehende Rechnungen und hältst Wiedervorlage und Dokumentation in Ordnung
  • Du arbeitest an Ausschreibungen mit und erstellst gemeinsam mit uns IT-Angebote

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Organisationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, viele Fäden gleichzeitig in der Hand zu halten
  • Sicheres, freundliches Auftreten in der Kundenkommunikation
  • Du bist technikaffin und bringst dein Wissen in IT-Angebote und Softwaretests ein
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; moderne KI-Tools nutzen wir im Alltag, du arbeitest dich gern ein
  • PLUS: Berufserfahrung in Projektkoordination, Projektassistenz oder im Angebots- und Vergabewesen
  • PLUS: Erfahrung mit Scrum oder agilen Abläufen

Benefits

Das bieten wir

  • Gehalt von 2.800 Euro brutto/Monat bei 32 Std./Woche (entspricht einem Vollzeitäquivalent von 42.000 Euro brutto/Jahr). Der Stundenumfang ist zwischen 30 und 40 Stunden vereinbar.
  • Ausbau der Position in Richtung Projektleitung ist möglich
  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, geförderte Zertifizierungen und Bildungsurlaub
  • Gleitzeitregelung innerhalb unserer Kernarbeitszeit
  • 30 Urlaubstage, unbefristeter Vertrag, BVG-Fahrausweis
  • Lunch-Zuschuss sowie kostenlose Getränke und Snacks im Büro
  • Budget für Gesundheitsförderung
  • We love Kids! Kita-Zuschuss und kinderfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen
  • Vierbeinige Kollegen willkommen! Bring deinen Hund mit ins Büro. 🐕
  • Langfristige Kunden aus öffentlicher Hand und Mittelstand
  • Nach ISO 9001 und ISO 27001 zertifiziert (TÜV Süd)
  • Zentrales Büro zwischen Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz und Alexanderplatz

Es handelt sich um eine Präsenzstelle mit fünf Arbeitstagen pro Woche in Berlin-Mitte.

Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Sende uns Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und ggf. Arbeitszeugnisse mit deinem möglichen Eintrittstermin.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! ♥️

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Anlagen- & Rohrleitungsbau - Wasseraufbereitung
descriptionHtml:
Du bist bei uns das Gesicht des Projekts nach außen: Kunden, Planer und Generalunternehmer sprechen mit dir, von der technischen Klärung über Baubesprechungen und Nachträge bis zur Abnahme. Die Montage vor Ort führt unsere Bauleitung, Kalkulation und Verträge liegen bei der Geschäftsführung. Du hältst Technik, Termine und Kunde zusammen.

Wir sind ein Familienbetrieb in zweiter Generation mit rund 15 Leuten in Raesfeld und bauen seit über 40 Jahren Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen für Schwimmbäder, Thermen, Hotels und Kliniken: Filter, Verrohrung, Dosier-, Mess- und Steuerungstechnik. Unsere Projekte liegen überwiegend in NRW, einzelne bundesweit. Schwimmbad-Fachwissen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Wer Anlagen- oder Rohrleitungsbau kann, lernt Badewassertechnik bei uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest 2 bis 4 Projekte parallel, Auftragsvolumen rund 250.000 € bis 2,5 Mio. €, Laufzeit 2 bis 12 Monate

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Kunden, Fachplaner und Generalunternehmer und leitest Baubesprechungen und Baustellentermine

  • Du klärst die Technik: Ausführungsplanung, Rohrleitungs- und R&I-Schemata, Abstimmung mit Lieferanten und unserer Bauzeichnung

  • Du erkennst Nachträge, begründest und verhandelst sie und schreibst Bedenken- und Behinderungsanzeigen nach VOB/B

  • Du stimmst Termine und Personal mit Bauleitung und Montageplanung ab und steuerst Subunternehmer technisch

  • Du verantwortest Inbetriebnahmen, Abnahmen und die Dokumentation bis zur Übergabe an den Kunden

  • Du berichtest Projektstand und Kosten regelmäßig an die Geschäftsführung

Nicht deine Aufgabe: Vorkalkulation, Angebote und Vertragsabschluss (Geschäftsführung) sowie die tägliche Führung der Montage (Bauleitung).

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Projektleiter im Anlagenbau, Rohrleitungsbau, in der Wasser- oder Abwassertechnik oder der TGA, mit eigener Verantwortung gegenüber dem Auftraggeber

  • Technische Ausbildung als Ingenieur (z. B. Verfahrens-, Versorgungstechnik, Maschinenbau), Techniker oder Meister

  • Sicherheit in der VOB/B: Nachträge, Bedenken- und Behinderungsanzeigen, Abnahmen

  • Du liest Rohrleitungs- und R&I-Schemata und redest bei Pumpen, Filtern und Verrohrung technisch mit

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu Terminen in ganz Deutschland, gelegentlich mit Übernachtung

  • Wohnort idealerweise im Münsterland, am Niederrhein oder im Ruhrgebiet

Ein Plus:

  • Schwimmbad- oder Badewassertechnik (DIN 19643)

  • Kunststoff-Rohrleitungsbau

  • Erfahrung mit Capmo

Benefits

  • 70.000–90.000 € Jahresgehalt je nach Erfahrung, plus Projektbonus

  • Dienstwagen auch zur Privatnutzung: Mercedes E-Klasse T-Modell (Plug-in-Hybrid, Baujahr 2023)

  • Reisen mit Grenze: höchstens 2 Wochen am Stück auswärts

  • Weiterbildung nach der Probezeit, z. B. KI-Schulung im Haus

  • Klarer Zuschnitt: Bauleitung auf der Baustelle, Kalkulation und Verträge bei der Geschäftsführung

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Büroarbeit teilweise im Homeoffice, ein fester Bürotag pro Woche in Raesfeld

  • Einarbeitung in die Badewassertechnik durch unser Team

title: Projektleiter Elektrotechnik (m/w/d)

title: Projektleiter MSR / Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d)

Dann erwartet Sie hier ein attraktives Jahresgehalt von 75.000 bis 85.000 € je nach Erfahrung sowie ein Firmenwagen auch zur privaten Nutzung.

Projektleiter MSR / Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d) | 75.000-85.000 € brutto/Jahr + Firmenwagen

title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) Finance
