title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech – Content Supply Chain & Automatisierung | Vollzeit | Hybrid
descriptionHtml:
DIU ist IT-Dienstleister für MarTech-Lösungen (Marketing Technology: Technologien, mit denen Marketing- und Content-Prozesse geplant, automatisiert und ausgespielt werden) sowie AI & Cloud Services mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden entwickeln, integrieren und betreiben wir IT-Lösungen für Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung, Medien und Industrie.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade und Suzuki.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und vom Anspruch, Technologie dort einzusetzen, wo sie messbar Wirkung erzeugt. Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unserem Motto: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns: www.diu.digital

Aufgaben

WANTED

Unser Geschäftsbereich MarTech unterstützt Marketing-, Content- und Brand-Teams dabei, ihre Content Supply Chain, also den Weg von Inhalten von der Erstellung über Freigabe und Veredelung bis zur Ausspielung auf allen Kanälen, effizienter, automatisierter und KI-fähig aufzustellen. Wir orchestrieren Systeme, Prozesse und KI-Services toolunabhängig. Wo keine passende Standardlösung existiert, bauen wir schlanke, eigene Lösungen und bewerten jede Entscheidung wirtschaftlich im Interesse unserer Kunden.

Du suchst eine Rolle, in der du Projektverantwortung, Beratungskompetenz und eigenes technisches Umsetzen verbindest? Dann wird DIU interessant für dich. Bei uns sind die Wege kurz, Entscheidungen transparent und Zusammenarbeit professionell. Als Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech verantwortest du Projekte rund um Automatisierungslösungen, Marketing Production Automation (kurz: MPA) und die Integration von Systemen der Content Supply Chain. Kleinere Automatisierungen, Prototypen und Integrationen setzt du selbst um, zum Beispiel mit Claude Code, MCP-Servern oder Low-Code-Plattformen.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1–2 Tagen Office pro Woche aus. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead zusammen und entlastest ihn. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen.

DOINGS

  • Du planst, steuerst und setzt Projekte entlang der Content Supply Chain um: Automatisierungslösungen, MPA-Services und Systemintegrationen.

  • Du analysierst Content-Prozesse bei unseren Kunden, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in fachliche und technische Aufgaben.

  • Du entwickelst einfache technische Lösungen selbst, etwa Workflow-Automatisierungen, Schnittstellen, Prototypen oder Self-Service-Tools, unterstützt durch KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code und MCPs.

  • Du berätst Kunden zu Workflows, Datenflüssen, Schnittstellen und dem sinnvollen Einsatz von KI im Content-Prozess.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass sich Lösungen reibungslos in bestehende MarTech-Landschaften und Prozesse einfügen.

  • Du verantwortest Projektplanung, Zeitpläne, Budgets und Ressourcen für deine Projekte.

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Kunden, Fachbereiche und Entwicklung und sorgst für klare, regelmäßige Kommunikation.

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche Leitung von Teilprojekten und unterstützt den Teamlead bei Planung, Priorisierung und Steuerung.

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-/Medien-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Quereinsteiger mit passender Berufserfahrung sind herzlich willkommen.

  • Mehrjährige Projektmanagement-Erfahrung, bestenfalls in Projekten mit technischem Umsetzungscharakter.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Lösungen selbst zu bauen, und hast erste Erfahrung mit Scripting, APIs oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie bspw. Make.

  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, MCP, LLM-APIs) oder große Lust, dich darin schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Verständnis für Content-Prozesse im Marketing sowie für IT-Architekturen, Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen, um mit Entwicklung und Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen.

  • Erfahrung mit Systemen der Content Supply Chain (z. B. Marketing-Automation, DAM, Workflow- oder Produktionsplattformen) ist von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung in Projekten im Konzernumfeld und Sicherheit im Umgang mit vielen Beteiligten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

DIU FOR YOU

Bei DIU besetzen wir nicht Stellen, sondern suchen nach Menschen mit Leidenschaft für ihr Fachgebiet. Wir verstehen uns als Plattform für ein Team aus Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft mit anderen teilen oder in Projekte einbringen möchten. Den Rahmen für diese Arbeit schaffen wir mit:

  • Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen deiner Wahl, die wir gern ermöglichen

  • Einer agilen Unternehmensorganisation

  • Einer offenen Fehler- und Gesprächskultur

  • Einbeziehung tiefer fachlicher Themen in Management-Entscheidungen

DIU SPIRIT

Wir sind nicht laut - sondern lieber unaufgeregt und verlässlich. Wir entwickeln DIU bewusst strukturiert weiter. Bei uns findest du:

  • Sehr durchmischte Altersstrukturen

GET IN

title: Projektmanager (m|w|d) für Promotions, Roadshows und Events – Vollzeit
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

WAHRE KOMMUNIKATION verbindet Marken und Menschen. Wir arbeiten für Markenhersteller und Retailer in den Bereichen FMCG, Consumer Goods, Spielwaren und Retail. Unsere Stärke ist die verzahnte Aktivierung in Content, Live und Digital entlang der gesamten Customer Journey, von der Leadgenerierung bis zum Abverkauf. Seit 25 Jahren bringen wir diese Expertise mit einem großartigen Team zu den besten Kunden der Welt.

Marken wie Dr. Oetker, Mattel, Bauck, Andros und Chio vertrauen auf uns. Unser LIVE-Team für Roadshows, Events und Verkostungen begleitet jede Aktion komplett: von der Konzeption über die Ankündigung, Planung und Durchführung bis zum Abbau, zur Logistik und zum abschließenden Reporting. So kommen Marken, Produkte und Samples zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort bei den Menschen an und werden dort inszeniert.

Als etablierte Werbe- und Kommunikationsagentur machen wir Marken entlang der gesamten Customer Journey erlebbar: CONTENT. LIVE. DIGITAL.

Das bedeutet: Wir machen aus tollen Marken noch tollere Marken.

Wofür wir stehen

  • Wertschätzung: Wir hören einander zu, begegnen uns mit Respekt und übernehmen Verantwortung füreinander, im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit den Menschen am POS.

  • Zielorientierung: Wir erreichen gesetzte Ziele mit hoher Qualität und reagieren flexibel und pragmatisch auf Veränderungen.

  • Leidenschaft: Wir geben aus Überzeugung das Beste für unsere Kunden und unser Team.

Worum es geht

Wir suchen einen Projektmanager in Vollzeit, der seine Aktionen von A bis Z in der Hand hat. Du planst, konzipierst und steuerst Roadshows, POS-Aktionen, Promotions und Verkostungen und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende alles rund läuft. Dabei weißt du, dass gutes Projektmanagement nicht nur am Schreibtisch passiert. Wenn es darauf ankommt, bist du vor Ort, begleitest deine Aktion am POS oder auf der Roadshow, packst mit an und behältst auch bei der Rückführung im Lager den Überblick.

Du führst deine eigenen Kunden, dein eigenes Projektteam und deinen Azubi. Gleichzeitig bist du die rechte Hand deiner Teamleitung und übernimmst als Stellvertretung Verantwortung für das gesamte Team.

Und noch was im Sinne der wahren Kommunikation: Wir suchen KEINEN Social Media Manager.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest deine eigenen Kunden und Projekte und bist ihr erster Ansprechpartner.

  • Du begleitest jede Aktion vollständig: Konzeption, Kalkulation, Planung, Durchführung, Personaldisposition, Logistik und Reporting.

  • Du planst Budgets, Zeitpläne, Personal und Material und behältst alle Fäden in der Hand.

  • Du führst und entwickelst deinen eigenen Azubi und arbeitest eng mit deinem Projektteam zusammen.

  • Du berichtest an deine Teamleitung und vertrittst sie im gesamten Team. Ist sie im Urlaub, berichtest du direkt an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Du bist bei Bedarf vor Ort, begleitest Roadshows, Handelsroadshows, POS-Aktionen und Verkostungen und gibst Änderungen sofort an alle Beteiligten weiter.

  • Du steuerst die Logistik: Große und kleine Aufbauten, Samples, Aufsteller und Material sind zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort.

  • Du checkst nach der Aktion Rückführung, Packlisten und Lagerbestände und sorgst dafür, dass alles vollständig und in Ordnung ist.

  • Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings für deine Kunden und ziehst Learnings für die nächste Aktion.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung als Veranstaltungskaufmann (m|w|d) oder Kaufmann für Marketingkommunikation (m|w|d), ein Studium im Bereich Projekt- oder Eventmanagement oder Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Bereich Live-Marketing, Promotions, Roadshows oder Events.

  • Du führst Kunden souverän, überzeugst mit Struktur und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick.

  • Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Menschen zu führen und Azubis auf ihrem Weg zu begleiten.

  • Logistik und Lagerprozesse sind dir nicht fremd, und wenn es nötig ist, packst du selbstverständlich mit an.

  • Du hast einen Führerschein.

  • Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Menschen und kannst Teams begeistern.

  • Du möchtest deine eigenen Stärken und Talente aktiv bei uns einbringen. Wir sind gespannt, was du mitbringst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einem innovativen Unternehmen mit Zukunftsperspektive

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit eigenen Kunden, eigenem Azubi und Entwicklungsperspektive

title: Python Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help us build high-quality, reliable backend systems that accelerate our mission.

This role sits within our mortgage engineering team. You’ll work across the backend stack, owning features end to end: from shaping product and technical requirements through implementation, launch, and iteration.

This role is ideal for a hungry, ambitious engineer who wants to step up quickly; someone with strong engineering fundamentals, high ownership, and the drive to grow into a senior-level contributor.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and ship high-quality backend features using Python, Django, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Pydantic, Postgres, and Google Cloud

  • Own backend work from concept through delivery, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external engineering partners to deliver features with cross-team dependencies

  • Work closely with frontend to shape excellent user-facing and internal experiences

  • Bring strong technical judgment to the table, improving not just how systems work, but how they scale and evolve

  • Contribute to backend architecture, API design, data modelling, performance, reliability, security, and developer experience

  • Raise the standard of your own work and the work of those around you

Who you are:

  • Strong hands-on experience building backend systems with Python

  • Practical experience working with Django

  • Experience designing or consuming RESTful APIs

  • Experience designing and exposing GraphQL APIs for frontend applications

  • Experience working with Postgres and relational data models

  • Familiarity with Pydantic, typed Python, or modern Python engineering practices

  • Some experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally Google Cloud, or a strong desire to learn

  • A good eye for clean architecture, API design, performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • A product-minded approach: you care about the “why” behind what you’re building

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability

  • The ability to uncover unknowns, navigate ambiguity, and turn complex problems into clear, shippable solutions

  • Pride in your craft, clean code, thoughtful reviews, and helping others grow

Ideally, you'll also have:

  • Experience with PDF generation or document rendering workflows

  • Experience in early-stage or fast-moving product teams

  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure operations

  • A data-driven approach to decision-making

  • Openness to change, innovation, and the ways AI will reshape how products are built and used

What makes someone successful in this role

You don’t just “take tickets.” You think like a product builder. You’re hungry to learn, quick to take ownership, and motivated by the chance to grow fast. You notice when a system could be simpler, when an API could be clearer, or when a technical decision needs more care.

You’re comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking good questions, making decisions, and pushing work over the finish line.

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership through WellHub

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Regulatory Lead
descriptionHtml:
Regulatory Lead

Remote, with occasional travel as required | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The role

We are looking for a Regulatory Lead to take day-to-day ownership of our regulatory framework, and of our relationship with our external compliance provider, as the business grows.

This is a broad, hands-on role covering regulatory change, compliance processes, governance and risk across the UK and US. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, our Compliance Officer and MLRO, the senior leadership team, external legal and regulatory advisers, and sophisticated institutional clients and counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take day-to-day ownership of the firm’s regulatory framework across the UK and US, prioritising work through a central plan and dashboard.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting the business, assess their impact and lead the implementation of any changes required.

  • Work with our external compliance provider to keep compliance policies, procedures and controls up to date and applied in practice, including marketing and financial promotions approvals, client categorisation and onboarding, employee compliance (such as personal account dealing, conflicts of interest and gifts and hospitality) and compliance records.

  • Oversee the compliance monitoring carried out by our external provider, act on its findings, and keep records and evidence ready for regulatory and client due-diligence review.

  • Support the MLRO and our external provider in running the firm’s financial crime framework, including anti-money laundering, sanctions and client due diligence.

  • Assess the regulatory implications of new products, jurisdictions and business initiatives, and coordinate specialist advice where needed.

  • Act as a point of contact for regulators and for clients’ and counterparties’ compliance and regulatory teams, including responding to due-diligence questionnaires.

  • Coordinate compliance training with our external provider and promote a strong compliance culture across the business.

  • Prepare regulatory and compliance reporting for the Board and senior leadership, and support corporate governance processes.

  • Manage external legal and regulatory advisers, instructions and budgets, including on contractual, data protection and other matters requiring legal input.

  • Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes through templates, automation and technology.

About you

You will have substantial experience in a regulatory or compliance role, whether gained at a fintech, crypto or digital-asset business, a trading firm, bank or broker, a regulator, an advisory or consultancy firm, or a combination of these. A legal qualification is welcome but not required.

Experience in trading, markets, payments or digital assets is desirable. A strong working knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks, sound regulatory judgement and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business processes will be essential. Exposure to US regulation would be an advantage.

You should have:

  • Experience of compliance frameworks, policies and monitoring, including working with or overseeing outsourced compliance providers.

  • Experience managing regulatory change and assessing the regulatory impact of new products or business activities.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including drafting clear policies, procedures and reports.

  • The confidence to work independently and exercise sound judgement.

  • The ability to recognise when specialist legal advice is needed, and to work effectively with external counsel.

  • A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly to colleagues across the business.

  • The ability to engage confidently with regulators, sophisticated clients, counterparties and their compliance or regulatory teams.

  • Experience managing external advisers and coordinating work across multiple jurisdictions.

  • An interest in financial markets, trading technology and regulatory developments.

The role would suit someone who wants meaningful responsibility in a growing business and enjoys building a well-organised, effective regulatory function rather than simply responding to individual queries.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

title: AI Fabric Architect
descriptionHtml:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About this role

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

What you will do:

  • Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric

  • Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many

  • Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables)

  • Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live

  • Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic

  • Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

  • Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

  • Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents

  • Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in data center or HPC networking, including direct responsibility for production GPU cluster fabrics

  • A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators

  • Deep expertise in InfiniBand (NDR/XDR, UFM, subnet management) and/or RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet

  • Strong command of rail-optimized and Clos/fat-tree designs, BGP/ECMP, and EVPN/VXLAN

  • A clear understanding of how fabric design and tuning affect collective communication and real workload performance

  • Comfortable automating with Python, Ansible, or similar

  • Strong Linux skills and the ability to debug across the boundary between host, NIC, and fabric

  • Sound judgment on tradeoffs between cost, performance, reliability, and time to deploy

  • NVIDIA Quantum/Spectrum-X, ConnectX-7/8, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and/or Broadcom Tomahawk 5-class Ethernet

  • 400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler AI infrastructure team, NVIDIA networking, or an AI factory integrator

  • Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design

  • Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks

  • Experience building out multiple sites in parallel or on aggressive timelines

  • Willingness to travel frequently to data center sites, especially during build-outs

What we offer at fal:

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • A lot of learning and growth opportunities

  • We offer relocation assistance to San Francisco.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

  • Regular team events and offsite

title: Engineering Manager – Platform
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Engineering Manager – Platform

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work.

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager – Platform, you will lead a team building and operating the platform services customers build on, from virtual machines to observability and security, joining one of our Platform teams: Cloud, Observability or Security. We hire strong managers first, then agree your team with you based on your strengths and interests.

You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Each team has around nine engineers: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer, and a platform engineer. Your first team is a starting point, and moves between teams are normal here.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Network, Storage & Cluster

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test.

  • Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning.

  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it.

  • Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development.

  • A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

  • A good understanding of:

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with GPU, HPC, or AI infrastructure is a bonus. Nobody has depth in every area above: tell us which you know and which you want to learn.

What You Bring

  • People leadership: Build strong teams and help engineers grow.

  • Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail.

  • Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together.

  • Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes.

  • Curiosity: Learn new domains fast. GPUs, networks excite you rather than worry you.

  • Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (Principal Engineer and Engineering Lead) → Final.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Workforce Security
descriptionHtml:
About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

 

Why This Role

We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to protect how our staff work: the accounts they sign in with, the devices they use, the third-party tools they rely on, and the agents they delegate work to. You'll work closely with IT, which operates our employee services and devices.

This is an engineering role: you'll spend your time building tools and automations, designing practical controls, investigating escalations, and shipping changes.

 

What You’ll Work On

These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:

  • Identity and access. Strengthen how staff authenticate and what they can reach: single sign-on coverage, phishing-resistant authentication, and access provisioning and revocation that stay reliable and complete as people and tools change. Design scoped, short-lived credentials for the tools and agents that act on staff's behalf, and improve our ability to detect credential misuse.

  • Endpoint security. Work with IT on device trust, hardening, and visibility across our fleet. Find practical ways for engineers and researchers to install what they need without introducing unnecessary risk.

  • AI agents and staff tooling. Help staff use agents and AI-powered tools productively and safely. Review the threat models, permissions, and data flows of tools staff build or adopt, including coding agents, desktop assistants, browser extensions, and MCP servers. This includes how staff supervise and stay accountable for delegated actions, and the audit trails that make agent activity reviewable. Build sandboxes, credential patterns, and guardrails that make the secure path the convenient one.

  • Third-party tool security. Define a scalable security review for the tools staff use day to day, and work with IT, which owns procurement and provisioning, to build security checks into how tools are onboarded and offboarded. Maintain a current picture of which tools can reach company code, credentials, and customer data as tools are added and retired.

  • Visibility and response. Make sure identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry is collected and usable. Investigate escalations and incidents in these areas, verify that we can contain a compromised account or device quickly, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in identity and access security and endpoint security. Hands-on experience administering an identity provider and a device-management platform.

  • Practical understanding of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, secrets handling, and authorization design. You can trace how an application obtains and uses credentials and find where access controls can be bypassed.

  • Hands-on engineering ability. You can read unfamiliar code, inspect how an app talks to APIs, and write the automation and tooling that replace manual processes.

  • Experience using LLMs and agents in your own work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they can be attacked or misused.

  • Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones and apply controls in proportion to the risk.

  • Experience supporting researchers, engineers, or other highly technical staff, and a track record of finding secure ways to meet their needs.

  • Comfort working with real autonomy and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.

Experience with macOS security, developer tooling, SaaS security, software distribution, agent integrations, or threat hunting would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems for real users than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.

 

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $180,000 - $225,000 USD + Equity

 

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Network Architect, Backbone Network
descriptionHtml:
Design and build the global network that connects Radiant’s data centres, customers and future regions.

At a glance

Team: Infrastructure Delivery, Office of the CTO
Reports to: Infrastructure Delivery lead
Location: UK based, with travel to sites and industry events
Work model: Hybrid

Who we are

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale, powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments.

Our Infrastructure Delivery team designs and builds the systems that connect our sites and bring new capacity online. The backbone is a critical part of that work as Radiant expands across regions.

The opportunity

You will own the architecture of Radiant’s global backbone, from the first design decision through build, testing and handover. It will connect our data centres, new developments, cloud and customer interconnects, while meeting demanding requirements for resilience, capacity and data sovereignty.

You will be the design authority for the backbone, working hands-on with a small architecture team, delivery partners, vendors and carriers. Infrastructure Operations will run the network after go-live, so you will bring them into decisions early and give them a network they can operate confidently.

What you’ll do

  • Define the backbone architecture and roadmap, including routing, traffic engineering, site connectivity, transit, peering and private interconnects.

  • Turn customer, capacity and sovereignty requirements into designs that can be built and operated. Work with cluster network, infrastructure, storage, security and data centre teams to resolve trade-offs.

  • Produce high-level and low-level designs, bills of materials, test plans and acceptance criteria. Lead design reviews and approve the technical design before build and handover.

  • Evaluate routing and optical platforms, carriers and proposed designs. Contribute technical requirements and assessments to procurement processes while Procurement owns commercial terms.

  • Establish standards for network automation, a source of truth and streaming telemetry. Validate designs in the lab, investigate complex backbone faults and improve the architecture as the network grows.

  • Represent Radiant in technical discussions with customers, vendors and the wider network community, including at relevant industry events.

What you’ll bring

  • You have owned a multi-site backbone from design through production, including delivery across more than one country. You bring around ten years in network engineering, with substantial carrier, service provider or hyperscale backbone experience.

  • You have deep practical knowledge of BGP, an interior routing protocol such as IS-IS or OSPF, MPLS and segment routing. You can design internet edges, peering, data centre interconnects and resilient paths.

  • You understand optical transport, including DWDM, coherent optics, dark fibre and wavelength services, and can make sound decisions across leased and owned capacity.

  • You have configured and tested major routing platforms, automated network changes with tools such as Python or Ansible, and worked with a network source of truth. You can write clear designs and defend them with engineers, executives and customers.

  • You hold a current expert-level network certification, such as JNCIE-SP or CCIE Service Provider, or an equivalent, and are comfortable travelling to sites and speaking at industry events.

Nice to have: Experience with GPU or AI infrastructure networks, sovereign or regulated environments, long-haul fibre routes, or contributions to the wider network community.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, and we’d rather hear from you than miss out.

What we offer

Our UK package includes share options, a bonus scheme, 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, a 5% employer pension contribution, private medical cover, dental and optical support, wellbeing benefits, paid parental leave, dedicated learning time and a cycle to work scheme. Confirm the applicable package with People before posting.

Equal opportunities

Radiant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital or parental status, or any other protected characteristic.

descriptionHtml:

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

We are looking for a Product Builder to join the IDP & RPA pod. You will take real problems from customers, decide what is worth solving, and build and ship the solution yourself, using AI tools to get from idea to production quickly without lowering the bar.

Product Building is how Camunda's Experience organization builds the applications people use on top of Camunda 8, such as Hub, Operate, and ProcessOS. Small pods of builders own a product area from customer problem to shipped change, with no hand-offs between product management, design, and engineering. We are setting this model up now, so you will help shape how it works.

The IDP & RPA pod builds how Camunda processes work with documents and legacy applications. With intelligent document processing (IDP), customers create extraction and classification templates in Camunda Hub and publish them so a process can use AI to turn invoices and other documents into structured data. With robotic process automation (RPA), customers integrate legacy applications that have no APIs, using Robot Framework scripts on a standalone RPA worker. The hard problems come with putting LLMs into customer processes: extraction quality, model and prompt choices, testing and trust, and working for AI agents as well as for people.

What You Will Do

  • Help shape product direction for IDP & RPA by combining customer input, usage data, and field feedback into clear priorities.

  • Partner with the other builders and product strategy to turn problems into shipped features, using short written proposals and prototypes to align early.

  • Make judgment calls with incomplete information within your scope and own the outcome.

  • Communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the details the way you do.

  • Use AI tools across the whole loop, from specs to prototypes to production-ready code, and hold a high bar for what you ship by reviewing and improving the output rather than accepting it.

  • Build, test, and ship improvements to the IDP & RPA experience, reading errors and tracing issues far enough to give your pod useful context.

  • Talk to customers and to support and customer success colleagues about how IDP is used and where it breaks, and turn what you learn into decisions about what to build next.

  • Pick up customer incidents and trace them across Hub, the connectors, and the deployed process of the customer.

  • Track what you ship against real outcomes and adjust when the data tells you to.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

This role is an existing vacancy

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

title: Retention & CLV Operator (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Glow25!

At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on.

We look forward to getting to know you.

These are our current challenges and future goals:

Five years ago, Glow25 started from zero. Today we are one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands, with a large community of returning customers. Our biggest lever is making sure those customers stay with us: through a strong subscription programme, a loyalty programme and a lifecycle experience that gives them a reason to come back, again and again.

To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Retention & CLV Operator who works alongside our existing teams, keeps the big picture in view and sets up our retention engine structurally. Ownership covers Klaviyo flows, our subscription programme and our loyalty programme, plus post-purchase, replenishment, education, win-back and sales campaigns. Copy, flows and launches come from one person, with access to a rich customer data set and the freedom to build individual AI workflows. Lifecycle work that was written and built personally, and that moved repeat purchase or customer value, makes an application stand out.

This role joins an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving them together with the teams is encouraged.

This is where we need your support:

  • Retention strategy and customer journey: Strategic thinking that keeps the whole lifecycle in view and sets up retention structurally, from onboarding, product education and replenishment to cross-sell and win-back, so that customers stay with us long term and the setup scales across markets.

  • Subscription and loyalty programmes: Experience building and growing a subscription offering and loyalty mechanics, from the sign-up experience and churn prevention to VIP experiences that turn customers into long-term fans.

  • Lifecycle flows in Klaviyo: Hands-on expertise in building triggers, audiences, timing, branches and suppression rules independently in Klaviyo.

  • Copy and campaigns: Direct-response copywriting and storytelling that moves customers, from campaign emails to long-form sales sequences, plus planning and running customer moments, product launches and seasonal sales together with Acquisition and Creative.

  • Data and AI-driven decisions: Confidence in using cohort, repeat-purchase and contribution-margin evidence to choose tests and make clear decisions, paired with practical use of AI for customer research, copy exploration and workflows, with human judgment on claims and final copy.

  • Localization and collaboration: A feel for adapting stories and offers to each market instead of translating them, while keeping one brand voice, and a collaborative way of working with Acquisition, Customer Service, Product and Analytics, sharing learnings so that all teams get faster.

You have the following experience:

  • Personally written and built lifecycle programs in D2C or e-commerce, ideally in a high-repeat category such as supplements, beauty or food, with clear proof of what was written, built, launched, measured and changed.

  • Track record of subscription, loyalty, post-purchase, replenishment or win-back programs that moved repeat purchase, revenue per recipient or customer value.

  • Strong direct-response instincts and storytelling skills across short and long formats, plus hands-on experience in a lifecycle platform, ideally Klaviyo.

  • A structural, big-picture mindset and comfort with e-commerce economics and experiments: retention set up as a system rather than a series of one-off campaigns, with the ability to separate real lift from attributed revenue, without being a pure analyst.

  • Hands-on use of AI in the last 12 months to speed up research, copy or workflows. Show us what you built.

  • A collaborative communicator who brings colleagues along by explaining decisions clearly and sharing learnings, fluent in English; German or another European language is a plus.

That's something you can look forward to:

  • Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.

  • Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.

  • Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.

  • Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.

  • Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.

  • Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

  • Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

  • Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.

  • Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.

  • Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

  • Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.

  • Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

Yay! You've made it this far!

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: Senior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.
  • Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.
  • Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.
  • Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.
  • Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.
  • Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.
  • Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.
  • Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.
  • Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.
  • Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.
  • Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.

About the team

The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. You’ll join a distributed group of Account Executives, sales managers, and business development team members who collaborate asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business in the mid-market segment. We partner closely with marketing, sales development, and technical teams to run an efficient, transparent sales process, document what works in our sales handbook, and represent the voice of the customer back into GitLab. We focus on opportunities like supporting customers through toolchain consolidation, driving platform adoption, and sharing learnings from wins and losses to continuously improve how we sell and support GitLab.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description
As a Senior Business Development Manager in our Invoice Finance team, you'll take on a more complex and higher-value origination remit, working the largest and most strategically important opportunities across our acquisition channels. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, take the lead on more sophisticated deal structures, and act as a role model and informal mentor to more junior members of the BDM team, while continuing to personally originate and close new business.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of a portfolio of higher-value, strategically important Invoice Finance opportunities and introducer relationships

  • Get up to speed on Kriya's most complex deal structures and credit considerations

  • Build relationships with junior BDMs and begin sharing best practice on prospecting and qualification

  • Own origination and closing of higher-value, complex Invoice Finance opportunities, driving income against monthly, quarterly, and annual targets

  • Help build and manage a portfolio of strategically important introducer relationships, including key broker and accountancy firm partnerships

  • Take the lead on structuring more complex lending proposals, working closely with credit to get deals over the line

  • Act as a mentor to junior BDMs, sharing best practice on prospecting, qualification, and deal structuring

  • Play a key role in developing and executing the commercial business plan for Invoice Finance, in line with strategic goals

  • Identify and pursue multi-product cross-sell opportunities across the wider Kriya and Allica Bank offering

  • Comply with all mandatory policies and adhere to operational procedures to maintain internal controls

Channels you'll work

  • Strategic introducer and broker relationships

  • Key accountancy firm partnerships

  • New-to-bank direct outreach on larger opportunities

  • Cross-sell referrals from across Allica Bank

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Substantial track record of new business origination in Invoice Finance or closely related SME lending products, with demonstrable success on larger, more complex deals

  • Experience building and managing strategically important introducer and broker relationships

  • Deep understanding of the Invoice Finance market, deal structuring, and credit considerations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and representing the business at a senior level with introducers and partners

  • Natural mentor, happy to share knowledge and raise the standard of those around you, without formal management responsibility.

  • Strong commercial judgement, with a track record of identifying and converting cross-sell opportunities

  • Managerial and people hiring experience is a plus

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, and a track record of improving processes as a business scales

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

  • Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.

What you'll bring

title: Research Consultant im Bereich Marktforschung (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Kundenkommunikation und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte souverän und verständlich präsentieren

Benefits

Du kannst in unserem schönen, hellen Altbau Büro in Berlin Mitte arbeiten oder im Homeoffice mit vier Teamtagen im Büro pro Monat. title: Responsable de Boutique Paris
descriptionHtml:
En tant que Responsable de boutique dans notre boutique de Paris, vous donnez le ton au quotidien, insufflez votre énergie à l’équipe et transformez les objectifs commerciaux en actions concrètes sur le terrain. Vous garantissez une expérience client irréprochable et mémorable. Responsable de la performance globale de la boutique, vous assurez un leadership de proximité, accompagnez votre équipe avec bienveillance et exigence, et veillez à maintenir un point de vente toujours impeccable et inspirant. Vous êtes également l’interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) du siège et contribuez activement au développement de la marque dans votre région.

Vos missions principales

  • Vous êtes responsable de la gestion globale de la boutique : l’équipe, les ventes, la présentation du magasin et l’atteinte des objectifs.

  • Vous encadrez, accompagnez et motivez votre équipe afin de faire ressortir le meilleur de chaque collaborateur(trice).

  • Vous assurez les tâches administratives liées aux relations humaines, telles que les entretiens d’évaluation et les entretiens de recrutement.

  • Vous suivez les KPI (key performance indicators) liés aux ventes, à la satisfaction client et à la planification des horaires.

  • Vous êtes le point de contact principal pour les équipes du siège et le/la Retail Coordinator.

  • Vous identifiez les opportunités du marché et y répondez via des actions commerciales et des optimisations.

  • Vous veillez à une planification optimale des équipes ainsi qu’à une gestion rigoureuse des stocks.


  • Vous justifiez d’au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience sur un poste de management, idéalement dans le secteur de la vente au détail.

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un BTS MCO ou d’une formation équivalente, de préférence orientée commerce, management ou mode.

  • Vous êtes flexible et disponible pour travailler à des horaires variables, notamment en soirée et le week-end.

  • Vous disposez d’un fort sens des responsabilités, d’une attitude proactive et savez fédérer, accompagner et motiver une équipe au quotidien.

  • Vous résidez à Paris ou dans sa région.

  • Le cas échéant : Vous êtes autorisé(e) à travailler en France.

À propos de My Jewellery

My Jewellery est l’une des marques et entreprises de e-commerce ayant une des croissances les plus rapides aux Pays-Bas, avec une présence internationale. Nous créons des collections et des campagnes qui apportent un petit plus au quotidien des femmes. Avec plus de 1 000 collègues, nous faisons grandir chaque jour une marque pleine d’ambition, de créativité et d’énergie.

Notre culture ? Personnelle, engagée et pleine de vie. Ici, vous pouvez vraiment être vous-même et vous avez toute la place pour évoluer, apprendre et avoir un impact concret. Malgré notre forte croissance internationale, les échanges restent directs, avec des circuits de communication courts, une organisation horizontale et une ambiance très conviviale. En équipe, nous avançons ensemble et aimons faire la différence au quotidien.

title: RF Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space.

As an RF Systems Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development, and integration of communication systems across our satellite connectivity and next-generation RF payload programs. You'll work on RF system architecture, signal processing algorithms, and performance analysis, collaborating closely with FPGA, embedded software, systems, and hardware engineers to develop and integrate complex RF technologies.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of RF hardware and signal processing, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing their work go from initial design to in-orbit operation.


About this Role:
  • Contribute to the design and development of RF systems for satellite connectivity and payload applications, including architecture, requirements, and technical trade-offs.
  • Perform RF link budget analysis and evaluate subsystem performance across S-band, X-band, and inter-satellite link (ISL) applications.
  • Develop and optimize signal processing algorithms for RF payloads using MATLAB and related simulation tools.
  • Support RF payload development across the signal chain, from antennas and RF frontends to ADCs and SDR systems, including signal detection and geolocation.
  • Collaborate with FPGA, embedded software, and systems teams to translate RF requirements into implementable solutions and integrate signal processing algorithms.
  • Define and track system requirements, documenting technical decisions, integration activities, and verification results.
  • Support RF testing, hardware integration, troubleshooting, and performance verification through AIT and in-orbit commissioning.
  • Work across engineering and AIT teams to drive successful development and integration of RF systems and payloads.

    • Must Haves:
  • 2+ years of experience in Radio Frequency (RF) systems engineering, subsystem integration, or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience with RF system integration, debugging, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Experience with signal processing algorithms, including the ability to model, analyze, or evaluate RF signal processing approaches.
  • Knowledge of RF communication systems and subsystems, particularly S-band and X-band communications.
  • Experience with RF link budget calculations and RF system-level performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with RF hardware, test equipment, and subsystem validation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive technical activities and collaborate across system and software integration efforts.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

    • Nice to Haves:
  • Experience with Software-Defined Radio (SDR) architectures and development.
  • Familiarity with FPGA-based signal processing, including experience working with FPGA teams to implement digital signal processing algorithms or IP blocks.
  • Knowledge of key SDR components and technologies, including channelizers, analog-to-digital converters (ADC), and digital-to-analog converters (DAC).
  • Experience using MATLAB for signal processing, modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
  • Experience translating system-level RF and signal processing requirements into FPGA or embedded software implementation requirements.
  • Experience with antenna systems, RF frontends, and RF payload architecture.
  • Familiarity with RF geolocation, signal detection, spectrum analysis, or SIGINT-related applications.
  • Experience with RF testing, integration, and performance verification in an aerospace or satellite environment.

    • Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Robot Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As a Robot Operations Engineer, you will be the backbone of our hands-on robotic development. You will be responsible for the bring-up of fresh hardware, maintaining our active hardware fleet, as well as owning the "robot gym": our dedicated lab environment where robots undergo continuous testing and AI model training.

Your work ensures that our AI and software teams have uninterrupted access to high-functioning, reliable hardware. Working at the intersection of hardware engineering and AI development, you will oversee prototype bring-up, diagnose electromechanical issues, and create a structured, highly efficient lab environment that accelerates our overall product development cycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Hardware Bring-up: Perform the initial bringing up and commissioning of freshly built prototypes. Ensure the flawless interaction between hardware, firmware, and base software stacks before handing them over for active testing.

  • "Robot Gym" Management: Own and operate the "robot gym." Ensure the lab environment is safe, organized, and continuously optimized to support the AI team's data collection and training operations.

  • Fleet & Inventory Ownership: Track, maintain, and manage the entire inventory of robot prototypes, sub-assemblies, and critical spare parts. Ensure all active units are properly version-controlled and running the latest hardware and firmware configurations.

  • Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Perform routine maintenance, sensor calibrations, and hands-on repairs across the robot fleet. Rapidly diagnose and resolve electromechanical, networking, or system-level issues to minimize testing downtime.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary technical bridge between the Hardware and AI teams. Provide operational support, manage hardware allocation requests, and feed critical performance observations back to the hardware engineering team to improve future iterations.

  • Process Standardization: Establish and document clear standard operating procedures (SOPs) for robot operation, safety protocols, lab maintenance, and hardware troubleshooting.

Your profile

We are looking for hands-on engineers who love getting their hands dirty with complex mechatronic systems and take immense pride in keeping a high-tech robotic fleet running at peak performance.

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in robotics operations, lab management, hardware testing, field engineering, or a similar hands-on electromechanical role.

  • Core Skills: Strong hands-on mechanical and electrical troubleshooting capabilities. Familiarity with Linux environments, basic network configuration, and scripting (e.g., Python or Bash) for system diagnostics and bring-up. Experience managing hardware inventory, using standard lab equipment, and ensuring operational safety.

  • Mindset: You are highly organized, proactive, and service-oriented. You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced lab environment, possess a strong sense of ownership over your fleet, and understand that the success of our AI development relies heavily on the readiness and reliability of the hardware you manage.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

As Sales Manager for the French Market at Amenitiz, your primary objective is to ensure the day-to-day execution, coaching, and operational stability of a small, focused French sales team based in our new Lyon hub. You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development.

You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results.

We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners.
