title: Senior Forward Deployed Product Manager (London)
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

In AI, proximity to customer reality is the moat. Even the best model doesn't run itself: it takes someone who gets close enough to a customer's business to make it work, and that closeness doesn't happen on its own.

That's where the Forward Deployed Product Manager comes in. You'll work directly with our biggest customers at the moments that matter most in their journey with Fin, whether that's proving out value in an evaluation, getting a deployment live, or expanding what's possible once it's working, and get them to real, measurable success with Fin faster than they'd get there on their own. What you learn with them feeds back into the product, so every customer after them gets there faster and better too.

This is a very novel role in the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what great looks like at Fin: evolving the playbooks, and shaping how we win and deliver on our biggest, highest-stakes deals.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for a PM who wants real time with customers and hands-on time with the product, and who's comfortable making progress before every answer is known.

What will I be doing? 

  • Own outcomes for a portfolio of strategic customers deploying Fin. Understand their business, their support operation, and their technical environment well enough that the deployment plan you propose earns trust immediately.
  • Run the full arc yourself. Pitch and demo Fin, scope the solution, hands-on configure it (including custom development if required), and unblock whatever gets in the way, whether that's a product gap, a technical integration, or a cross-functional snag.
  • Be the AI expert in the room. Customers should leave every conversation with you knowing more about how to get outstanding results from Fin.
  • Partner tightly with Sales, Success, and R&D so each deployment feels like one team to the customer, not a relay race.
  • Turn what you learn in the field into product. Bring specific, evidence-backed input, not just feature requests, to shape the roadmap.
  • Build the playbook as you go: the deployment patterns, templates, and best practices that make the next ten deployments faster than the first.
  • Help define what Forward Deployed PM means at Fin. It's a very novel role across the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what it looks like here.

Success in this role looks like your customers thriving with Fin, and the product getting sharper because of what you learned from them. It's product management at its core, not solutions engineering, customer success, or professional services.

What skills do I need? 

  • Experience: No minimum years required. We care about impact, drive, and potential, evidenced through the skills below, not tenure.
  • Customer obsession: Deep empathy paired with a bias for action. You're motivated by solving the real problem and delivering measurable results.
  • Communication & storytelling: You can pitch Fin to a room of executives, then get into the technical weeds with their engineers, adjusting depth and tone without losing either audience.
  • Technical fluency: You're able to talk to engineers and customers about modern tech stack, from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to LLMs and low-code tooling. You're comfortable onboarding a customer into more technical product setups.
  • Evidence-based thinking: You use data, not anecdotes, to make the case for a deployment plan or a roadmap bet, and you're comfortable pulling and interpreting data (conversation logs, usage, CX metrics) to find the story.
  • Cross-functional influence: You navigate organizational boundaries easily, and bring people together to get the best outcome for customers and Fin.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive in fast-changing, undefined environments, switching fluidly between big-picture strategy and in-the-weeds execution.
  • Operational rigor: Operational rigor: You're highly organized and structured, managing multiple deployments and priorities without becoming reactive, and you know when a moment calls for speed versus polish.

Even better if you have:

  • Experience building product for enterprise customers
  • Startup or B2B SaaS experience
  • Background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pennylane accélère fortement le développement de ses activités Financial Services / Banking. Pour accompagner cette croissance et sécuriser la trajectoire financière de cette activité stratégique, nous recrutons un·e FP&A Analyst dédié·e aux Financial Services.

Au sein de l’équipe FP&A, tu seras le point de référence financier du périmètre. Ta mission sera de transformer les ambitions business en une trajectoire financière robuste et pilotable, en combinant modélisation, analyse de la performance et business partnering.

Tu travailleras au croisement des équipes Finance, Financial Services, Strategy, Risk et Compliance, dans un environnement en forte croissance et soumis à des enjeux réglementaires spécifiques.

Tes missions


Piloter la performance Financial Services

  • Construire, maintenir et challenger le modèle financier du périmètre Financial Services.

  • Suivre la performance mensuelle : actuals, forecast, budget.

  • Analyser les écarts, identifier leurs principaux drivers et formuler des recommandations actionnables.

  • Produire une lecture claire de la performance à destination des équipes opérationnelles et de la Finance.

Maîtriser les revenus, les coûts et la marge

  • Modéliser les différentes composantes du chiffre d’affaires : acquisition clients, nombre de comptes, mix produit, pricing.

  • Reconstituer et piloter la structure de coûts à mesure que le périmètre est internalisé et se développe.

  • Analyser les coûts directs, indirects, mutualisés, réglementaires, récurrents et exceptionnels.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de marge et construire les analyses de rentabilité pertinentes par produit, partenaire ou segment.

Accompagner la croissance et les décisions stratégiques

  • Évaluer la faisabilité financière des objectifs de croissance et le niveau de ressources nécessaire pour les atteindre.

  • Construire des scénarios et analyses de sensibilité sur les principaux leviers et risques du Business Plan.

  • Préparer les contributions Financial Services aux cycles de Budget et de Reforecast.

  • Challenger les hypothèses des équipes et contribuer aux arbitrages d’investissement.

Construire un pilotage adapté à une activité régulée

  • Intégrer dans les modèles les coûts partenaires, les contraintes réglementaires et les risques opérationnels.

  • Travailler avec les équipes Risk et Compliance pour traduire les enjeux réglementaires en impacts financiers.

  • Faire évoluer les indicateurs, reportings et processus à mesure que l’activité gagne en maturité.

  • Fiabiliser et automatiser les analyses, en lien avec les outils FP&A et les équipes Data.

L’impact attendu

Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras directement à :

  • sécuriser un Business Plan ambitieux grâce à des hypothèses robustes et régulièrement challengées ;

  • améliorer la visibilité sur les revenus, les coûts, la marge et les principaux risques ;

  • donner aux équipes et aux dirigeants une information financière fiable et actionnable ;

  • structurer les réflexes et les outils FP&A propres à une activité Banking ;

  • assurer une communication lean avec les équipes opérationnelles Financial Services.

Ton profil

  • Tu as une expérience solide de 5 ans minimum en FP&A, Transaction Services, audit, conseil financier, contrôle de gestion ou finance stratégique.

  • Tu maîtrises la modélisation financière, les cycles Budget / Forecast et l’analyse des écarts.

  • Tu sais transformer des données complexes en conclusions simples, structurées et orientées décision.

  • Tu fais preuve d’une grande rigueur, tout en gardant une forte compréhension des enjeux business.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés et challenger de manière constructive.

  • Tu as un excellent niveau sur Excel ou Google Sheets ; une expérience d’un EPM tel que Pigment est un plus.

  • Tu communiques avec clarté, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, en français et en anglais.

  • Une expérience dans la banque, la fintech, les paiements ou un environnement régulé est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable si tu démontres une forte capacité d’apprentissage.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Prendre en charge le pilotage financier d’une activité stratégique en très forte croissance.

  • Construire les modèles, indicateurs et processus de référence d’un périmètre encore en structuration.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij niet alleen bouwen aan frontendoplossingen, maar ook richting geven aan hoe we onze websites en digitale platformen de komende jaren ontwikkelen?

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Voor ons Websites & Portals Platform team zoeken we een ervaren frontend engineer die technisch leiderschap combineert met sterke hands-on kennis van Angular. Iemand die vooruitkijkt, een frontend visie en roadmap kan neerzetten en andere teams kan meenemen in de technische richting.
Je bent dus niet alleen degene die complexe frontend vraagstukken kan oplossen. Je helpt ook bepalen waar we naartoe gaan, welke technische keuzes we maken en hoe verschillende ontwikkelteams binnen die koers samenwerken.

Als Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead speel je een centrale rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons frontend platform.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

- het opstellen en uitdragen van de technische visie en roadmap voor frontend;
- het verder ontwikkelen en moderniseren van het frontend platform;
- het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare platformcomponenten voor onze websites en digitale klantomgevingen;
- het maken en bewaken van technische en architectuurkeuzes;
- hands-on ontwikkelen met Angular en TypeScript;
- het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers en ontwikkelteams die gebruikmaken van het platform;
- het bewaken van standaarden, kwaliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en samenhang;
- het vertalen van behoeften vanuit verschillende teams naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen;
- samenwerken met onder andere solution teams, architectuur, security en infrastructuur.

Het gaat daarmee om meer dan software ontwikkelen. Jij helpt de technische koers van het frontendlandschap te bepalen en zorgt ervoor dat die koers ook daadwerkelijk landt binnen de organisatie. Wat deze rol interessant maakt? Je krijgt de kans om op meerdere niveaus impact te maken. De ene keer duik je zelf de techniek in. De andere keer bespreek je een architectuurkeuze, werk je aan de roadmap of help je een ander team om een oplossing binnen het platform goed neer te zetten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het individuele vraagstuk. Je vraagt je steeds af: hoe maken we het platform eenvoudiger, consistenter, schaalbaarder en toekomstbestendiger?

#LI-DNI


Wat vragen we van jou?

We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren frontendprofessional die technische diepgang weet te combineren met visie en leiderschap.

Je hebt:
- ruime ervaring met frontendontwikkeling;
- diepgaande ervaring met Angular en TypeScript;
- ervaring met NX workspace / monorepo en NodeJS, of vergelijkbare moderne frontendomgevingen;
- ervaring met Azure App Service en Azure Pipelines, of vergelijkbare cloud- en CI/CD-omgevingen;
- ervaring met het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van frontendplatformen;
- het vermogen om een technische visie en roadmap op te stellen en uit te dragen;
- ervaring met het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers of andere ontwikkelteams;
- voldoende senioriteit om technische keuzes uit te leggen en verschillende stakeholders daarin mee te nemen;
- kennis van .NET en API-integraties (pré);
- ervaring met Agile, Scrum en/of SAFe;
- minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
- een goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels en woonachtig in Nederland.

Wie ben jij? Je bent technisch sterk, maar bent niet iemand die het liefst alleen met code bezig is.

- Je kijkt verder dan het vraagstuk van vandaag;
- Je ziet afhankelijkheden tussen teams en systemen;
- Je durft technische keuzes te maken en daarvoor te staan;
- Je kunt ontwikkelteams enthousiasmeren en meenemen;
- Je schakelt makkelijk tussen developers, architecten en management;
- Je bent pragmatisch en weet wanneer een oplossing technisch goed genoeg is;
- Je neemt eigenaarschap over de ontwikkeling van het platform.

Je combineert daarmee de kwaliteiten van een senior engineer, technisch sparringpartner en kartrekker.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur.

title: Senior Global Brand Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Avenir Collective. Building the future of beauty, personal care and lifestyle brands.

We acquire and scale high-potential consumer brands, bringing together the capital, people and operating expertise to turn strong brands into enduring businesses. Our difference is that we are operators, actively managing our brands and providing the capabilities, infrastructure and expertise they need to scale, while preserving the product, purpose and consumer connection that make each brand special.

We’re building a connected house of brands where great people, brands and ideas come together. If you’re excited by building businesses, solving problems and working with a collaborative, entrepreneurial team, we’d love to hear from you.


Your role at a Glance

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially grounded Senior Global Brand Manager to take ownership of two of our most exciting growth opportunities: a male grooming brand and a skin health brand. Both have built strong foundations as digital-first, Amazon-led businesses, with proven products and loyal customers. The next chapter is about turning them into true omnichannel brands, with clear positioning, distinctive identities and sustainable growth across key markets.

Reporting to our Chief Brand Officer, you will be the senior brand lead across both categories, setting direction and rolling up your sleeves in equal measure.

Initially you will work largely hands-on, partnering closely with product, creative, digital commerce and commercial colleagues to land key priorities. As you prove the model and build the case for further investment, you will have the opportunity to shape and grow a team around you. This is a role for someone who loves building: someone who takes ownership, moves at pace, brings people with them and gets things done.

The Mission

Both brands are at an inflection point. They have earned their place online through great products and performance-led growth, but their brand foundations have not yet caught up with their ambition. Positioning, identity and the wider brand ecosystem now need to evolve so that each brand can travel beyond a single marketplace, win in new channels and with retail partners, and stand for something clear in the mind of the consumer.

The task at hand:

  • In male grooming, evolve and sharpen the brand so it builds on a strong core proposition and grows into a broader, more relevant grooming brand for today’s man.

  • In skin health, build credibility and trust in a category where efficacy and reassurance matter most, creating a brand that consumers and retail partners can believe in.

  • Across both, translate brand strategy into omnichannel go-to-market plans that land in market, across retail, direct-to-consumers and marketplaces beyond Amazon.

  • Deliver early, visible wins that demonstrate commercial impact and build the business case for future investment in the brands and the team.

Location and Flexibility

  • Full-time role based at our modern office in Runway East, London

  • 40 hours per week, 9 am to 6 pm with a one-hour lunch

  • This position is hybrid, with the expectation to go to the office 2 days per week

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Own the global brand strategy, positioning and identity for both the male grooming and skin health brands, ensuring each is clear, distinctive and relevant across markets.

  • Lead brand evolution work, from consumer insight and positioning through to visual identity, packaging and tone of voice, moving the brands from marketplace-led to brand-led.

  • Build annual brand plans with clear growth targets, KPIs and investment cases, and take accountability for delivery against them.

  • Put the consumer at the heart of every decision, using insight, data and real-world understanding to shape messaging, product experience and activation.

  • Track category trends, competitor activity and emerging opportunities in grooming and skin health and turn them into action.

  • Develop brand guidelines, playbooks and toolkits that make it easy for teams, partners and markets to bring the brands to life consistently.

Brand Activation & Commercial Delivery

  • Partner with product, creative, digital commerce and marketplace commercial teams to develop and land go-to-market plans at pace.

  • Lead omnichannel campaigns across e-commerce, retail, social media, PR, influencer and community platforms.

  • Bring a “glocal” mindset: consistent global brands, with room for smart local adaptation.

  • Work hand in hand with the commercial team on retailer sell-in, providing compelling brand stories, decks and assets, and joining key customer conversations where needed.

  • Manage and get the best from external agency partners across creative, PR, social and digital, within agreed budgets.

  • Measure performance rigorously, connecting brand activity to commercial outcomes and adjusting course quickly.

Leadership, Collaboration & Building for the Future

  • Build strong, trusted relationships across the business and with external partners, bringing people with you through influence rather than authority.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on brand opportunities, risks and growth priorities.

  • Build the case for future investment in the brands and in brand capability, using results and insight to show what is possible.

Experience & Capabilities

  • Significant brand management experience, with a track record at senior manager level or equivalent, in male grooming, skin health, personal care, beauty or adjacent consumer health categories.

  • Proven experience building, repositioning or evolving brands, including positioning, identity, packaging and messaging.

  • Experience taking brands beyond a single channel, ideally from digital or marketplace-led into retail and wider omnichannel.

  • Strong commercial grounding: confident with P&Ls, retailer dynamics, pricing and business cases, and able to link brand investment to commercial returns.

  • Experience leading campaigns and brand activation across multiple markets.

  • Strong creative judgement and a good understanding of digital, social and content trends.

  • Excellent agency management and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, or scale-up environment is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Salary: £60,000 - £70,000

  • 30 days holiday + 8 UK bank holidays

  • Pension contribution Scheme – 5% from you, 3% from us.

  • Private Medical Insurance – Includes travel, vision & dental (Vitality)

  • Work from Abroad – One month per year, anywhere in the world

  • Bonus Scheme – Discretionary bonus, based on individual and company performance

  • Mental Health Support – Free, confidential therapy via Spill

  • Flexi-Fridays – Finish early one Friday per month

  • Avenir Events – Quarterly meetups, celebrations & socials

  • Vibrant Office – Runway East, Bloomsbury

This is a rare opportunity to take two beauty and personal care opportunities to the next level, driving momentum and shaping their future while laying the foundations for a team and a truly brand-led business. You will have genuine ownership, senior visibility and the autonomy to make a tangible impact from day one.

Note: By submitting your application to join our talent pool, you consent to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with our privacy policy.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

  • Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

Compensation: €70K – €83K • €67K – €120K Equity

Our Global Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our London office as part of a Global DoorDash Engineering team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office).

This role sits in our Consumer Org, where you'll work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
  • Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
  • Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
  • Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
  • Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
  • You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
  • You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
  • You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
  • You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy

title: Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino (Remote)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Primary Focus:

As Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
  • Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
  • Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
  • Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
  • Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
  • Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
  • Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
  • Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
  • Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
  • Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
  • Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
  • Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
  • Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
  • Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

How This Role Connects Across the Team:

  • Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
  • Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
  • Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
  • Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
  • Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
  • Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that’s optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
  • Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
  • Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
  • Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
  • Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
  • Experience managing and developing direct reports.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

title: Senior Manager Revenue Accouting
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You’ll own the technical accounting behind how Mews recognises revenue across SaaS, fintech and financial services, and set the standard the wider finance team works to. This role exists because our revenue streams are getting more varied, and every new product, pricing model or payment flow needs a clear, controlled accounting answer before it goes live. You’ll make those calls across all Mews entities and geographies, with the autonomy to shape how it’s done.

title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.
  • Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.
  • Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.
  • Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.
  • Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.
  • Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.
  • Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.
  • Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.
  • Design for cost and manufacturability from the start and prepare the transfer to series production.

What you bring

Must have

  • MSc or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.
  • At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.
  • Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.
  • Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.
  • Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.
  • Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.
  • Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.
  • Dutch or German language skills.

What we offer

  • A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.
  • Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.
  • Permanent employment with a competitive salary and an employee stock option plan.
  • A lean, senior team with short decision paths.

Why Join ROB’E?

  • Build a category-defining MedTech company from an early stage
  • Work directly with experienced physician-founders
  • Take ownership across strategy, product, and company building
We would love to hear from exceptional individuals who are excited about building a company at the intersection of AI, robotics, and cardiovascular medicine.

You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media.   • French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.
  • Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.

You will ensure the stability, security, and performance of enterprise network and firewall environments, with a particular focus on Check Point technologies, advanced networking, and high availability. Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of secure and reliable network solutions.

Your Tasks:

  • Administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Check Point Next Generation Firewalls (NGFW)
  • Management of Check Point Security Management, SmartConsole, Security Gateways, and firewall policies
  • Configuration and optimization of NAT, VPN connectivity, firewall rules, and network segmentation
  • Operation and continuous improvement of complex enterprise network infrastructures in a business-critical SaaS environment
  • Analysis and resolution of advanced network issues involving TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, routing, and switching
  • Implementation and maintenance of high-availability solutions, including Check Point ClusterXL
  • Execution of firewall upgrades, migrations, patching, and security hardening activities
  • Ensuring secure connectivity and network isolation across multiple customer environments
  • Troubleshooting of network performance, availability, and connectivity issues
  • Participation in incident management, root cause analysis, and change management processes
  • Collaboration with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams on network optimization and modernization initiatives

Your Profile:

  • Professional experience in Network Engineering, Network Security, or Firewall Administration
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Check Point Firewalls, including configuration, administration, policy management, and troubleshooting
  • Strong expertise in enterprise networking, routing, switching, and network security
  • In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, NAT, IPsec VPNs, and network segmentation
  • Proven experience working with large-scale, complex network infrastructures
  • Experience supporting high-availability, security-critical production environments
  • Good understanding of multi-tenant environments, secure customer connectivity, and network isolation
  • Experience in banking, financial services, FinTech, or enterprise SaaS environments is highly desirable
  • Knowledge of Check Point VSX, Multi-Domain Security Management (MDSM), and ClusterXL is an advantage
  • Check Point certifications (CCSA/CCSE) are an advantage
  • Experience with cloud networking (AWS/Azure) and network automation tools such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform is a plus
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams
  • Fluent English skills are required, German language skills are an advantage

title: Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Bei Picnic betreiben wir einige der modernsten teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) für Lebensmittel Europas - mit einer Mischung aus Robotik, smarter Software und einer People-First-Kultur. Mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) liefern wir in über 100 deutschen Städten täglich Lebensmittel aus. Unsere jüngste Investment Runde, an der auch die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation beteiligt ist, zeigt das Vertrauen in unser Konzept. Als Senior Operations Manager (m/w/d) in unserem FC in Falkensee spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Zufriedenheit unserer KundInnen und Mitarbeitenden.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Wertstromanalyse: Du leitest Wertstromanalysen zur Ermittlung des Ist-Zustandes von Prozessen, analysierst wertschöpfende und nicht wertschöpfende Tätigkeiten und entwickelst Pläne für den Soll-Zustand, um Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.
  • Projektarbeit: Du entwickelst und setzt Strategien zur Rationalisierung von Arbeitsabläufen um, beseitigst Engpässe und steigerst die Gesamteffizienz von Prozessen innerhalb von Wertströmen.
  • Datenanalyse: Mit ausgeprägter Datenanalyse- und Problemlösungskompetenz identifizierst und behebst du Prozessprobleme.
  • Change Management: Du förderst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, indem du Lean-Methoden einsetzt, Problemlösungs-Workshops moderierst und funktionsübergreifende Teams befähigst, Prozessverbesserungen selbst zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Teamleitung: Mit natürlichen Führungsqualitäten förderst du Bottom-up-Engagement und die tägliche Einbindung der Produktionsstätten und Mitarbeitenden, um Kaizen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voranzutreiben.
  • Verbesserung: Du zeigst eine konsequente Haltung zu den 5S-Prinzipien (Sauberkeit, Organisation usw.) und bringst Erfahrung in der Schulung, im Coaching und in der Umsetzung dieser Verbesserungsstandards mit.
  • Schichtleitung: Übernimm einmal pro Woche die Schichtleitung mit 150+ Lagermitarbeitenden, um weiterhin nah an unseren Operations zu sein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise im Ingenieurwesen oder Lieferkettenmanagement.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in großen Lager Betrieben mit, vorzugsweise im Bereich der Automatisierung.
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Lean Management und/oder Wertstromdesign, einschließlich einschlägiger Zertifizierungen.
  • Außergewöhnliche Führungsqualitäten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Motivierung und Führung von Teams zur Erzielung herausragender Ergebnisse.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, kompetent im Umgang mit Datenanalysetools wie Tableau und Excel.
  • Praktische Mentalität, die Ideen in die Tat umsetzt und mit gutem Beispiel vorangeht, um den Erfolg zu fördern.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen. Kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

Why Join Samsara?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica is building out its growth function, based around talented, empowered and autonomous individuals who will be responsible for product-based customer acquisition using a combination of channels to meet objectives set across the business. You will get an opportunity to work with different teams across the business including product squads, distribution, engineers and operations to deliver on Allica’s mission of becoming the UK’s most recommended business bank.

We are rare amongst banks in that our senior leadership team have backgrounds at worldleading fintechs, which shows in their active engagement in both the strategic and execution elements of our rapidly scaling organisation. Because we are working on one of the last untapped fintech opportunities, in a new team it will mean that we're often working on entirely new challenges and unpicking complexity as we move along. No two days are ever the same.

Role Description

The Senior Performance Marketing Executive at Allica Bank is responsible for managing, optimising, and reporting on campaigns across our Lending and Business Bank Account products. You will be in our accounts every day, as well as contributing to strategy, to scale customer acquisition at an efficient CAC:LTV.

You are the ideal candidate if you have experience executing & scaling data-driven, direct response Performance Marketing channels. You are comfortable analysing large datasets and implementing based on key insights found. You want a role where your skills and hard work will have a material impact and drive results.

Principal Accountabilities

Campaign Management & Execution

  • Execute and optimise campaigns across Paid Social, Paid Search, PMax, and other key channels. 

  • Optimise creative, user journeys, campaign structures, and targeting, with structured experiments & test-and-learn roadmaps to scale results efficiently.

  • Provide key insights to help develop channel strategy and investment allocation.

Data & Reporting 

  • Ensure all activity is tracked comprehensively and maintain accurate reporting of campaigns and creative. 

  • Provide clear and actionable recommendations by analysing performance data.

Marketing Technology & Automation 

  • Set up and optimise workflows and integrations using tools like HubSpot and Zapier. 

  • Use AI and automation to improve speed, scale, and campaign effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Work closely with Brand, Product, Sales, Data, and Compliance to ensure aligned, compliant acquisition.

Contribute to go-to-market planning and unify performance with brand-led growth.

Personal Attributes & Experience Skills & Experience

  • 2-4 years hands-on experience executing and scaling high-performing Performance Marketing campaigns, ideally with a strong focus on Meta Ads and Google ads within Fintech. 

  • Experience running test-and-learn programmes at scale, with specific focus on creative testing systems and user journey testing. 

  • Strong modelling and analysis skills using Excel and other analytics & visualisation tools.  Understanding of attribution, tagging, and offline conversion tracking, with experience optimising campaigns to pipeline events.

  • Familiar with HubSpot, Zapier, and basic no-code automation.

  • Bonus: Working proficiency with SQL.

  • Bonus: Exposure to Financial Promotions or regulated industries.

Mindset & Working Style

  • Analytical and data-driven - comfortable making decisions from performance metrics.

  • Proactive and self-starting working with speed and autonomy. 

  • Use AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency and results. 

  • A fast learner who thrives in high-growth, fast-moving environments.

  • Motivated by impact and passionate about helping established businesses thrive through better banking.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.
