title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices.

Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients.

We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider

  • Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job

  • Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations

  • Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow

What you will be doing

1. Security: Codebase, incident management, AI guardrails, fleet management.

These are the main things that you will be focusing during your first months with us:

  • Secure the codebase: workflow permissions, pinned actions, dependency and secret scanning, package security.

  • Run vulnerability watch and build our incident response tooling: establish the blast radius, write the fix, deploy it company-wide, run the postmortem.

  • Define our AI guardrails: we use AI tools heavily and we are embedding them in the product, so we need clear rules on which data those tools may reach and how their output is reviewed before it ships.

  • Develop our fleet management tools to **keep our laptops up-to-date and secure, define and enforce security practices, deploy and maintain management and security tooling to our fleet.

2. Infrastructure management: Compute, data access, observability.

  • Own our AWS compute: VPC and network segmentation, EC2 allocation.

  • Support data storage. As the team and our partner base grow, access to sensitive data has to stay compartmented and auditable. You will be consulted on where data belongs, across RDS, Redshift, PostgreSQL and the rest, and on keeping access to it properly controlled.

  • Build the observability layer: metrics, logs and traces in one place, alerting that fires on real failures.

  • Own secure access to our infrastructure: secure networks, access control and policies, observability.

3. Scalability: Improve the tools we have, choose the ones we will need.

  • Our product is being built and the volume of data coming in keeps growing, which will call for architecture and resources we do not use today. You will be expected to anticipate failures and future needs, and bring your expert knowledge and experience to our systems & designs.

Who you are

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, with security a real part of the job rather than an occasional task.

  • Deep hands-on AWS: IAM and identity management, VPC design, RDS, container orchestration, secrets management, federated authentication for CI.

  • Terraform in production with a real review workflow behind it, and containers you have operated rather than only deployed to.

  • Ownership of CI/CD security, ideally GitHub Actions: supply chain integrity, dependency management, build provenance.

  • Incident response as a practitioner. You have been the person on the hook, not the person who read the report afterwards.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Highly sensitive data in a high-stakes regulated sector: health, finance or defence.

  • Working knowledge of French health data regulation (HDS, CNIL, GDPR), or another regulated environment and the appetite to learn this one quickly.

  • Device management at scale (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or equivalent) and automated joiner, mover and leaver processes.

  • Dagster or a comparable orchestration framework, and PostgreSQL in production.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience relative to the role.

  3. Technical Case: A exercise representative of the real challenges you'll face.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with several people with whom you've worked closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

title: Senior Platform & Security Engineer – Cloud, DevSecOps & AI Agents
descriptionHtml:
🏢 About 21bitcoin

We are 21bitcoin. We believe in a future where Bitcoin is a natural part of everyone's life – simple, secure, and easy to understand.

We're looking for people who want to help build a real mission – not just do a job. With us, you'll take on responsibility early, work with a highly motivated international team and actively shape the future of money.

👋 The role

As a Senior Platform & Security Engineer, you are the hands-on solution architect for our cloud platform, our security, and our AI agent infrastructure. You work within the Platform & Security team and support the Backend team in our AWS environment.

The role combines DevOps, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Security Engineering. You design solutions, build them yourself, and run them in production. You also bring practical AI experience and help us build and operate AI agents in a regulated environment. Moreover, you provide guidance to engineers on other teams when it comes to infrastructure and security.

Tasks

🚀 Your mission

You build the foundation our product and our engineers rely on every day. This is what you own, and what good looks like:

  • A platform teams can rely on: You architect and run our AWS infrastructure as code, with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows that let teams ship faster and with greater confidence.

  • Security by default: You secure our AWS environment across all accounts and build security checks into our pipelines, so engineers ship securely without manual gatekeeping. Findings are fixed on time.

  • Detection and response that works: You build monitoring and alerting where every alert is worth acting on, and you lead security incident response from investigation to post-mortem.

  • AI agents in production: We are moving to agentic coding, and you build the infrastructure for it, for example dedicated, secure environments in which agents can act. You also design, deploy, and operate AI agents that take over repetitive platform and security work in a controlled, auditable way.

  • Architecture and guidance: You turn product and engineering requirements into clear designs and guide other teams through implementation.

🌱 Your first months

Your impact starts on day one. You dive straight into our AWS platform and ship your first changes to production within weeks, not months. From there, core parts of our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security, and AI agents become yours: you set the direction, make the calls, and watch your work run in production. You do none of this alone: together with the team, you drive the work that makes our platform and IT secure and puts AI agents into production. You challenge each other's ideas, share what you learn, and get further together than any of you would alone. We are looking for self-driven engineers who would rather shape a platform than work through a task list. If that is you, you will find the room, the trust, and the responsibility to do it here.

Requirements

🛠️ Your toolbox

These are examples of the technologies we work with, not a complete list.

  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS in a multi-account setup, with serverless and container workloads and networking (VPC, AWS Network Firewall)

  • Infrastructure as Code: for example CDK, OpenTofu, and Terraform, run on a platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud

  • CI/CD & containers: for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI, with GitOps and Docker

  • Observability & incident management: monitoring, alerting, and on-call, for example with Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic, and PagerDuty, Rootly, or incident.io

  • Security: code and pipeline scanning with tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido (SAST, DAST, dependency, container and secrets scanning, IaC security), plus AWS security services such as Amazon Inspector and AWS Security Hub

  • Identity & access: central identity management and zero-trust network access

  • AI & agents: agent platforms such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform

  • Languages: Python, Node.js (TypeScript), Terraform

⭐ What you bring

We are looking for a high performer with an engineering mindset. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and build for where our platform needs to be next year, not only for today's ticket.

  • Senior and hands-on: 5+ years in software engineering and DevOps, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering. You have designed cloud, platform, and security solutions end to end and can explain the trade-offs.

  • You code (must-have): Python, Node.js, and Terraform, at a level where you direct agentic coding tools, review their output critically, and own the result.

  • AWS in depth: Multi-account setups with AWS Organizations and Control Tower, containers and serverless, VPC security design, AWS Network Firewall, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon Inspector, all managed as code with tools such as CDK, OpenTofu, or Terraform.

  • Security in the pipeline and in production: You have built CI/CD pipelines with integrated security scanning (tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or Aikido), operated security controls with logging, monitoring, and alerting, and handled security incidents end to end. You are comfortable being on call.

  • AI in practice: You have applied AI in engineering work and know how to run it responsibly in production. Ideally, you have already built on agent platforms and frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock (AgentCore) or the Claude platform.

  • Ownership and teamwork: You take responsibility for outcomes, explain technical topics clearly to any audience, and treat security as a partnership with engineering, not a gate.

A plus: workflow orchestration with Temporal, Restate, or Inngest, and production experience with a Terraform platform such as env0, Scalr, or Terraform Cloud, as well as GitLab and JumpCloud.

Benefits

💡 Why join 21bitcoin

  • Hybrid work: Work flexibly and meet the team in person at our hubs in Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich a few times per month.

  • Top tech stack: Work with a modern, cloud-native stack across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, observability, security tooling, and AI agents.

  • Learn and improve: Grow across platform, security, architecture, and AI, with real problems to solve and room to develop your skills.

  • Impact across the stack: Your work shapes the platform, the security posture, and the systems that power the product.

  • Ownership and responsibility: Take full ownership of critical systems in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

  • Collaborative team: Join a highly skilled team where collaboration and shared ownership are part of everyday work.

  • Shape the future: Be part of a mission-driven company building Bitcoin financial services and setting new technical standards.

💶 Salary

Salary range: €75,000 – €120,000 gross per year.

Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, previous experience, and location.

📝 How to apply

Please reach out and include a bit about yourself, your resume or CV, examples of past projects, and a few bullet points on why you want to join 21bitcoin and what you expect.

CVs are important, but don't forget to include your favorite Bitcoin meme in your application.

🤝 Interview process

  1. Exploratory call: In a 30-minute call, we discuss what excites you about this role and ask a few questions based on your past experience.

  2. Engineering deep dive: We discuss the specific skills for the role in a 1.5-hour whiteboard session.

  3. Culture and engineering mindset: We get to know each other and talk about how you work, take ownership, and make engineering decisions.

  4. Decision time.

📍 This is a hybrid role. You are based in or near Vienna, Salzburg, or Munich and join us at our hubs a few times per month.

Applications are limited to candidates currently residing in the European Economic Area (EEA).

title: Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager owns the standard, performance and quality of the Autoreverse process, from vehicle receipt through initial disassembly and handover to downstream activities.

The role supports the four Operations sites, works daily with the Operations Managers and interfaces with the Product Manager to ensure that process, quality and product requirements are aligned. The objective is to deliver a safe, repeatable and scalable process for the A2MAC1 Data Factory.

The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures.

As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to:

  • Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites.
  • Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery.
  • Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation.
  • Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites.
  • Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030.

RESPONSABILITIES

1. Process Standards and Methods

  • Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model.
  • Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites.
  • Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined.
  • Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow.

2. Quality and Continuous Improvement

  • Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality.
  • Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing.
  • Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites.

3. Operations Performance

  • Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle.
  • Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps.
  • Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites.
  • Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis.

4. International Coordination and Deployment

  • Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites.
  • Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking.
  • Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites.
  • Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up.
  • Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard.

5. Product and Industrialization Interface

  • Work with the Product Manager to translate product and vehicle evolution into operational process requirements.
  • Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality.
  • Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives.
  • Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment.

6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution

  • Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager.
  • Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse.

title: Senior Producer
descriptionHtml:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the UK and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.

MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry. 

With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.

About the Role

As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.

You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.

What You Will Do

  • Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.
  • Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.
  • Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.
  • Coordinate development across Product, Game Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management.
  • Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.
  • Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.
  • Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.
  • Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.
  • Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.
  • Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
  • Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.
  • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.
  • Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.
  • Champion improvements to development workflows, production practices, tooling, and cross-functional collaboration across the Live Game organization.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in game production, with significant experience in mobile free-to-play or live-service games.
  • Proven experience managing the development and delivery of mobile game features, systems, content, events, or other player-facing experiences.
  • Strong understanding of Live Operations, including high-frequency content delivery, live calendars, release cycles, remote configuration, QA validation, launch readiness, and post-launch support.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent development workstreams with complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong understanding of roadmap planning, milestone management, critical-path tracking, risk management, change management, and delivery readiness.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams, with an understanding of client/server dependencies, configuration, integration, and mobile release considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage dependency escalation, negotiate tradeoffs, and create accountability across teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for the quality and accuracy of production information.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar project-management systems.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, from shaping a development roadmap to following individual deliverables through completion.
  • A player-focused mindset and passion for building engaging, polished, and continuously evolving mobile game experiences.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Is highly organized, structured, dependable, and comfortable operating in a high-volume Live Operations environment.
  • Understands the realities of mobile free-to-play development, including rapid iteration, global releases, frequent content updates, live player impact, and operational precision.
  • Drives outcomes beyond task tracking and status reporting.
  • Anticipates problems before they become delivery issues.
  • Communicates directly, diplomatically, and consistently across global teams and time zones.
  • Creates accountability without unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
  • Is comfortable challenging unclear plans, identifying gaps, and driving decisions.
  • Can manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on the critical path.
  • Brings sound judgment, energy, and a collaborative mindset to a fast-paced, globally distributed development organization.
  • Cares deeply about both the quality of the player experience and the operational excellence required to deliver it.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Trust and Safety at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable. You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.

You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.

The ideal candidate

  • 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

  • Strong mobile app and web experience

  • Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

  • Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

  • Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

  • AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

  • Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

  • Bonus:

    • Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)

    • Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools

    • Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty

    • UX writing

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

  • Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

  • Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

  • Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

  • Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

  • Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

  • Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

  • Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own

Our design principles

  1. Simplicity wins

    1. If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.

  2. Evidence over ego

    1. We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior.

  3. Trust is our best feature

    1. Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them.

Interview Process

  • CV screening

  • An introductory call with someone from the Talent Team and/or hiring manager

  • A take-home exercise to complete in your own time

  • Task debrief with members of the design team (45 mins)

  • Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):

    • VP Product & Design

    • Engineering team members

    • Final round interview with our CPO

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

IMPORTANT - this role is initially offered as a 24-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension depending on business needs.

We see design as a crucial element of achieving our mission, so designers are represented at all levels, including senior leadership. As our new Senior Product Designer, you will be empowered to concentrate on design solutions for people’s needs. The design organisation is well established and our impact is highly valued. That means you will be able to fully focus on your contribution to our success. 

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our Security domain. The team works to keep Vinted safe and trusted without compromising the member experience. This work goes beyond preventing fraud and abuse: you’ll also shape a new, high-impact member-facing experience that broadens how people can safely access and use Vinted.

As a Senior Product Designer in Security, you’ll own complex, ambiguous product problems from discovery through delivery, turning questions around trust, access, and protection into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data analysts, content designers, and other designers, balancing strong safeguards with clarity and ease for millions of members.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Work with cross-functional partners to be the voice of our members, define problems and goals, map flows, prototype interactions, and support the development process.
  • Own complex product work end to end, from framing the right problem and defining the experience architecture through prototyping, implementation, launch, and iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted building tools to turn ideas into working experiences, test assumptions early, and accelerate delivery, while critically assessing their output and knowing when human judgement is essential.
  • Partner up with other domain designers to work on initiatives that keep raising design quality and user-centeredness maturity. 
  • Conduct usability tests to assess and validate design ideas and collaborate with User Researchers on discovery and generative studies.
  • Give and solicit feedback from designers and cross-functional partners.
  • Be part of our Security domain and report to the Product Design Director.

About you 

  • Strong proven experience (typically 5+ years) designing complex web or native mobile products and taking them from ambiguous problem spaces through implementation, launch, and measurable outcomes.
  • Interaction design, visual design and evaluative user research skills. 
  • Good at working with complex systems
  • Excellent communication skills, including excellent written and spoken English.
  • Good understanding of the design process, designing with qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • A strong collaborator with cross-functional peers.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted prototyping or building tools to create, test, and ship working product experiences.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strategic impact, complex problem-solving, and proof of shipping, including your personal contribution, delivery trade-offs, collaboration through implementation, and what changed after launch.
  • Experience contributing code-based prototypes or pull requests within an engineering workflow is a plus.

Only applications that include a portfolio will be considered.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday

  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Senior Product Management Builder (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

 

Your opportunity:

AI is shifting how the best products get built. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread.

At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders.

A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions.

Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized.

Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. If building the thing sounds more natural to you than describing it, this role is for you.

 

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped product. Write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, and get it in front of users, with as few handoffs as possible. Own the full loop.

  • Compress research, synthesis, and spec-writing from weeks into hours. You reach for AI tools not because you’ve been asked to, but because they faster make you faster in delivering high quality outcome. You know when to trust the output, when to edit it, and when to reject it. Use AI as a force multiplier.

  • You structure fuzzy problems, identify what should and shouldn’t be built, and move forward when there are dozens of possible directions. The magic is in the trade-offs, not the feature list. Turn ambiguous ideas into things users can trust.

  • You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-related product work, translating AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, and outputs into clear product decisions. You work effectively in hybrid human-AI teams. Work in small, focused teams.

  • You know the metric your team is trying to move. You measure your week by what changed in user behaviour, not by how many tickets moved to Done. Be accountable to outcomes, not roadmaps.

  • You give feedback directly, to anyone, regardless of level. You raise blockers early and in the open. Push back when something’s wrong. Team player who raises the bar.

 

Your profile:

Your craft

  • 5+ years experience in Product Management (ideally in fintech or B2B). You’ve shipped things that real people use, and you can point to the metric that moved when you did.

  • Understand implicitly the product development process - from discovery, to user research to experimentation. You are able to build and defend a compelling strategy that solves user needs.

  • You have a builder track record: you’ve made things with AI, not just written specs about them. Shipped products, agent workflows, or tools real users have touched. Any of these count whether at work or in your personal life.

  • You’re AI-native by default. You use tools like Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or similar regularly. You follow the AI product space closely and you know the difference between a demo and something production-ready.

  • You’ve built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster. You know when to trust AI output, when to edit it, and when to reject it.

  • You’ve gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief to be written for you. The output was good enough that a team shipped from it.

  • Low PM baggage: you’re not attached to how product management "should" be done. You care about outcomes, not territory.

  • When designing and shipping AI-enabled products, you consider privacy, safety, fairness, transparency, bias, and accountability. You assess when AI-generated outputs are appropriate for use and raise concerns when risks or limitations are identified.

Your range

  • Across all three disciplines, you can hold your own: in Product you can identify opportunities, assess impact, and prioritize ruthlessly. In Design, you have taste: you know when something looks right but feels wrong. In Engineering, you’ve used AI coding tools to build something real, and you’re not dependent on an engineer to tell you why it’s broken.

How you work

  • Data fluency: you know the metric you were trying to move, and you can say whether you moved it, with healthy skepticism about what metrics do and don’t tell you.

  • You believe in experimentation and ship with velocity to learn quickly. You know your way around AB tests and are excited to try new data science models to learn faster.

  • You’ve worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people, and that raised your bar, not lowered it.

  • You’ve found a way through blockers rather than waiting to be unblocked. When something was genuinely impossible, you documented why and moved on.

  • You bring an entrepreneurial and independent mindset. You are excited about spotting opportunities and then acting on them.

  • Fluency in English is required (German is a plus).

This role is not for you if…

  • You’re not genuinely excited about being able to stretch across design and engineering functions.

  • You’ve never built an AI prototype and/or shipped code, side projects count.

  • You pride yourself in what you delivered rather than its impact

  • You need certainty, a full brief, or someone else’s research to get started.

  • You don’t believe in fast learning and getting things into customers hands early and use

 

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal tech meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

 

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
The challenge
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.

These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale the Calling for Work product proposition from 1 to 100. There's no mature roadmap to inherit: you'll write it, test it with customers and scale what works, with our Product & Tech team, to deliver a step change in segment growth.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product proposition: Set the vision, strategy, roadmap and targets for Calling for Work, and be responsible for its user growth and retention.

  • Shape the business proposition: Define what Talk360's business offer is and how it's priced, together with our commercial teams.

  • Learn from customers continuously: Use interviews, surveys, support tickets and app store reviews to turn pains into a ranked opportunity roadmap.

  • Lead delivery: Work in an agile Product & Tech team; keep scope tight, priorities clear and releases flowing.

The Team

What you’ll bring

Who you are

Recruitment process

  1. First call: A short intro call with our recruiter.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
  • Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

Must haves:

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
  • Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.
  • Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.
  • Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.
  • The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.
  • Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.
  • Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.
  • Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.
  • You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.

Important attributes for this role:

  • You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from

  • Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
  • A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
  • Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
  • Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
  • Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
  • Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
  • You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: (Senior) Product Manager – Legal AI Scaleup
descriptionHtml:
Du entscheidest, was wir bauen und über 450 Kanzleien täglich nutzen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken – Du hast eine eigene, begründete Meinung dazu, wohin sich Legal AI entwickelt, und denkst in Markt und Wirkung, nicht nur in Features.

Wenn du nicht alles erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen Potenzial, nicht Perfektion.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - Procurement & Portfolio Management (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As Product Manager Procurement & Portfolio Management, you take on one of the most strategically defining product roles within our energy retail business: you design how 1KOMMA5° procures, hedges, and optimizes electricity for an increasingly flexible customer portfolio. You sit at the intersection of energy markets, energy procurement, our flexibility assets, and our customer-facing tariff strategy - and you turn this into a measurable commercial advantage.

  • Own our Procurement Strategy: Define how and where 1KOMMA5° procures energy for our customer portfolio - across day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets. Develop a clear market split logic, and continuously refine it based on portfolio characteristics, customer mix, and market conditions.
  • Design Portfolio Hedging & Risk Management: Build hedging and risk management strategies tailored to different customer portfolios (dynamic vs fixed tariffs or flexibility/ancillary services). Define when and how we lock in volumes, what we leave open, and how we balance commercial upside against risk exposure.
  • Shape Our Flexibility Procurement Model: Design how we procure and steer our flexibility portfolio. Defining models such as flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price-based offers, and the trade-offs between them. Develop the commercial logic and the operational requirements for each model.
  • Run Quantitative Portfolio Analysis: Independently run analyses on procurement performance, hedging effectiveness, and portfolio economics. Build the analytical foundation that supports strategic decisions, identifies optimization opportunities, and quantifies the impact of changes to our procurement and steering setup.
  • Monitor Performance and Drive Continuous Improvement: Define KPIs across procurement cost, hedge effectiveness, portfolio risk, and flexibility margin. Use data to continuously sharpen our market positioning and commercial performance.

Dein Profil

General:

  • 4+ years of experience in (international) energy procurement, portfolio management, or energy trading, ideally in a utility, energy retailer, trading desk, or aggregator environment
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience running portfolio analyses, hedge calculations, and market scenarios (Python, SQL, or comparable tools are a strong plus)
  • Proven ability to translate market and commercial logic into structured processes and product requirements
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving market environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Market & Domain Expertise:

  • Deep understanding of European power markets - day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets - and the mechanisms that drive prices
  • Solid working knowledge of hedging instruments (futures, options, OTC), balancing markets, and BRP settlement
  • Familiarity with flexibility products and procurement models (flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price offers) and their commercial trade-offs
  • Awareness of regulatory frameworks shaping energy retail (Marktkommunikationsprozesse, balancing regimes, market design developments)
  • Experience working with external procurement partners, ETRM systems, or trading platforms is a strong plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups
  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Senior Research Scientist, 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
descriptionHtml:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Senior 3D Reconstruction and Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. 

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models
  • Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)
  • Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties
  • Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)
  • Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories
  • Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)
  • Collaborate with Engineering teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware
  • Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data 

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Education: PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .
  • 3D Vision: Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation.
  • Modern Deep Learning: Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)
  • Programming & Systems: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

  • Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus
  • Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms

title: Senior Sales Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fundamental XR builds VR and haptic training solutions for the med-tech, med-device, and pharma industries. We're VC-backed and our market position is unique.

We already work with some of the biggest names in the industry; Philips, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Orbis, Abiomed, Vicarious Surgical, Novartis, and Allergan, among others.

Our target markets are pouring investment into VR, AR, XR, and AI right now. That timing, combined with warm accounts that have room to grow and large enterprise logos still
untapped, means the ceiling on this role is high.

Where we see this hire having a real impact

You'll help set the standard for how we sell. Your cadence, outreach approach, and account strategy will become the model others follow.

  • Generate your own pipeline. You'll be responsible for identifying, developing, and selling new business opportunities. We expect the successful candidate to have strong SDR fundamentals, tailored email, proficient on the phone and create bespoke LinkedIn outreach as well as building the confidence to work our target market in person at industry events.

  • Grow warm accounts. Take existing relationships with room to expand and turn them into larger, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Use data to drive and defend your strategy. You'll need to tell a clear, data-backed story of who you're targeting and why, spot when a channel or approach isn't working and pivot quickly, and double down, increasing cadence and investment on the tactics that prove fruitful.

  • Collaborate with other teams. Following our new ‘Solution Sales’ process, where an SME / MedEd / PO is engaged early in customer conversations to appropriately understand customer requirements, define scope and liaising with CSM to define how business outcomes will be measured and articulated to client on live project

  • Strengthen the sales team culture by focusing on delivery and hands-on mentoring of junior team members.

  • Help review our sales software stack helping figure out what works for us, what software or services are critical and supporting the successful roll out

Who we think we be successful in this role

  • Proven track record closing complex, high-value deals (six figures and above), ideally in a solution-sale or enterprise environment.

  • Comfortable and effective with SDR-style outreach: cold email, LinkedIn, calling and event-based prospecting.

  • Experience selling into large enterprise or matrixed organisations, ideally med-tech, med-device, pharma, healthcare, or another regulated/technical market.

  • A creative, hypothesis-driven approach to sales - someone who tests new angles rather than defaulting to "how it's always been done."

  • Confidence operating without a fully mature playbook, and the drive to help build one.

  • Comfortable working with data and CRM reporting to justify targeting decisions, track what's working, and adjust cadence and channel mix based on results rather than instinct alone.

  • Excellent stakeholder management across clinical, procurement, and commercial buyers.

  • Experience driving smart adoption of available tools using agentic AI for persona and target company research, for example, delivering results faster and at greater scale.

What We Offer

  • A penthouse office in Farringdon with unlimited snacks and soft drinks

  • £250/year work-from-home budget to build a setup that works for you

The Senior Sales Director will be responsible for driving strategic new business, expanding relationships with Pacvue’s largest global clients, and delivering exceptional value across every stage of the sales process. This senior individual contributor role is ideal for a highly motivated, consultative seller who thrives in complex enterprise environments. The Senior Sales Director will excel at identifying opportunities, building deep partnerships, and positioning Pacvue’s platform as the leading solution for brands and retailers in the rapidly evolving commerce landscape. This role will focus on acquiring new strategic enterprise clients, leading complex, high-value sales pursuits and expanding Pacvue’s presence among the world’s largest brands and retailers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Understand and learn about the e-commerce industry and competitive environment including knowledge of competitive product offerings. Provide market insights, competitive intelligence, and enterprise customer feedback to help inform Pacvue’s enterprise sales strategy.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Sales Operations Manager - Partnerships

Location: Berlin (office-first)
Contract: Permanent

Team description

Partnerships is where SumUp is growing into a full service platform for integrators and enterprise partners, and Sales Operations keeps that growth running, from partner budgets and payments to the pipeline data that shows what's working. In this role, you'll take full ownership of the Sales Operations process domain from your first weeks and shape it for the long term, becoming the main point of reference for how our processes, tools and ways of working fit together. You'll also shape how we measure progress and success.

What you'll do

  • Own the Sales Operations process domain for Partnerships and act as the main point of reference for how processes, tools and teams work together
  • Design, automate and improve Partnerships processes
  • Review how commission and revenue share payments work, find ways to improve them and source a tool where needed
  • Build Salesforce reporting and monitoring that tracks partner interactions , proposals and process KPIs, so the team can see progress and act on it
  • Be the bridge between our Partnerships and Data, Systems and Finance teams to turn feedback from process users into improvements, supported by training and clear documentation

What you'll bring

  • Solid experience in a similar role, with a strong foundation in leading complex projects or strategic consulting
  • Experience optimising sales and budget processes across regions and functions, with strong skills in process automation.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce and other business systems, including shaping stages, fields and reporting around a sales pipeline. Expert level skills in Excel or Google Sheets and AI native.
  • Ability to turn business needs into clear specifications for technical teams, and to source and evaluate new tools.
  • Experience working closely with sales and finance teams within a fast paced and agile environment.
  • A pragmatic and proactive approach, and the ability to keep moving through change and uncertainty.

Nice to have: experience in people management, such as managing or mentoring others.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚵 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success.
