title: Senior Software Engineer (Capacity and Quota Management)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong knowledge of Python or willingness to quickly become productive with our technology stack

  • Experience building distributed backend systems and microservice architectures

  • Understanding of distributed transactions, consistency models, and reliable asynchronous workflows

  • Strong communication and ownership mindset

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data and Orchestration
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Data and Orchestration team in London builds the platforms behind Wayve's data engineering, orchestration and inference workflows. Our infrastructure lets partner teams ingest, process and transform high-volume data from external vendors, vehicle fleets and customer programmes, and we make sure those systems are reliable, efficient and easy to use.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You'll help evolve Wayve's data pipeline platform. That means revamping our existing Harness system and building a new DAG-based orchestration system for our fleet's next-generation data volumes. You'll work on infrastructure used across the company, supporting high-priority data runs, batch inference, evaluations and business-critical incident response, and you'll work closely with partner teams to understand what they need from their pipelines.

🧩 What you'll be working on

  • Designing, building and evolving scalable data pipeline and orchestration infrastructure for Wayve's next-generation autonomous driving data platform

  • Revamping the existing Harness system and developing a new DAG-based workflow platform

  • Building tooling and libraries that make data ingestion, processing, inference and evaluation workflows simple, reliable and consistent across teams

  • Making sure the platform runs hundreds of parallel pipeline steps efficiently, with correct outputs, no conflicts and effective resource prioritisation

  • Supporting batch inference and performance optimisation workflows, so teams can run evaluations in a cost-effective and scalable way

  • Improving platform reliability, quality and usability, including incident response workflows aligned to business-defined SLOs

🙌 You should apply if

  • Essential

    • Strong software engineering fundamentals and solid Python programming skills, with experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade systems

    • Experience building or operating DAG-based workflow orchestration and data pipeline systems, using tools such as Airflow, Dagster or Flyte.

    • Experience with distributed computing frameworks such as Ray or Spark

    • Experience working with systems at scale, ideally involving distributed systems, large data volumes or high-throughput processing

    • Experience deploying and operating production workloads on Kubernetes, including troubleshooting issues and managing resources for reliable, scalable data-processing services.

    • Familiarity with distributed event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka

    • Strong understanding of database principles and consistency models—including eventual and strong consistency in distributed systems—with practical familiarity with relational databases and data warehouses such as Postgres and ClickHouse

    • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with platform users and partner teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions

    Desirable

    • Experience with machine learning infrastructure, inference systems or ML performance optimisation

    • Exposure to large-scale batch processing, compute scheduling or resource prioritisation

    • Experience building shared libraries, developer tooling or internal platforms used across multiple teams

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen

  • HM Meeting + Domain interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [programming, systems & domain-specific interview; 2 hours total]

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Runtime Team
descriptionHtml:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Runtime team at PolyAI.  This team owns the core voice infrastructure that powers every call our AI agents handle - from the moment a phone rings to the moment it hangs up.

You'll work across the full real-time voice stack: telephony, real-time audio streaming and media handling, speech recognition and synthesis integration, LLM orchestration, turn-taking and voice activity detection, call recording, and the data pipeline that captures it all. We operate across AWS and Azure, serving enterprise customers at scale across multiple global regions.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and build features across the voice runtime - from new integrations with third-party contact centre platforms, to improving how our agents handle interruptions and overlapping speech, to scaling our infrastructure for higher call volumes.
  • Own services end-to-end: write code, review PRs from across the company, deploy to production, and support what you ship.
  • Debug complex, cross-service issues in production - the kind where a timing problem involves VAD thresholds, ASR transcription windows, LLM response latency, and audio playback all interacting at once.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and design documents. The team has strong thought leadership on stateful vs stateless service boundaries, API design, and where responsibilities should live.
  • Collaborate with product facing teams who build on top of the runtime - helping them understand configuration, troubleshooting call behaviour, and unblocking their work.
  • Improve the developer experience: better defaults, less reliance on opaque config, more features controllable through the UI, and better test coverage.

What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 4+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Strong experience with real-time or latency-sensitive systems: streaming, media pipelines, networking, or similar domains where milliseconds matter.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems: gRPC, state management across services, connection error recovery, and working with systems that must not drop calls.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS (EKS/Kubernetes, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Redis) - comfortable deploying containerised services and debugging infrastructure-level issues.
  • Strong written communication - design docs, PR reviews, and async debugging are core to how the team works.

Strong plus:

  • Experience with speech technologies: ASR, TTS, VAD, or end-of-turn detection — either integrating them or working on the systems around them.
  • Experience with Go - this is the primary language for our voice services. Most engineers on the team work across both Go and Python.
  • Experience with Python - parts of our LLM orchestration layer, serverless function runtime, and data pipeline are Python.
  • Prior work on LLM orchestration or agent frameworks: tool calling, function execution, prompt management, context window management, or conversation state machines.
  • Experience with data pipeline technologies: Kafka, ClickHouse, S3-based event stores, or similar.
  • Experience with observability at scale: Datadog, structured logging, SLO/SLI definition, and using metrics to drive reliability improvements.
  • Multi-cloud experience (Azure in addition to AWS).
  • Familiarity with VoIP/telephony (SIP, RTP) or WebRTC (STUN/TURN/ICE, media negotiation).
 

Benefits

descriptionHtml:
Die Triathlon Group, eine Tochtergesellschaft der Sunlight Group, ist ein führender globaler Anbieter von Batteriesystemen, Ladegeräten und Energiemanagementlösungen für industrielle Anwendungen. Mit über 1.600 Mitarbeitenden an Standorten auf drei Kontinenten ermöglicht Triathlon durch innovative Produkte auf Basis von Blei-Säure- und Lithium-Ionen-Technologie sowie durch ein starkes Serviceversprechen zuverlässige und effiziente Prozesse für unsere Industriekunden – insbesondere in der Intralogistik.

Bei der Triathlon Group legen wir großen Wert darauf, gemeinsam als Team erfolgreich zu sein und unseren Mitarbeitenden Raum für persönliche Weiterentwicklung zu bieten. Wir pflegen einen respektvollen und fairen Umgang miteinander und fördern eine Unternehmenskultur, in der jeder – unabhängig von Position oder Betriebszugehörigkeit – seine Ideen und Initiativen einbringen kann. Dabei setzen wir auf agile Arbeitsweisen und bieten vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem inklusiven und chancengerechten Umfeld.

Gemeinsam mit der Sunlight Group gehört Triathlon zu den am schnellsten wachsenden globalen Anbietern im dynamischen Energiespeichermarkt und beschäftigt insgesamt mehr als 3.800 Mitarbeitende.

Aufgabenbereich

Steuer-Compliance & Reporting

  • Verantwortung für die steuerliche Compliance aller deutschen Gesellschaften sowie Sicherstellung der fristgerechten und ordnungsgemäßen Abgabe von Körperschaftsteuer-, Umsatzsteuer- und weiteren gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Steuererklärungen
  • Erstellung und Überprüfung von Steuerbilanzen, Steuerberechnungen sowie latenten Steuern im Rahmen der Jahresabschlüsse
  • Sicherstellung der vollständigen Einhaltung der deutschen Steuergesetze, Vorschriften und Berichtsanforderungen

Steuerberatung & Risikomanagement

  • Überprüfung steuerlicher Berechnungen, Abzüge und Gutschriften zur Minimierung von Risiken und Optimierung der Steuerposition
  • Fachliche Beratung zu deutschen Steuerthemen, einschließlich der körperschaftsteuerlichen, der umsatzsteuerlichen Organschaft sowie der Grunderwerbsteuer (RETT)
  • Unterstützung bei Betriebsprüfungen, Kommunikation mit Steuerbehörden sowie Abstimmung mit externen Beratern

Verrechnungspreise & Intercompany-Transaktionen

  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung und Überprüfung von Verrechnungspreisdokumentationen gemäß den deutschen Anforderungen
  • Abstimmung konzerninterner Transaktionen deutscher Gesellschaften und Sicherstellung ihrer korrekten steuerlichen Behandlung

Internationale Steuern & Pillar Two

  • Überwachung der Einhaltung von Pillar-Two-Vorschriften, einschließlich der erforderlichen Dokumentation und Meldungen
  • Unterstützung bei Country-by-Country-Reporting-Prozessen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Group-Tax-Team bei internationalen steuerlichen Fragestellungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Transaktionen mit US-Gesellschaften

Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Finance, Accounting und Group Tax zur Sicherstellung einer abgestimmten steuerlichen Behandlung und Berichterstattung
  • Ansprechpartner sowie vertrauenswürdiger Berater für interne Stakeholder in Bezug auf steuerliche Auswirkungen in Deutschland

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Steuern, Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im deutschen Unternehmenssteuerrecht, idealerweise in einem internationalen Umfeld
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Körperschaftsteuer- und Umsatzsteuerrechts, der Organschaftsregelungen sowie der Grunderwerbsteuer (RETT)
  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Verrechnungspreisdokumentationen und im Umgang mit konzerninternen Transaktionen
  • Kenntnisse zu Pillar Two sowie im internationalen Steuerreporting sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit SAP ist wünschenswert
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind von großem Vorteil
  • Zusätzliche steuerliche Qualifikationen (z. B. die Vorbereitung auf das Steuerberaterexamen oder eine vergleichbare Zertifizierung) sind von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Stabiles Arbeitsumfeld in einem internationalen Unternehmen mit breiten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein motiviertes Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien, Agilität und kurzen Entscheidungswegen in einem zukunftsorientierten Marktumfeld (Lithium-Ionen-Batterien)
  • Ein freundliches Team, welches fachlich mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht
  • Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Betriebliche Sozialleistungen sowie die Möglichkeit des BusinessBike-Leasings für 2 Fahrräder
  • Unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
  • Eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit remote zu arbeiten
  • Hunde am Arbeitsplatz sind herzlich Willkommen!

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
locations: United States, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, France, DRC, India
descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Every payment we process runs on the infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are building a platform that lets product teams run across multiple clouds and regions. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against.

This is a senior role in an established, fast-moving team. You will own the multi-cloud and multi-region programme end to end: the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the roadmap. You will bring enough technical depth to work as a peer with our engineers and architects, and pair it with a product mindset: you treat the platform as a product with internal customers, and you judge success by whether those teams adopt it.

As a Senior Technical Programme Manager, you are responsible for delivering the programme across teams you don't manage. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

  • A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers. You won’t need low level knowledge but you should be comfortable discussing networking between clouds and regions, identity and access, infrastructure as code pipelines, and what latency, data residency and failover mean for payments workloads

  • Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS

  • Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders

  • Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you.

  • Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Run the programme end to end, from sequencing the work through to production, across several teams and multiple cloud providers.

  • Own the roadmap. Understand what product engineering teams need before they can deploy into Azure or a new cloud region, help decide which paved roads come first, and set adoption measures we can report on.

  • Turn architecture decisions into delivery plans. Work with our senior engineers and architects on design trade-offs, make sure decisions get written down, and spot when a decision is blocking delivery.

  • Manage dependencies and risk across teams you don't control, and escalate early, with options, when something is going to slip.

  • Build compliance from the start. PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 apply to most of what this programme touches, and control requirements need to show up in the plan, before any production workloads go live.

  • Keep the delivery records honest. Our roadmap lives in Jira Product Discovery and delivery in Jira; you'll work with the relevant teams to make sure both reflect what is actually happening.

  • Use AI tools in how you run the programme: status reporting, dependency analysis, drafting and keeping documentation current. We use them heavily and expect you to as well.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Senior Treasury Specialist (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte unsere Treasury-Strukturen und schaffe Transparenz über Liquidität und Cashflows für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und entwickelt seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter. Dabei schaffen wir die Treasury-Strukturen und Prozesse, die wir benötigen, um unsere Liquidität zuverlässig zu steuern, finanzielle Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen und unser internationales Wachstum nachhaltig zu unterstützen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Treasury-Themen - von Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme. Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem Finance-Team zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und schaffst Strukturen, die mit unserem Unternehmen und unseren internationalen Gesellschaften mitwachsen.

Du verbindest fundierte Treasury-Expertise mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer zunehmend global ausgerichteten Treasury-Funktion aktiv mitzugestalten.

Warum diese Rolle?

Treasury aktiv aufbauen: Du übernimmst nicht einfach bestehende Strukturen, sondern gestaltest unsere Treasury-Prozesse und Standards in einer entscheidenden Wachstumsphase aktiv mit.

Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Strukturen: Du kannst bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln und direkt umsetzen. Dabei ist Deine Expertise gefragt, auch wenn es darum geht, neue Wege zu finden.

Internationaler Impact: Du wirkst am Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung mit und schaffst die Grundlage für mehr Transparenz und einheitliche Standards über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Skalierbarkeit: Du entwickelst Prozesse und Reporting weiter, nutzt digitale Lösungen und schaffst effiziente Abläufe, die auch mit zunehmender Komplexität funktionieren.

Nähe zu Finance Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise in Liquiditätssteuerung, Finanzierungsfragen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen ein.

Dein nächster Karriereschritt: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Deine Rolle perspektivisch zu einer Treasury-Lead- oder Global-Treasury-Manager-Position mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung entwickeln.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Cash Forecasting & Liquiditätsmanagement: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cash-Forecasts und schaffst Transparenz über Liquidität, Zahlungsströme und den Finanzierungsbedarf unserer internationalen Gesellschaften.

Treasury-Strukturen & Prozesse: Du entwickelst zuverlässige Treasury-Prozesse, Zuständigkeiten und Standards weiter und unterstützt den Aufbau einer global abgestimmten Treasury-Steuerung über Länder- und Gesellschaftsgrenzen hinweg.

Automatisierung & Reporting: Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Automatisierung von Forecasting, Reporting und wiederkehrenden Treasury-Abläufen und setzt skalierbare, systemgestützte Lösungen um. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer SAP S/4HANA Cloud aktiv mit und schöpfst deren Potenzial voll aus.

Finanzierung & Analysen: Du unterstützt bei Finanzierungsaktivitäten, beispielsweise im Zusammenhang mit Wandeldarlehen, erstellst Analysen und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für interne Stakeholder vor.

Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting und dem HQ-Finance-Team zusammen, koordinierst Treasury-Themen mit relevanten internen und externen Stakeholdern und treibst Verbesserungen eigenständig voran.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Treasury, insbesondere im Cash Forecasting und Liquiditätsmanagement

  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, um Prozesse auch in einem wachsenden Umfeld eigenständig aufzubauen

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Strukturen oder mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Standards zu entwickeln

  • Interesse an Automatisierung, digitalen Systemen und skalierbaren Prozessverbesserungen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale Treasury-Themen und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Treasury-Strukturen aktiv mit. Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Dein Verantwortungsbereich perspektivisch bis hin zu einer Treasury-Lead- oder Global-Treasury-Manager-Rolle mit internationaler Verantwortung und dem Aufbau eines kleinen Teams entwickeln.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

title: Service- & Vertriebsassistenz (m/w/d): Organisationstalent mit Anpacker-Mentalität
descriptionHtml:
Vielleicht suchen wir genau dich.

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf, wir suchen einen Menschen.

Einen, der nicht montagmorgens schon auf Freitag wartet. Einen, der nicht ständig fragt: „Wer ist dafür zuständig?“, sondern eher: „Was kann ich tun?“

Wir suchen jemanden mit Bock auf Menschen. Auf Verantwortung. Darauf, Dinge anzupacken und am Ende des Tages zu sehen, was man geschafft hat.

Denn ganz ehrlich:
Wenn du einfach nur einen Job suchst, um irgendwo deine Stunden abzusitzen, sind wir wahrscheinlich nicht füreinander gemacht.

Wenn du aber denkst:

„Ich kann mehr. Ich will mehr. Und ich möchte zeigen, was ich kann.“

… dann wird es interessant.

Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Autohaus in Leer und vertreten die Marken Toyota und Mitsubishi. Bei uns arbeiten Verkauf, Service und Werkstatt eng zusammen – und genau an dieser Schnittstelle suchen wir Verstärkung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Als Service- & Vertriebsassistenz bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, der Werkstatt, dem Verkauf und dem restlichen Team.

Kundenkontakt & Organisation

  • Du bist persönlich, telefonisch und per E-Mail eine der ersten Anlaufstellen für unsere Kunden.
  • Du nimmst Kundenanliegen auf, koordinierst sie und sorgst dafür, dass sie beim richtigen Ansprechpartner landen.
  • Du behältst Termine, Wiedervorlagen und offene Vorgänge im Blick und fasst bei Bedarf selbstständig nach.
  • Auch wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, sorgst du dafür, dass nichts untergeht.

Service & kaufmännische Abwicklung

  • Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung, Bearbeitung und Nachbereitung von Werkstattaufträgen.
  • Du kümmerst dich um Abrechnung, Zahlungsverkehr, Kasse und offene Posten.
  • Du bereitest wiederkehrende kaufmännische Vorgänge wie den Monatsabschluss zuverlässig vor.

title: SIP Expert
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a SIP Expert to own the telephony layer that connects ElevenAgents voice agents to the phone network. SIP traffic is moving from early adoption to large enterprise call volumes, so the hard problems are now reliability and latency at scale.

Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Owning SIP end to end, from design doc to implementation, testing and ongoing operation, for a product used by enterprises at scale.

  • Making call flows such as warm transfers dependable, and simplifying how our call services communicate with each other.

  • Diagnosing and fixing load-related failures such as resource exhaustion and dropped connections.

  • Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features.

Specific responsibilities might include:

  • Making our SIP edge and routing layer production-ready for large enterprise traffic.

  • Designing and shipping lightweight, lower-latency call-handling services.

  • Supporting carrier and SIP trunk integrations for enterprise customers.

You will join a small team of five, reporting directly to the team lead, with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or open source contributions.

We do require:

  • Experience building and operating large-scale SIP/VoIP systems in production, including debugging load-related failures such as port exhaustion, dropped connections and state shared across services

  • Hands-on experience running LiveKit (or comparable real-time media infrastructure) at scale, with comfort in WebSockets, WebRTC and RTP

  • Strong backend engineering in Go or a comparable systems language, and a record of owning projects from design document through launch and maintenance

  • Based in Europe or a nearby time zone, with at least 2 to 3 hours of daily overlap with CET

Bonus: Hands-on experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS/FreeSWITCH), or carrier and SIP trunk interconnects.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or nearby time zones, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 time zones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London and Warsaw.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. The Roku TV organization builds technology used on millions of TVs globally, and the team is already applying AI to demanding TV problems in resource-constrained environments where quality, performance, and reliability matter.
As part of this team, you will help define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated for Roku TV use cases. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who treats AI agent design as an engineering discipline: architecting durable systems, grounding them in the right context, integrating them with tools and services, and making them reliable in production.

What is the role?

We are looking for a hands-on, systems-oriented Agentic AI Engineer of roughly 2-5 years experience to design, build, and maintain intelligent agents and copilots that drive automation, accelerate workflows, and unlock new product and platform capabilities for Roku TV. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development—from prototyping and architecture through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
You will contribute directly to Roku’s AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring strong real-world performance in production environments.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI agents and copilots for Roku TV use cases, integrating them with internal systems, tools, and services.
  • Own end-to-end agentic systems from concept to production, including model selection, prompt and context design, retrieval strategies, backend services, and conversational interfaces.
  • Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including handoffs, delegation, and cooperative task execution.
  • Build scalable RAG and context pipelines that provide high-quality grounding for AI systems and keep them aligned with evolving data sources and business logic.
  • Implement tool-calling, function-calling, and MCP-style integrations so agents can safely take actions and interact with the systems around them.
  • Create reusable agent templates, modular components, and paved-path patterns that accelerate adoption across teams and use cases.
  • Establish strong evaluation, observability, and monitoring for conversation quality, task success rate, latency, cost, and overall system performance.
  • Build safeguards that improve production readiness and reliability, including testing pipelines, controlled rollouts, drift detection, and mechanisms that prevent error amplification in multi-step workflows.
  • Prototype quickly, run experiments, and translate successful ideas into durable, scalable software solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful business and customer outcomes.

What experience would help someone be successful in the role at Roku? 

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, backend development, or adjacent domains, with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build production-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus experience with C/C++ or another systems language.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, retrieval, tool use, memory handling, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, MCP servers or equivalent function-calling architectures, and conversational interfaces.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, REST APIs, containerization, and modern deployment environments.
  • Experience with observability, evaluation, experimentation, and feedback loops for AI systems in production.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, move quickly, and deliver incrementally in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative working style.

Nice to have

  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks or orchestration systems such as LangChain, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience with video, audio, TV, or edge-device environments, especially where latency, cost, and hardware constraints matter.
  • Familiarity with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Research experience, paper implementation experience, or a habit of applying emerging GenAI techniques pragmatically to real problems.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

descriptionHtml:

We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

title: Software Engineer, Web Development
descriptionHtml:

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Fixgehalt im Bereich von 50.000 bis 60.000 EUR pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen individuellen Stärken und Erfahrungen. Welche Technologien kommen in dieser Position zum Einsatz?

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Tech-Stack, der unter anderem Next.js, TypeScript, Python und React umfasst. Außerdem setzen wir auf innovative KI-Technologien wie Large Language Models und Vision Transformers.

Ein Studium in einem passenden Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik) ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger:innen, die sauberen Code zu schätzen wissen und praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringen, sind bei uns ebenfalls herzlich willkommen.

Ja, absolut! Bildung und Weiterentwicklung haben bei uns höchste Priorität – nicht nur extern, sondern auch intern. Du arbeitest eng mit UI/UX-Designern, Product Managern und anderen Entwickler:innen zusammen. Durch regelmäßige Code-Reviews und den Austausch im Team gestalten wir die Entwicklungsprozesse gemeinsam und fördern eine offene Feedback-Kultur.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Titanom besonders?

Bei uns hast du die Chance, mit modernsten Technologien an innovativen Bildungsprojekten zu arbeiten, die echten Impact haben. Wir legen großen Wert auf kreative Problemlösungen, Teamarbeit und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

You will be responsible for creating and assuring solution architecture using a wide range of technologies, from SaaS eCommerce platforms through to client-specific cloud solutions. Our Solution Architecture team not only focus on delivery but also work with our clients in delivering the best consulting advice to ensure world class solutions that enable our clients to transact more digitally.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Working on large-scale digital transformation programmes with global clients, designing solutions for all the opportunity and complexity this brings

  • See out and develop relationships with key client stakeholders responsible for digital and architecture strategy
  • Orchestrate and run design workshops, and translate business strategy and requirements into solution architecture
  • Ensure your architecture vision is realised by our teams, across all phases of programme delivery

  • Understand the level at which solution architecture applies, and help transition your solutions to application and cloud architects and technical leads
  • Make and justify key architectural decisions considering all relevant constraints
  • Follow the principles and guidance set out by the Solution Architecture team
  • Contribute to the initiatives of our Solution Architecture team, including developing common patterns for new technologies and developing PoCs against industry trends.

What we want from you: 

  • Core understanding of the capabilities of a wide range of technologies typically found within an eCommerce landscape, including enterprise eCommerce platforms and components, and apply this knowledge to your solutions
  • Proven experience of solution ownership,
  • Experience delivering solution transformations, roadmaps and (or) Integration strategies

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll define and drive the technical strategy for multi-objective payments optimisation, balancing payment conversion, fraud risk and transaction costs. You’ll own complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve payments performance and influence product adoption at scale.

  • Define algorithmic approaches such as contextual bandits, alongside experimentation methods including A/B testing and causal inference.

  • Partner with Engineering to build the tools, infrastructure and production machine-learning systems that enable optimisation at scale.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, Risk and Commercial teams to influence product strategy and investment decisions.

  • Communicate complex data insights and technical recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring your work drives decisions.

  • Mentor and coach data scientists and engineers, raising the bar for technical practice across the team.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • An advanced degree, such as a PhD or master’s, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of industry experience in data science or applied machine learning.

  • Strong experience with experimentation and causal inference to drive data-informed product decisions with measurable impact.

  • Experience operating as a technical leader, defining critical systems and influencing product strategy in a high-growth environment.

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python or R.

  • Experience using LLMs, AI and agents to improve processes or machine-learning models.

Preferred

  • Experience deploying machine-learning systems to production.

  • Experience with payments optimisation, fraud detection, risk modelling or other complex decisioning systems.

  • Experience with contextual bandits or other online optimisation methods.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

Learn more about your team

Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 150+ countries and 60+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. title: Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.
