title: Staff/Principal Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Why this role exists

In a world where it’s easier and easier to get software off the ground and to 75% built, it’s the last 25% that really matters. We need deep craft specialists—people who will raise the quality bar, bring a spark of creativity, drive best-in-class interaction and visual design, and push execution excellence across our most strategic product areas.

This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. We need a maker, a doer, a leader in craft.

If you have a deep passion for interaction design, product thinking, and pixel-perfect execution—and the leadership and autonomy to drive impact without waiting for direction—this is the role for you.

Must Have Experience

We’re looking for a world-class IC designer who:

  • Has shipped complex, high-quality software products.
  • Designs for multiple surfaces—desktop, mobile, chat interfaces, AI first and emerging experiences.
  • Balances speed and detail—knows when to move fast and when to obsess over the last 1%.
  • Thinks end-to-end—from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction detail.
  • Understands engineering and can build prototypes to communicate ideas (Framer, Loveable, Windsurf, Vercel, Figma, code etc...).
  • Has taste. You know what great design looks and feels like, and you push to get there.
  • Can tell a compelling story—articulating your decisions with clarity and conviction.
  • Operates with agency, ownership, and autonomy—doesn’t wait to be told what to do.

 Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not for you if: 
● You prefer strategy, research or system design over execution—this is a craft-heavy role.
● You need a lot of direction or structured processes—you should thrive in open-endedness and ambiguity.
● You don’t obsess over details—we’re looking for someone who sweats the pixels.
● You primarily work on marketing sites—this role is about designing deep, functional software experiences.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing: 
● Owning end-to-end design for high-impact product areas from concept to execution.
● Defining new interaction patterns and design paradigms for Fin, our automation, and AI-powered tools.
● Sketching, prototyping, and testing ideas at different fidelities to validate decisions.
● Working closely with engineers and PMs to define problems, move quickly, and deliver high-quality solutions.
● Maintaining high standards of craft while balancing speed and execution.
● Contributing to design culture—mentoring others, pushing for greatness in a team, refining processes, and sharing knowledge inside and outside Intercom.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re successful if: 
1. You’ve raised the design bar. Your work is referenced as an example of exceptional craft and taste.
2. You’ve shipped product with major business impact. The areas you own are visibly better because of you.
3. You operate autonomously. You don’t need direction—you see what needs to be done and do it.
4. Engineers love working with you. Your designs are considered, clear, and easy to implement.
5. Your peers trust your judgment. When you push for quality, people listen.

Interview Process

We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time and energy consuming–we aim to be thorough, speedy and transparent in our approach. You should expect for the entire 
process to be no more than 4 weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with various members of our team and have the opportunity to fully validate that Intercom and the role is the right fit
for you.

Ready to build something great?

If you're driven to push the boundaries of product design and have the craft, autonomy, and taste to make a real impact, we want to hear from you. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. title: Staff Product Manager (Runtime Team)
descriptionHtml:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

PolyAI automates customer service through lifelike voice assistants that let customers lead a conversation. Our voice assistants make it possible for businesses to deliver outstanding customer service that rivals their human agents.

Our customers, which include the world’s leading logos, are expanding how they use our platform, driving automation of critical customer service operations and integrating PolyAI into their daily customer service workflows.

We’re looking for a highly technical, senior product leader to own the platform underneath everything our agents do: the runtime that serves conversations in production, the inference layer that powers our models, and the data infrastructure that feeds both. This is a deep infrastructure role with direct exposure to latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs at scale, not a roadmap-and-backlog role. You’ll set strategy for areas other teams build on top of, working closely with engineering leadership rather than through them

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy for runtime (how conversations get served in production), inference (how our models are hosted and served, including self-hosted and third-party paths), and the data platform (how conversation and model data moves, is stored, and is queried across the business)
  • Set direction on build-vs-buy and self-host-vs-managed tradeoffs for model serving, including evaluating cost, latency, and scaling implications of infrastructure decisions before they’re made, not after
  • Build and own the evaluation framework for how we measure runtime and inference performance in production (latency, throughput, cost per minute/token, failure rates), and drive continuous improvement off that data
  • Partner directly with infrastructure and platform engineering leadership to sequence a technical roadmap that often has no visible customer-facing surface, and defend its priority against features that do
  • Own how conversation data flows into and out of the platform, including data residency, retention, and access-control tradeoffs that affect what the business can build or sell
  • Translate ambiguous technical constraints (capacity limits, model failure modes, data gaps) into decisions the rest of the business can plan around
  • Lead and influence a cross-functional group of engineers, data scientists, and infrastructure specialists without formal authority over them
  • Represent this area in exec-level conversations on cost, capacity planning, and platform risk

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of product management or related technical experience, including a strong track record owning infrastructure, ML/data platform, or runtime-adjacent products, not just user-facing features
  • Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field involving AI/ML or distributed systems, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong working knowledge of how inference and model-serving infrastructure actually works: latency budgets, GPU/node economics, self-hosted vs. managed serving tradeoffs
  • Comfortable owning a roadmap with no end-user-visible surface, and able to make the business case for infrastructure investment on its own terms
  • Experience with data platform decisions: pipelines, residency/compliance constraints, and tradeoffs between centralizing vs. fragmenting data by region or product line
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a senior level: setting direction, not just executing against someone else’s plan, and mentoring more junior PMs
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication skills, particularly translating infrastructure tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders

Compensation

We offer a competitive base salary, shaped by your experience and location, plus equity — so you share in the value you help create.

Benefits

Only the best
We expect the best from our people, we hire people that expect the best from themselves, and we nurture this drive for excellence.

Ownership

Relentlessly improve
We demand more from ourselves and are always evolving. Continuous, obsessive improvement is the only way we will transform the world of conversational AI.

Disagree and commit

Je adviseert Duty Managers en Recruitment over geschikte kandidaten voor een dienstverband en coördineert de overdracht na afloop van de stage.

title: Strategic Account Director - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

The Opportunity

We are taking the Commercial World Model into its next phase: agentic AI that reasons over it directly, running investigations and surfacing risk the way a senior analyst would, then returning sourced assessments for human review.

You would build and scale a new product line with the backing of an established, proven global organization. It offers the freedom of an entrepreneur inside a business, with talented resources behind you, including forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts. It is a front-row seat to the changes shaping global markets right now.

We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to bring deep subject matter expertise to our financial services vertical. You will join an already strong sales team and take it further into the relationships, domain depth, and agentic use cases this vertical needs next. You bring the network and the credibility that only years inside this sector can build.

You won’t be the first rep at Sayari, but you will be one of the first people anywhere selling agentic investigation and risk agents into this vertical, on a foundation of data other vendors in our space don’t have. That’s the pitch you’ll be making, and it’s a true one.

This is a senior, relationship-led seat focused on enterprise outcomes: multiyear agreements of $2M+, and agentic AI adoption that spreads into every adjacent buying center inside your accounts. Financial services runs on relationships that take years to earn. We want people who already have them and can use them to go deeper in a vertical we are already investing in, not start one from nothing.

The seat owns a high-value EMEA enterprise book with a dual mandate: expand what’s already there, and open new tier-1 logos through your own network. It is not a renewal seat, and it is not a customer-success seat with a senior title.

What You Will Drive

  • Own the full cycle. Win new business from the first conversation with a target account through a signed multiyear agreement. Self-generate 60%+ of your pipeline through your network, targeted outreach, and practitioner communities, not inbound leads.
  • Deepen the playbook. Bring domain expertise that sharpens how we sell agentic AI into this vertical. Refine our methodology, positioning, and use-case narrative based on what you know works with this buyer, and share it with the wider team.
  • Expand within accounts. Move accounts from a single agentic use case to enterprise-wide deployment across the Commercial World Model and our AI agents.
  • Map the executive landscape. Build trusted relationships across every function that touches risk: compliance and legal leadership, risk operations, investigations teams, procurement, and IT. Think Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and General Counsel.
  • Prove the agent, then scale it. Partner with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and your forward-deployed team to get agentic workflows into production with top-tier customers first. Use early wins as references to open net-new budget across the account.
  • Inform the roadmap. You are on the front line of how this vertical reacts to agentic AI. Take that market intelligence back to Product and Engineering.
  • Run a rigorous pipeline. Maintain a predictable pipeline using a structured sales methodology, and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.

Who You Are

  • A domain expert. 15+ years immersed specifically within the financial services blue-chip segment with C-Suite level context with a focus on banking compliance, risk and technology with a real, live and verifiable network already established inside that sector. Not adjacent experience. You know the regulatory environment, the day-to-day challenges practitioners face, and the trends shaping the sector.
  • A proven closer. A history of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements and driving net-new revenue from both existing complex accounts and new logos, which you can walk through in specific, named detail.
  • A strong communicator. Executive presence that lets you explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders, and be treated as a peer rather than a vendor.
  • A strategist. You navigate complex procurement, legal review, and multithreaded account politics, and can move from a single buyer into two or more adjacent buying centers. You are fluent in a structured methodology such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Miller Heimann.
  • A practitioner’s peer. You have spent your career inside this vertical, not selling into it from the outside. You can hold a substantive conversation with a senior practitioner on the regulatory, operational, or risk pressures they face.
  • A builder and pioneer. You are energized by growing something rather than maintaining it, with experience building a territory, book, vertical, or motion from scratch.
  • Curious about agentic AI. You don’t need to be technical, but you need to be the person in the room who can explain what agentic AI can and can’t yet do.
  • Ready to travel. Up to 25%, to be in the room with the accounts and stakeholders that matter most.

The Team Behind Every Deal

  • Forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts, embedded with the customer’s risk, compliance, and AI infrastructure teams to prove real use cases.
  • Solutions Engineering, to run technical proof and translate data provenance for non-technical stakeholders alongside you.
  • Customer Success, to land the first use case and turn it into a reference you can use to expand the account.
  • Marketing and BDR support on the remaining share of your pipeline. This is a network-and-credibility hire, not a “we have no leads” hire.

WHY TOP PERFORMERS CHOOSE SAYARI

  • Uncapped Revenue Upside: An aggressive, uncapped commission structure with market leading accelerators for expansion revenue, and no bonus caps.
  • Genuinely Novel Product: Sell agentic AI that shows its work and traces every finding to a primary source. Not a black box, and not a chatbot wrapper. You will be one of the first people selling autonomous investigation and risk agents into this vertical anywhere in the market.
  • Elite Benefits:  UK: fully paid private medical, dental, vision, salary sacrifice benefits.
  • Retirement: UK: 8% pension
  • True Rest: UK: 25 days plus bank holidays, plus a company-wide winter shutdown and other market leading leave policies.

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.

About the Role

We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Win new enterprise logos. Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.
  • Sell a platform, not a point solution. Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.
  • Run the full sales lifecycle. Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.
  • Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements. Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.
  • Be a trusted advisor. Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota
  • You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals
  • You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry
  • You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations
  • You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews
  • You are an outstanding presenter in person and virtually, with strong business acumen and natural curiosity
  • You are self-driven, organised and comfortable managing a long, multi-threaded pipeline with forecast discipline
  • You are tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools; you have worked with Salesforce, RFP management tools or similar systems
  • You are open to regular travel across EMEA to meet clients face-to-face
  • Nice to have: fluency in a second European language, and experience selling CRM, marketing, reservations, PMS or POS technology

About SevenRooms

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Support & Implementation Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wie ein Unternehmen seine Kunden abrechnet, entscheidet darüber, wie es wachsen kann. Subscription-Modelle, nutzungsbasierte Preise, individuelle Vertragskonditionen, die Anforderungen sind vielfältig, die Systeme dahinter oft nicht.

Fynn gibt Unternehmen die Infrastruktur, um genau das zu können: flexible, automatisierte Abrechnung, die mit dem Geschäft mitläuft statt es zu bremsen. Wir sind eine Plattform für das gesamte Quote-to-Contract Prozess, von der Angebotserstellung über Rechnungsstellung bis hin zum Inkasso.

Was uns ausmacht, zeigen am besten unsere Zahlen:

  • über 750.000 abgerechnete Kunden
  • bereits über 12.5 Mio Rechnungen versendet
  • seit mehr als 5 Jahren ein etablierter Player auf dem Markt

Wir sind ein eingespieltes Team mit klarem Fokus: solide Technologie, echte Kundenorientierung und der Anspruch, eine Kategorie zu definieren, die noch viel Gestaltungsraum hat.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als Software Engineer in unserem Implementation & Customer Team bist du die Brücke zwischen unserem Produkt und unseren Kunden. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kunden erfolgreich starten, technisch sauber, zuverlässig und ohne Reibungsverluste.

Das ist kein klassischer Support-Job. Es ist eine Engineering-Stelle mit starkem Kundenfokus, mit dem Unterschied, dass du den Weg vom Problem zur Lösung vollständig selbst gehst: von der Diagnose über die Implementierung bis zur Übergabe. Was du dabei siehst, fließt direkt ins Produkt.

Deine Aufgaben

Kunden-Onboarding & technische Integration
Du begleitest neue Kunden von der ersten technischen Analyse bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Das bedeutet: Systeme verstehen, Anforderungen klären und gemeinsam mit dem Kunden einen sauberen Start auf Fynn sicherstellen.

  • Technische Analyse bestehender Systeme und Datenstrukturen auf Kundenseite
  • Abstimmung mit Kunden zu Anforderungen, Zeitplan und Übergabekriterien
  • Aufsetzen und Verifizieren der Integration, API-Anbindungen, Konfiguration, Testläufe

Datenmigrationen

Ein großer Teil unserer Kunden wechselt von bestehenden Systemen zu Fynn. Du entwickelst und betreibst die ETL-Prozesse, die diesen Wechsel ermöglichen - strukturiert, validiert und sicher.

  • Analyse und Mapping von Quelldaten aus Legacy-Systemen, CSV-Exporten oder Fremd-APIs
  • Entwicklung von ETL-Pipelines mit sauberer Fehlerbehandlung, Validierungslogik und Logging
  • Qualitätssicherung der migrierten Daten, gerade im Finance-Kontext ist das kein optionaler Schritt

Support, Bugfixing & Weiterentwicklung

Wenn Kunden auf Probleme stoßen, bist du die erste technische Instanz. Du replizierst, analysierst und löst, oder übergibst mit vollständigem Kontext. Darüber hinaus bringst du dich damit aktiv in die Produktentwicklung ein.

  • Fehleranalyse und Bugfixing in unserem PHP/Symfony-Backend und der TypeScript-Schicht
  • Direkte Kommunikation mit Kunden zu Fehlerstand und Lösung
  • Feedback aus dem Kundenkontakt aktiv ins Produkt tragen, als konkreter
    Verbesserungsvorschlag
  • Unterstützung bei der Integration neuer Funktionen in die bestehende Plattform, um Kundenflexibilität zu erhöhen
  • Durchführung von Code-Reviews und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Benutzer-Dokumentation für unsere Software-Module

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen keine perfekte Passung auf eine Liste von Technologien. Wir suchen jemanden, der technisch solide ist, selbstständig denkt und Freude daran hat, für Kunden echte Probleme zu lösen.

  • 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, gerne in einem kundennahen Umfeld, als Implementation Engineer, Solutions Engineer oder Software Developer mit Kundenkontakt
  • Kenntnisse in Subscription Billing, Invoicing oder Fintech
  • Gute PHP-Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit Symfony-Erfahrung, du findest dich in einem bestehenden Backend zurecht
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang von objektorientierter Entwicklung
  • TypeScript / JavaScript: du kannst unsere API- und Frontend-Schicht lesen und Fehler darin einordnen
  • Solides SQL-Verständnis: Datenprobleme gehst du direkt an der Quelle an
  • Erfahrung mit Datenmigrationen oder ETL-Prozessen, oder eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie du es angehen würdest
  • Präzision: Im Finance-Umfeld hat jede Zahl eine Bedeutung, und du bist dir deiner Verantwortung bewusst
  • Kommunikation: du kannst einem Buchhalter und einem Backend-Developer dasselbe Problem erklären, auf zwei verschiedene Arten
  • Fließend Deutsch ist für unseren deutschsprachigen Kundenstamm ein Muss

Zur Arbeitsweise

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht allein. Code Reviews, gemeinsame Fehleranalysen, offene Fragen im Team, das gehört bei uns zum Alltag, nicht zur Ausnahme. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass kritischer Code ein zweites Paar Augen bekommt, dass Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar dokumentiert sind, und dass Wissen nicht bei einzelnen Personen hängt, sondern im Team verfügbar bleibt.

Daneben arbeiten wir konsequent mit AI-Tools wie Claude Code, Codex oder andere, nicht um Schritte zu überspringen, sondern um den Fokus auf das zu legen, was wirklich zählt: das Verständnis des Problems, die Qualität der Lösung, das Feedback vom Kunden. Erfahrung damit ist kein Einstellungskriterium. Die Bereitschaft, so zu arbeiten, schon.

Unser Stack

Wir hiren für Fähigkeiten, nicht für spezifische Technologien. Den Stack lernst du hier, wichtiger ist, wie du an Probleme herangehst.

  • PHP / Symfony / PHPUnit
  • TypeScript / Node.JS
  • PostgreSQL
  • Gitlab
  • Linear
  • Notion

Benefits

  • Mitgestaltung - Die Chance, an wegweisenden FinTech-Lösungen mitzuarbeiten und die Zukunft der Finanzbranche mitzugestalten
  • Weiterbildung - Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung, inklusive Schulungen und Konferenzteilnahmen. Zudem ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Kreativität und Innovation aktiv gefördert werden
  • Standort & Remote - Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für Remote-Arbeit, um eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance zu ermöglichen
  • Ausstattung - Aktuelles MacBook und alles, was du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können
  • Mobilität & Sport - Deutschland-Ticket oder Urban Sports Club, du wählst, was zu dir passt
  • 30 Tage Urlaub - pro Jahr für eine optimale Work-Life-Balance
  • Wachstum & Ownership - Du übernimmst Themen von Anfang bis Ende. Wenn Fynn wächst, wächst dein Aufgabenbereich mit, in die Richtung, die du einschlagen willst

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Ein Satz dazu reicht für den ersten Schritt. Alles Weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam im Call. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

title: Talent Lead
descriptionHtml:
You make sure the best people apply to Pivotal's programs, and that we select the right ones.

  • Salary: £86,750–£155,500 per year, depending on seniority. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll own how people find Pivotal’s programs and how we select them. This runs from the first time someone hears about us to the final decision, which you make with mentors. In 2027 we plan up to 4 more application rounds, and for our Q1 2027 round we received 5,000+ applications.

The primary focus will be to grow the number of strong applicants, including people from outside the usual AI safety pipeline, such as mid-career professionals. You’ll also run selection at scale, which is getting harder because AI-written applications make written answers a weaker signal. You’ll design each round, check afterwards whether it picked the right people, and change it when it did not.

  • Outreach and marketing. Grow the number of strong applicants for each program through channels, campaigns, partner organisations, and presence at universities and conferences.

  • Communications for applicants. Program pages, application guidance and messages to applicants.

  • The selection process. Design and run each round: forms, AI-assisted screening, contract reviewers, work tasks, interviews, and final decisions with mentors and Research Managers. Keep it fair, fast and compliant with data protection law.

  • Learning from results. Track which selection signals predict good fellowships and careers. This includes fellows who did worse than expected and strong applicants we turned down. Change the process based on what you find.

Who does well in this role

  • You have run recruiting, admissions, marketing or talent search for a selective program or organisation, and you can show results.

  • You have good judgement about people, and you can make it explicit so that others can apply it consistently.

  • You want to find out if your process works, and you change it when it does not.

  • You are good at outreach & communications, including outside the AI safety community.

  • You use AI tools well, for example to screen at scale, and you know where they fail.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks from AI. You do not need a research background.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £155,500

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Du willst als Account Executive Steuerkanzleien im Raum Düsseldorf oder München für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video und vor Ort in der Kanzlei? Als eine:r der ersten Account Executives für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du dir dein eigenes Gebiet auf, verantwortest den gesamten Vertriebszyklus bis zum Onboarding und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Firms-Team den Vertriebsansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden.

🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission

Du wirst eine:r der ersten Account Executives (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du baust dir deine Pipeline selbst auf, überzeugst Kanzleiinhaber:innen in der Demo und vor Ort und begleitest deine Kanzleien vom Abschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du arbeitest mit dem bewährten Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du zunächst direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an – als eine:r der Ersten gestaltest du mit, wie Pennylane hier an Kanzleien verkauft. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland.

Dein Team

Full-Cycle Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management deiner Kanzleien.

Outbound ist Kern: Rund 50 % deiner Pipeline baust du selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Ergänzt wird das durch Inbound-Leads und Empfehlungen. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr.

Starkes Setup: Dabei bist du nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt dich bei Onboarding und Betreuung deiner Kanzleien, damit du genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung hast.

Regional organisiert: Du betreust eine feste Region – Düsseldorf/Nordrhein-Westfalen oder München/Bayern – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien. Deshalb suchen wir dich dort, wo deine Kanzleien sind.

Im Aufbau: Du kommst zu einem kleinen Team von Account Executives dazu, das mit dir wächst – bald unter der Führung eines Team Leads Sales Firms in Berlin.

Beratender Vertrieb: Du gewinnst Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Du machst den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schaffst Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

Remote in deiner Region: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice oder Coworking in deiner Region und bist regelmäßig bei Kanzleien vor Ort, auf Messen und bei Verbandsveranstaltungen. Etwa einmal im Monat kommst du für Team-Treffen in unser Berliner Office.

Du wirst für den Erfolg deiner Region verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest den MRR aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region und trägst zur Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment bei.

  • Du baust eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst deine Aktivitätsquoten hoch.

  • Du führst Bedarfsanalysen und Produktdemos durch und begleitest komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Customer Success für eine reibungslose Übergabe und baust deine Kanzleien aus, indem du die Anzahl der über Pennylane betreuten Mandanten steigerst.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Pipeline sauber im CRM und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dich selbst zu steuern.

Als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst deine Vertriebsziele und hast nach 3 Monaten eine qualifizierte Pipeline, nach 6 Monaten deine ersten Kanzleien und erste Referenzen.

  • Du baust ein Netzwerk von Botschafter-Kanzleien auf, die Pennylane weiterempfehlen.

  • Du vertrittst Pennylane auf Branchenevents, Fachmessen und Veranstaltungen von Steuerberaterverbänden in deiner Region.

  • Du bringst deine Markteinblicke in Product, Marketing und das SME-Sales-Team ein.

  • Du teilst deine Learnings und baust das Playbook für die nächsten AEs mit auf.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb mit – mit komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast nachweislich Abschlüsse erzielt, die du selbst angebahnt hast.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast selbst Outbound gemacht: Kaltakquise bei Inhaber:innen und Entscheider:innen schreckt dich nicht – sie ist dein Hebel.

  • Du bist ein Builder: Du hast schon einmal ein Gebiet, einen Markt oder einen Prozess aufgebaut – idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up oder Scale-up) – und baust Vertrauen auf, bei Kanzleiinhaber:innen wie im Team.

  • Du bist gern draußen: Field Sales ist für dich kein Kompromiss, sondern der Grund, warum du diesen Job willst – Kanzleibesuche, Messen und Verbandstermine gehören für dich dazu.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst im Raum Düsseldorf oder München, hast einen Führerschein und eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland – und bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

title: Technical Marketing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

descriptionHtml:

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

➡️ Content-Expertise – Du identifizierst Trends, Formate und Chancen auf TikTok und leitest daraus kreative wie strategische Empfehlungen ab.

➡️ Analyse & Optimierung – Du beobachtest KPIs, leitest Learnings ab und optimierst Strategien datenbasiert.

➡️ Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit – Du arbeitest eng mit Redaktion, Design, Consulting und Data zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

✅ TikTok-Expertise - Du kennst die Plattform in ihrer Tiefe: Trends, Mechaniken, Community-Dynamiken, Formate.

title: Underwriting Assistant
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

You'll sit at the centre of our underwriting and customer operations, working with brokers and customers to keep new business and renewals moving. You'll report to our Senior Customer Operations Manager and work closely with our underwriters and with the Finance, Risk Intelligence and Product teams.

The role suits someone starting a career in insurance who enjoys solving problems and getting the detail right. You'll build a grounding in underwriting and customer service that carries into underwriting, operations or customer success. We expect you to use AI every day, and to build your own AI tools and workflows that take repetitive work off the team.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Process broker submissions and gather the information underwriters need to make a decision, using AI tools to read documents and spot gaps.

  • Answer broker and customer policy queries by phone, live chat and email, with fast and accurate resolutions.

  • Support underwriting analysis on new business and renewals with data-driven insight.

  • Triage underwriting referrals and allocate them according to underwriting authority levels.

  • Work with Underwriting, Finance, Risk Intelligence and Product to investigate and resolve issues.

  • Build and improve AI workflows, prompts and self-service routes that remove manual steps from our processes.

  • Capture broker and customer feedback, and turn recurring themes into process improvements and automation ideas.

  • Explain policy details and underwriting decisions to brokers and customers, and show them how to self-serve.

  • Follow internal procedures, regulatory requirements and company policies.

 

What you'll need

Essential

  • A genuine wish to start a career in insurance, underwriting or financial services.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret risk data.

  • A customer-first approach that keeps underwriting integrity intact.

  • Clear communication, including explaining complex points in plain language, and good rapport with brokers and customers.

  • Close attention to detail in everything you process and send.

  • Comfort using AI tools every day, and the curiosity to pick up new digital tools quickly.

  • The ability to work independently and with others, and to manage several priorities at once in a fast-paced setting.

Preferable

  • Some knowledge of commercial motor insurance, or an interest in underwriting and risk assessment.

  • Experience in customer or broker-facing roles.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

 

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

  • Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
  • Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
  • Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
  • Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
  • Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
  • Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
  • Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
  • Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
  • Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
  • Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
  • Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
  • Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
  • Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
  • Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
  • Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
  • Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
